  Future<void> _rejectItem(int itemId) async {
    final controllers = [TextEditingController()];

    final result = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            ),
            title: Text(
              'Tolak Item',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 500,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Berikan alasan penolakan dalam bentuk checklist:',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                      fontSize: 13,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Flexible(
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      child: Column(
                        children: controllers.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                          final idx = entry.key;
                          final ctrl = entry.value;
                          return Padding(
                            key: ValueKey(ctrl),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                            child: Row(
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.check_box_outline_blank_rounded,
                                  size: 20,
                                  color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: TextField(
                                    controller: ctrl,
                                    autofocus: idx == controllers.length - 1,
                                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                                      hintText: 'Alasan #${idx + 1}',
                                      isDense: true,
                                      contentPadding:
                                          const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                        vertical: 10,
                                        horizontal: 12,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _primaryText(ctx),
                                      fontSize: 14,
                                    ),                                    maxLines: null,
                                    minLines: 1,
                                    keyboardType: TextInputType.multiline,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                if (controllers.length > 1)
                                  IconButton(
                                    icon: const Icon(
                                      Icons.remove_circle_outline,
                                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                                      size: 20,
                                    ),
                                    onPressed: () {
                                      final removedCtrl = controllers[idx];
                                      setDialogState(() {
                                        controllers.removeAt(idx);
                                      });
                                      Future.delayed(
                                        const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
                                        () {
                                          removedCtrl.dispose();
                                        },
                                      );
                                    },
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => setDialogState(() {
                      controllers.add(TextEditingController());
                    }),
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    label: const Text('Tambah Alasan'),
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: AppTheme.accent,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx, false);
                },
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (controllers.every((c) => c.text.trim().isEmpty)) return;
                  Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
                },
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                ),
                child: const Text('Tolak Item'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    if (result == true) {
      if (!mounted) {
        for (var c in controllers) {
          try {
            c.dispose();
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        return;
      }
      final reasons = controllers
          .map((c) => c.text.trim())
          .where((t) => t.isNotEmpty)
          .map((t) => {'text': t, 'checked': false})
          .toList();

      if (reasons.isNotEmpty) {
        final notesJson = jsonEncode(reasons);
        final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
        final success = await prov.approveAdvanceItem(
          itemId,
          'reject',
          notes: notesJson,
        );
        if (mounted) {
          if (success) {
            prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
          } else {
            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
              SnackBar(
                content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal reject item'),
                backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
              ),
            );
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Always dispose after everything is done
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      for (var c in controllers) {
        try {
          c.dispose();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    });
  }

  void _showEvidence(String path, String? filename) {
    final paths = path.split('|').where((p) => p.isNotEmpty).toList();
    final filenames =
        (filename ?? '').split('|').where((f) => f.isNotEmpty).toList();
    if (paths.isEmpty) return;

    final screenWidth = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final token = context.read<AuthProvider>().token;

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                paths.length > 1
                    ? 'Bukti (${paths.length} file)'
                    : (filenames.isNotEmpty ? filenames[0] : 'Evidence'),
                style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx), fontSize: 18),
              ),
            ),
            if (paths.length > 1)
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () async {
                  for (final p in paths) {
                    final url = prov.getEvidenceUrl(p);
                    final uri = Uri.parse(url);
                    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
                      await launchUrl(
                        uri,
                        mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                      );
                    }
                  }
                },
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 12,
                    vertical: 8,
                  ),
                  textStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded, size: 14),
                label: const Text('Buka Semua'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: screenWidth > 700 ? 700 : screenWidth * 0.95,
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Center(
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 16,
                runSpacing: 16,
                alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                children: List.generate(paths.length, (index) {
                  final p = paths[index];
                  final name = filenames.length > index
                      ? filenames[index]
                      : p.split('/').last;
                  final url = prov.getEvidenceUrl(p);
                  final pLower = p.toLowerCase();
                  final isPdf = pLower.endsWith('.pdf');
                  final isImage = pLower.endsWith('.jpg') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.jpeg') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.png') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.webp') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.gif');

                  return InkWell(
                    onTap: () async {
                      final uri = Uri.parse(url);
                      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
                        await launchUrl(
                          uri,
                          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                        );
                      }
                    },
                    child: Container(
                      width: 140,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: _cardColor(ctx).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: _creamColor(ctx).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            height: 100,
                            width: 120,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.black12,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            ),
                            child: isImage
                                ? ClipRRect(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                    child: Image.network(
                                      url,
                                      headers: {
                                        'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
                                      },
                                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                      loadingBuilder:
                                          (context, child, loadingProgress) {
                                        if (loadingProgress == null) {
                                          return child;
                                        }
                                        return const Center(
                                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                            strokeWidth: 2,
                                          ),
                                        );
                                      },
                                      errorBuilder: (ctx, error, stack) =>
                                          const Icon(Icons.broken_image),
                                    ),
                                  )
                                : Icon(
                                    isPdf
                                        ? Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded
                                        : Icons.insert_drive_file_rounded,
                                    size: 48,
                                    color: isPdf
                                        ? AppTheme.danger
                                        : AppTheme.primary,
                                  ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            name,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: _creamColor(ctx),
                              fontSize: 10,
                            ),
                            maxLines: 2,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Tutup'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
        title: Text(
          'Hapus $count Item',
          style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Hapus $count item yang dipilih? Tindakan ini tidak bisa dibatalkan.',
          style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Batal'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger),
            child: const Text('Hapus'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;

    if (!mounted) return;
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final success = await prov.bulkDeleteAdvanceItems(
      _selectedItemIds.toList(),
      widget.advanceId,

      setState(() => _selectedItemIds.clear());
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text('$count item dihapus ✓'),
            backgroundColor: AppTheme.success,
          ),
        );
      }
    }
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _asMapList(dynamic list) {
    if (list == null || list is! List) return [];
    return list.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _uniqueById(List<Map<String, dynamic>> list) {
    final seen = <dynamic>{};
    return list.where((item) => seen.add(item['id'])).toList();
  }

              labelText:
                  parentId != null ? 'Nama Sub Kategori' : 'Nama Kategori',
            ),
            style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
            autofocus: true,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(innerCtx),
            child: const Text('Batal'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () async {
              if (nameCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
              final success = await prov.createCategory(
                nameCtrl.text.trim(),
                parentId: parentId,
              );
              if (innerCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(innerCtx);
              if (success && mounted) {
                // cari kategori baru untuk callback
                final all = prov.categories;
                Map<String, dynamic> found = {};

                // cari kategori yang baru dibuat
                for (final p in all) {
                  if (parentId == null && p['name'] == nameCtrl.text.trim()) {
                    found = p;
                    break;
                  }
                  if (parentId != null && p['id'] == parentId) {
                    final children = (p['children'] as List?) ?? [];
                    for (final c in children) {
                      if (c['name'] == nameCtrl.text.trim()) {
                        found = c;
                        break;
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }

                onCreated(found);

                if (context.mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    const SnackBar(
                      content: Text(
                        'Kategori ditambahkan (menunggu approval manager) ✓',
                      ),
                      backgroundColor: AppTheme.success,
                    ),
                  );
                }
              }
            },
            child: const Text('Tambah'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    // Delayed dispose
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      nameCtrl.dispose();
    });
  }

  void _showChecklistDialog(
    int itemId,
    List<dynamic> checklist,
    String advanceStatus,
  ) {
    final isRejected =
        advanceStatus == 'rejected' || advanceStatus == 'revision_rejected';
    final isSubmitted =
        advanceStatus == 'submitted' || advanceStatus == 'revision_submitted';
    final isDraft = advanceStatus == 'draft';
    final isRevisionDraft = advanceStatus == 'revision_draft';

    // SEMUA user (manager/staff) TIDAK bisa edit saat submitted
    // Bisa edit saat draft/rejected/revision_draft
    final canEdit = !isSubmitted && (isDraft || isRejected || isRevisionDraft);
    final canAddComment = canEdit;

    List<Map<String, dynamic>> localChecklist = _parseChecklist(checklist);

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setModalState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            title: Text(
              'Rejection Checklist${!canEdit ? ' (Lihat saja)' : ''}',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 400,
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 420),
                child: AppScrollbar(
                  controller: _checklistScrollController,
                  thumbVisibility: true,
                  interactive: true,
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    controller: _checklistScrollController,
                    child: SelectionArea(
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          ...localChecklist.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                            final item = entry.value;
                            return _buildChecklistTile(
                              item,
                              canEdit,
                              setModalState,
                            );
                          }),
                          if (canAddComment)
                            _buildAddCommentButton(
                              localChecklist,
                              setModalState,
                            ),
                          if (!canEdit && isSubmitted)
                            Container(
                              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 12,
                                vertical: 8,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(
                                    alpha: 0.3,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  const Icon(
                                    Icons.info_outline,
                                    size: 16,
                                    color: AppTheme.warning,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Text(
                                      'Kasbon disubmit, Move to Draft untuk edit',
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 11,
                                        color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(
                                          alpha: 0.9,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: Text(
                  'Tutup',
                  style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
                ),
              ),
              if (canEdit)
                _buildSaveChecklistButton(
                  ctx,
                  itemId,
                  localChecklist,
                  advanceStatus,
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _parseChecklist(dynamic checklist) {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> local = [];
    try {
      dynamic parsed = checklist is String ? jsonDecode(checklist) : checklist;
      if (parsed is List) {
        for (final e in parsed) {
          String text = '';
          bool checked = false;

          if (e is Map) {
            text = (e['text'] ?? '').toString();
            checked = e['checked'] == true;
          } else if (e is String) {
            text = e;
          }

          if (text.isNotEmpty) {
            local.add({'text': text, 'checked': checked});
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return local;
  }

  Widget _buildChecklistTile(
    Map<String, dynamic> item,
    bool canEdit,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    final alreadyChecked = item['checked'] == true;
    return CheckboxListTile(
      value: alreadyChecked,
      onChanged: canEdit
          ? (val) => setModalState(() => item['checked'] = val ?? false)
          : null,
      title: alreadyChecked
          ? SelectionContainer.disabled(
              child: Text(
                item['text'] ?? '',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: _secondaryText(context),
                  decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough,
                ),
              ),
            )
          : Text(
              item['text'] ?? '',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(context)),
            ),
      activeColor: AppTheme.success,
      checkColor: Colors.white,
      controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAddCommentButton(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
        onPressed: () => setModalState(
          () => list.add({'text': 'Komentar baru', 'checked': false}),
        ),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 18),
        label: const Text('Tambah komentar'),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSaveChecklistButton(
    BuildContext dialogCtx,
    int itemId,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list,
    String status,
  ) {
    return ElevatedButton(
      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
      ),
      onPressed: () async {
        bool allFinished = list.every((it) => it['checked'] == true);
        final newStatus = allFinished ? 'pending' : 'rejected';

        final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
        final success = await prov.updateItemPartial(itemId, {
          'notes': jsonEncode(list),
          'status': newStatus,
        });

        if (success) {
          prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          _showGlobalSnackBar(
            'Checklist berhasil disimpan ✓',
            AppTheme.success,
          );
        } else {
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          _showGlobalSnackBar('Gagal menyimpan checklist', AppTheme.danger);
        }
      },
      child: const Text('Simpan'),
    );
  }

  void _showGlobalSnackBar(String message, Color color) {
    if (context.mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message), backgroundColor: color));
    }
  }

  Widget _buildFileList(
    List<String> paths,
    List<String>? filenames,
    bool isLocal,
    Function(int) onRemove,
    BuildContext ctx,
    StateSetter setDialogState,
  ) {
    if (paths.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(ctx)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            isLocal
                ? 'Terpilih (${paths.length}):'
                : 'File Lama (${paths.length}):',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          ...List.generate(paths.length, (index) {
            final name = (filenames != null && filenames.length > index)
                ? filenames[index]
                : paths[index].split('/').last;
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    isLocal ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.cloud_done,
                    color: isLocal ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.primary,
                    size: 14,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      name,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: isLocal ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.cream,
                        fontSize: 11,
                      ),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        onRemove(index);
                      });
                    },
                    child: const Icon(
                      Icons.cancel,
                      size: 16,
                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showEditDisbursementDialog(
    Map<String, dynamic> advance,
    List<String> options,
  ) {
    List<String> localDisbursementFilePaths = List.from(_disbursementFilePaths);
    List<String> localExistingPaths = List.from(_existingDisbursementPaths);
    List<String> localExistingNames = List.from(_existingDisbursementFilenames);
    String? localDisbursementSource =
        (advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty
            ? null
            : (advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Edit Rincian Pengiriman'),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                  title: const Text('Tanggal Pengiriman'),
                  subtitle: Text(
                    AppFormatters.formatDateForApi(_disbursementDate!),
                  ),
                  trailing: const Icon(Icons.calendar_today),
                  onTap: () async {
                    final picked = await showDatePicker(
                      context: context,
                      initialDate: _disbursementDate!,
                      firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                      lastDate: DateTime(2101),
                    );
                    if (picked != null) {
                      setDialogState(() => _disbursementDate = picked);
                    }
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: localDisbursementSource,
                  isExpanded: true,
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Sumber Dana',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                  items: options
                      .map(
                        (source) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                          value: source,
                          child: Text(source),
                        ),
                      )
                      .toList(),
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setDialogState(() => localDisbursementSource = value);
                  },
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                const Text(
                  'Deskripsi',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  _disbursementDescriptionController.text,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _disbursedAmountController,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Amount',
                    prefixText: 'Rp ',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _adminFeeController,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Biaya Admin',
                    prefixText: 'Rp ',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final paths = await _pickDisbursementEvidence();
                    if (paths != null) {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        for (var p in paths) {
                          if (!localDisbursementFilePaths.contains(p)) {
                            localDisbursementFilePaths.add(p);
                          }
                        }
                      });
                    }
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.upload_file_rounded),
                  label: const Text('Tambah Bukti Transfer'),
                ),
                if (localExistingPaths.isNotEmpty)
                  _buildFileList(
                    localExistingPaths,
                    localExistingNames,
                    false,
                    (idx) {
                      localExistingPaths.removeAt(idx);
                      if (localExistingNames.length > idx) {
                        localExistingNames.removeAt(idx);
                      }
                    },
                    ctx,
                    setDialogState,
                  ),
                if (localDisbursementFilePaths.isNotEmpty)
                  _buildFileList(
                    localDisbursementFilePaths,
                    null,
                    true,
                    (idx) => localDisbursementFilePaths.removeAt(idx),
                    ctx,
                    setDialogState,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: const Text('Batal'),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
                final disbursementSource = localDisbursementSource?.trim();

                if (disbursementSource == null || disbursementSource.isEmpty) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    const SnackBar(
                      content: Text('Pilih Sumber Dana terlebih dahulu'),
                      backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                    ),
                  );
                  return;
                }

                setDialogState(() => _isSaving = true);
                final success = await prov.saveDisbursement(
                  advanceId: widget.advanceId,
                  disbursementSource: disbursementSource,
                  adminFee: _toDouble(_adminFeeController.text),
                  disbursedAmount: _toDouble(_disbursedAmountController.text),
                  evidenceFiles:
                      localDisbursementFilePaths.map((p) => File(p)).toList(),
                );
                setDialogState(() => _isSaving = false);

                if (success && mounted) {
                  setState(() {
                    _disbursementFilePaths.clear();
                    _disbursementFilePaths.addAll(localDisbursementFilePaths);
                  });
                  if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                } else if (!success && context.mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(
                      content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal menyimpan data'),
                      backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                    ),
                  );
                }
              },
              child: const Text('Simpan'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showEditReturnDialog() {
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final advance = prov.currentAdvance;
    if (advance == null) return;

    List<String> localReturnFilePaths = List.from(_returnFilePaths);
    List<String> localExistingPaths = List.from(_existingReturnPaths);
    List<String> localExistingNames = List.from(_existingReturnFilenames);
    String? localReturnSource =
        (advance['return_source'] ?? advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '')
                .toString()
                .trim()
                .isEmpty
            ? null
            : (advance['return_source'] ?? advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '')
                .toString()
                .trim();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setDialogState) {
          // Hitung saran kembalian (jika disbursed > approved)
          final approvedAmount = _toDouble(advance['approved_amount']);
          final disbursed = _toDouble(_disbursedAmountController.text);
          final excess = disbursed - approvedAmount;
          final suggestedReturn = excess > 0 ? excess : 0.0;

          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            title: Text('Edit Rincian Pengembalian',
                style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx))),
            content: SingleChildScrollView(
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  ListTile(
                    contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    title: Text('Tanggal Kembali',
                        style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx))),
                    subtitle: Text(
                      AppFormatters.formatDateForApi(_returnDate!),
                      style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
                    ),
                    trailing:
                        Icon(Icons.calendar_today, color: AppTheme.primary),
                    onTap: () async {
                      final picked = await showDatePicker(
                        context: context,
                        initialDate: _returnDate!,
                        firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                        lastDate: DateTime(2101),
                      );
                      if (picked != null) {
                        setDialogState(() => _returnDate = picked);
                      }

                  TextFormField(
                    controller: _returnedAmountController,
                    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                    inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                    style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),

                      labelText: 'Amount',
                      prefixText: 'Rp ',
                      border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                      suffixIcon: suggestedReturn > 0
                          ? TextButton(
                              onPressed: () {
                                setDialogState(() {
                                  _returnedAmountController.text =
                                      _currencyFormat.format(suggestedReturn);
                                });
                              },
                              child: const Text('Sesuai Sisa'),
                            )
                          : null,
                    ),                  ),
                  if (suggestedReturn > 0) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.info_outline,
                              size: 14, color: AppTheme.warning),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              'Saran kembalian (Sisa Dana): Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(suggestedReturn)}',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11, color: AppTheme.warning),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: localReturnSource,
                    dropdownColor: _cardColor(ctx),
                    isExpanded: true,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Sumber Dana',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    items: _advanceFundSourceOptions(advance)
                        .map(
                          (source) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                            value: source,
                            child: Text(source),
                          ),
                        )
                        .toList(),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setDialogState(() => localReturnSource = value);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: _returnDescriptionController,
                    maxLines: 3,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Komentar / Catatan Pengembalian',
                      hintText: 'Masukkan catatan tambahan jika ada...',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      alignLabelWithHint: true,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  Text(
                    'Evidence (Bukti Kembali)',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: _creamColor(ctx)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () async {
                      final paths = await _pickReturnEvidence();
                      if (paths != null) {
                        setDialogState(() {
                          for (var p in paths) {
                            if (!localReturnFilePaths.contains(p)) {
                              localReturnFilePaths.add(p);
                            }
                          }
                        });
                      }
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.file_upload_outlined),
                    label: const Text('Pilih Bukti Kembali'),
                  ),
                  if (localExistingPaths.isNotEmpty)
                    _buildFileList(
                      localExistingPaths,
                      localExistingNames,
                      false,
                      (idx) {
                        localExistingPaths.removeAt(idx);
                        if (localExistingNames.length > idx) {
                          localExistingNames.removeAt(idx);
                        }
                      },
                      ctx,
                      setDialogState,
                    ),
                  if (localReturnFilePaths.isNotEmpty)
                    _buildFileList(
                      localReturnFilePaths,
                      null,
                      true,
                      (idx) => localReturnFilePaths.removeAt(idx),
                      ctx,
                      setDialogState,
                    ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
                  final returnSource = localReturnSource?.trim();
                  if (_toDouble(_returnedAmountController.text) > 0 &&
                      (returnSource == null || returnSource.isEmpty)) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text(
                            'Pilih Sumber Dana pengembalian terlebih dahulu'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }
                  setDialogState(() => _isSaving = true);
                  final success = await prov.saveReturn(
                    advanceId: widget.advanceId,
                    returnedAmount: _toDouble(_returnedAmountController.text),
                    returnSource: returnSource,
                    returnDescription: _returnDescriptionController.text,
                    returnEvidenceFiles:
                        localReturnFilePaths.map((p) => File(p)).toList(),
                    existingFilePaths: localExistingPaths,
                    existingFileNames: localExistingNames,
                  );
                  setDialogState(() => _isSaving = false);

                  if (success && mounted) {
                    setState(() {
                      _returnFilePaths.clear();
                      _existingReturnPaths.clear();
                      _existingReturnFilenames.clear();
                    });
                    if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _showGlobalSnackBar(
                        'Data pengembalian disimpan', AppTheme.success);
                  } else if (!success && context.mounted) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      SnackBar(
                        content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal menyimpan data'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Simpan'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }
}

  // Settlement versions
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> approveDisbursementSettlement(
      int settlementId) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveReturnSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnSource,
    String? returnDescription,
    List<File>? returnEvidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/save-return'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnSource != null && returnSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_source'] = returnSource.trim();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null && returnDescription.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription.trim();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (returnEvidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in returnEvidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'return_evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

  String _formatAmount(dynamic amount, String? currency) {

    if (currency == 'IDR' || currency == null) {

    return '$currency ${NumberFormat('#,##0.##', 'en_US').format(val)}';

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

@jwt_required()
def save_return(advance_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    if user.role != "manager" and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    if advance.status not in (
        "draft",
        "revision_draft",
        "rejected",
        "revision_rejected",
    ):
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Tabel ini hanya bisa diubah dalam mode Draft atau Revisi."}
        ), 400

    # Set modified flag
    advance.modified_t3 = True

    if advance.return_status == "submitted" and user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Data sedang disubmit, tidak bisa diubah. Tunggu review manager."}
        ), 400

    data = (
        request.form.to_dict()
        if request.form
        else (request.get_json(silent=True) or {})
    )

    if "returned_amount" in data:
        advance.returned_amount = float(data["returned_amount"])
    if "return_source" in data:
        advance.return_source = str(data["return_source"]).strip() or None
    if "return_description" in data:
        advance.return_description = str(data["return_description"]).strip() or None

    if not advance.returned_amount:
        advance.return_source = None

    # Reset status ke pending jika sedang rejected atau submitted (saat ditarik kembali/diedit)
    if advance.return_status in ("rejected", "submitted"):
        advance.return_status = "pending"

    # Handle Evidence (Merging Existing + New)
    existing_paths = []
    existing_filenames = []

    if "existing_return_evidence_paths" in data:
        try:
            existing_paths = json.loads(data["existing_return_evidence_paths"])
        except Exception:
            existing_paths = []

    if "existing_return_evidence_filenames" in data:
        try:
            existing_filenames = json.loads(data["existing_return_evidence_filenames"])
        except Exception:
            existing_filenames = []

    new_paths = []
    new_filenames = []
    if "return_evidence" in request.files:
        files = request.files.getlist("return_evidence")
        for file in files:
            if file and file.filename and allowed_file(file.filename):
                ext = file.filename.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower()
                unique_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
                now = datetime.now()
                year_month = f"{now.year}/{now.month:02d}"
                upload_dir = os.path.join(
                    current_app.config["UPLOAD_FOLDER"], "receipts", year_month
                )
                os.makedirs(upload_dir, exist_ok=True)
                file.save(os.path.join(upload_dir, unique_name))
                new_paths.append(f"receipts/{year_month}/{unique_name}")
                new_filenames.append(file.filename)

    final_paths = existing_paths + new_paths
    final_filenames = existing_filenames + new_filenames

    advance.return_evidence_path = "|".join(final_paths) if final_paths else None
    advance.return_evidence_filename = (
        "|".join(final_filenames) if final_filenames else None
    )

    db.session.commit()
    db.session.refresh(advance)
    return jsonify(
        {"message": "Data pengembalian berhasil disimpan", "advance": advance.to_dict()}
    ), 200

  String _formatItemAmount(Map<String, dynamic> item) {
    final currency = (item['currency'] ?? 'IDR').toString().toUpperCase();
    final estimated = (item['estimated_amount'] ?? 0) as num;
    final kurs = (item['currency_exchange'] ?? 1.0) as num;
    final idrStr = item['idr_amount'];
    final idr = (idrStr is num && idrStr > 0) ? idrStr : (estimated * kurs);

    if (currency == 'IDR') {
      return 'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(estimated)}';
    }
    final foreignFormat = NumberFormat('#,##0.##', 'en_US');
    return '$currency ${foreignFormat.format(estimated)} (Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(idr)})';
  }

  List<String> _getCommentsFromNotes(String notes) {
    if (notes.isEmpty) return [];

    final systemPrefixes = [
      'Disetujui oleh',
      'Imported from',
      'Subcategory:',
      'Approved by',
      'System:',
    ];

    try {
      final decoded = json.decode(notes);
      if (decoded is List) {
        final List<String> comments = [];
        for (var item in decoded) {
          final text = (item is Map ? item['text'] : item).toString();

          bool isSystem = false;
          for (var prefix in systemPrefixes) {
            if (text.trim().startsWith(prefix)) {
              isSystem = true;
              break;
            }
          }

          if (!isSystem && text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
            comments.add(text.trim());
          }
        }
        return comments;
      }
      return [];
    } catch (_) {
      bool isSystem = false;
      for (var prefix in systemPrefixes) {
        if (notes.trim().startsWith(prefix)) {
          isSystem = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      return isSystem || notes.trim().isEmpty ? [] : [notes.trim()];
    }
  }

  Future<void> _moveToDraft() async {
    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
        title: Text(
          'Kembalikan ke Draft?',
          style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
        ),
        content: Text(
          'Apakah Anda yakin ingin menarik kembali kasbon ini ke status Draft untuk melakukan perbaikan?',
          style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
            child: const Text('Batal'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            child: const Text('Ya, Kembalikan ke Draft'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
    if (confirm != true || !mounted) return;
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final success = await prov.moveAdvanceToDraft(widget.advanceId);
    if (!mounted) return;
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(
        content: Text(
          success ? 'Kasbon ditarik ke draft ✓' : (prov.error ?? 'Gagal'),
        ),
        backgroundColor: success ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.danger,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _approveItem(int itemId) async {
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final success = await prov.approveAdvanceItem(itemId, 'approve');
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (success) {
      prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
    } else {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal approve item'),
          backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:async';

class ApiService {
  static const String _configuredBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
    'API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: '',
  );
  static const String _baseUrlPrefsKey = 'api_base_url';
  static String? _runtimeBaseUrl;

  static const Duration _requestTimeout = Duration(seconds: 10);
  static const int _maxRetries = 1;

  /// Helper untuk build URL dengan query parameters menggunakan StringBuffer
  static String _buildUrl(String baseUrl, List<String> params) {
    if (params.isEmpty) return baseUrl;
    final buffer = StringBuffer(baseUrl);
    buffer.write('?');
    buffer.write(params.join('&'));
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  /// Helper untuk retry request jika terjadi connection reset
  static Future<http.Response> _retryRequest(
    Future<http.Response> Function() requestFn,
  ) async {
    int attempts = 0;
    Exception lastException = Exception('Unknown error');

    while (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
      try {
        return await requestFn().timeout(_requestTimeout);
      } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Connection error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on TimeoutException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Request timeout: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on HttpException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('HTTP error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on SocketException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Network error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Unexpected error: $e');
        rethrow;
      }

      if (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
        await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: 500 * attempts));
      }
    }

    throw lastException;
  }

  static String get baseUrl {
    if (_configuredBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      return _configuredBaseUrl;

    if (_runtimeBaseUrl != null && _runtimeBaseUrl!.isNotEmpty) {

    if (_configuredBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {

    }
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();

  static Future<void> saveBaseUrl(String url) async {
    if (_configuredBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    final normalized = url.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'/$'), '');
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      _runtimeBaseUrl = null;
      await prefs.remove(_baseUrlPrefsKey);
      return;
    }
    _runtimeBaseUrl = normalized;
    await prefs.setString(_baseUrlPrefsKey, normalized);
    debugPrint('API Base URL updated to: $normalized');
  }

        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> approveDisbursementAdvance(int advanceId) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveReturnSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnSource,
    String? returnDescription,
    List<File>? returnEvidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/save-return'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnSource != null && returnSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_source'] = returnSource.trim();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null && returnDescription.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription.trim();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (returnEvidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in returnEvidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'return_evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> finalApproveAdvance(
    int id, {
    required int bankId,
    double adminFee = 0.0,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnDescription,
    String? disbursementDescription,
    DateTime? disbursementDate,
    DateTime? returnDate,
    List<String>? evidencePaths,
    List<String>? returnEvidencePaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementPaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementFilenames,
    List<String>? existingReturnPaths,
    List<String>? existingReturnFilenames,
  }) async {
    var request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$id/final_approve'),
    );
    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);

    request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDescription != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_description'] = disbursementDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDate != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_date'] = disbursementDate.toIso8601String();
    }
    if (returnDate != null) {
      request.fields['return_date'] = returnDate.toIso8601String();
    }

    if (existingDisbursementPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingDisbursementFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementFilenames,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnFilenames,
      );
    }

    if (evidencePaths != null && evidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in evidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    if (returnEvidencePaths != null && returnEvidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in returnEvidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  // helpers

  Map<String, dynamic> _handleResponse(http.Response res) {
    if (res.statusCode == 429) {
      String msg = 'Terlalu banyak permintaan. Mohon tunggu sebentar.';
      try {
        final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
        msg = body['error'] ?? body['message'] ?? msg;
      } catch (_) {}
      throw Exception(msg);
    }

    if (res.statusCode == 413) {
      throw Exception('File terlalu besar (Maks 16MB)');
    }

    // Handle 401 Unauthorized - token expired
    if (res.statusCode == 401) {
      throw Exception('Sesi expired. Silakan login kembali.');
    }

    // Handle empty body
    if (res.body.trim().isEmpty) {
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return {};
      }
      throw Exception('Server Error: ${res.statusCode}');
    }

    try {
      final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return body;
      }
      throw Exception(body['error'] ?? 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${res.statusCode}');
    } on FormatException {
      throw Exception('Server Error ${res.statusCode}: Respon tidak valid');
    }
  }

  String _networkHint(String message) {
    if (!kIsWeb && Platform.isAndroid) {
      if (_configuredBaseUrl.isEmpty) {
        return '$message. Pastikan: (1) Backend Flask running, (2) HP & PC di WiFi yang sama, (3) IP address benar';
      }
      return '$message. Periksa: (1) Flask backend aktif, (2) WiFi sama, (3) Firewall tidak blokir port 5000';
    }
    return '$message. Periksa backend aktif di $baseUrl';
  }
}

class ApiService {
  static const String _configuredBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(

    defaultValue: '',
  );

  static const Duration _requestTimeout = Duration(seconds: 10);
  static const int _maxRetries = 1;

  /// Helper untuk build URL dengan query parameters menggunakan StringBuffer
  static String _buildUrl(String baseUrl, List<String> params) {
    if (params.isEmpty) return baseUrl;
    final buffer = StringBuffer(baseUrl);
    buffer.write('?');
    buffer.write(params.join('&'));
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  /// Helper untuk retry request jika terjadi connection reset
  static Future<http.Response> _retryRequest(
    Future<http.Response> Function() requestFn,
  ) async {
    int attempts = 0;
    Exception lastException = Exception('Unknown error');

    while (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
      try {
        return await requestFn().timeout(_requestTimeout);
      } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Connection error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on TimeoutException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Request timeout: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on HttpException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('HTTP error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on SocketException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Network error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Unexpected error: $e');
        rethrow;
      }

      if (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
        await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: 500 * attempts));
      }
    }

    throw lastException;
  }

    List<String>? existingDisbursementPaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementFilenames,
    List<String>? existingReturnPaths,
    List<String>? existingReturnFilenames,
  }) async {
    var request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$id/final_approve'),
    );
    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);

    request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDescription != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_description'] = disbursementDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDate != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_date'] = disbursementDate.toIso8601String();
    }
    if (returnDate != null) {
      request.fields['return_date'] = returnDate.toIso8601String();
    }

    if (existingDisbursementPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingDisbursementFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementFilenames,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnFilenames,
      );
    }

    if (evidencePaths != null && evidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in evidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    if (returnEvidencePaths != null && returnEvidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in returnEvidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> approveDisbursementAdvance(int advanceId) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

  // Settlement versions
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveReturnSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnSource,
    String? returnDescription,
    List<File>? returnEvidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();

      'POST',

    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnSource != null && returnSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_source'] = returnSource.trim();

    if (returnDescription != null && returnDescription.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription.trim();

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {

    if (existingFileNames != null) {

    if (returnEvidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in returnEvidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'return_evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }
