  // helpers

  Map<String, dynamic> _handleResponse(http.Response res) {
    if (res.statusCode == 429) {
      String msg = 'Terlalu banyak permintaan. Mohon tunggu sebentar.';
      try {
        final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
        msg = body['error'] ?? body['message'] ?? msg;
      } catch (_) {}
      throw Exception(msg);
    }

    if (res.statusCode == 413) {
      throw Exception('File terlalu besar (Maks 16MB)');
    }

    // Handle 401 Unauthorized - token expired
    if (res.statusCode == 401) {
      throw Exception('Sesi expired. Silakan login kembali.');
    }

    // Handle empty body
    if (res.body.trim().isEmpty) {
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return {};
      }
      throw Exception('Server Error: ${res.statusCode}');
    }

    try {
      final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return body;
      }
      throw Exception(body['error'] ?? 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${res.statusCode}');
    } on FormatException {
      throw Exception('Server Error ${res.statusCode}: Respon tidak valid');
    }
  }

  String _networkHint(String message) {
    if (!kIsWeb && Platform.isAndroid) {
      if (_configuredBaseUrl.isEmpty) {
        return '$message. Pastikan: (1) Backend Flask running, (2) HP & PC di WiFi yang sama, (3) IP address benar';
      }
      return '$message. Periksa: (1) Flask backend aktif, (2) WiFi sama, (3) Firewall tidak blokir port 5000';
    }
    return '$message. Periksa backend aktif di $baseUrl';
  }
}

  static const Duration _requestTimeout = Duration(seconds: 10);
  static const int _maxRetries = 1;

  /// Helper untuk build URL dengan query parameters menggunakan StringBuffer
  static String _buildUrl(String baseUrl, List<String> params) {
    if (params.isEmpty) return baseUrl;
    final buffer = StringBuffer(baseUrl);
    buffer.write('?');
    buffer.write(params.join('&'));
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  /// Helper untuk retry request jika terjadi connection reset
  static Future<http.Response> _retryRequest(
    Future<http.Response> Function() requestFn,
  ) async {
    int attempts = 0;
    Exception lastException = Exception('Unknown error');

    while (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
      try {
        return await requestFn().timeout(_requestTimeout);
      } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Connection error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on TimeoutException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Request timeout: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on HttpException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('HTTP error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on SocketException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Network error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Unexpected error: $e');
        rethrow;
      }

      if (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
        await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: 500 * attempts));
      }
    }

    throw lastException;
  }

    int bankId, {
    double adminFee = 0.0,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnDescription,
    String? disbursementDescription,
    DateTime? disbursementDate,
    DateTime? returnDate,
    List<String>? evidencePaths,
    List<String>? returnEvidencePaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementPaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementFilenames,
    List<String>? existingReturnPaths,
    List<String>? existingReturnFilenames,
  }) async {
    var request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$id/final_approve'),
    );
    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);

    request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDescription != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_description'] = disbursementDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDate != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_date'] = disbursementDate.toIso8601String();
    }
    if (returnDate != null) {
      request.fields['return_date'] = returnDate.toIso8601String();
    }

    if (existingDisbursementPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingDisbursementFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementFilenames,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnFilenames,
      );
    }

    if (evidencePaths != null && evidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in evidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    if (returnEvidencePaths != null && returnEvidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in returnEvidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    String? disbursementComment,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> approveDisbursementAdvance(int advanceId) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveReturnAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnSource,
    String? returnDescription,
    List<File>? returnEvidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-return'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnSource != null && returnSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_source'] = returnSource.trim();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null && returnDescription.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription.trim();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (returnEvidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in returnEvidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'return_evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

  // Settlement versions
  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> finalApproveAdvance(
    int id, {
    required int bankId,
    double adminFee = 0.0,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnDescription,
    String? disbursementDescription,
    DateTime? disbursementDate,
    DateTime? returnDate,
    List<String>? evidencePaths,
    List<String>? returnEvidencePaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementPaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementFilenames,
    List<String>? existingReturnPaths,
    List<String>? existingReturnFilenames,
  }) async {
    var request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$id/final_approve'),
    );
    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);

    request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDescription != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_description'] = disbursementDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDate != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_date'] = disbursementDate.toIso8601String();
    }
    if (returnDate != null) {
      request.fields['return_date'] = returnDate.toIso8601String();
    }

    if (existingDisbursementPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingDisbursementFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementFilenames,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnFilenames,
      );
    }

    if (evidencePaths != null && evidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in evidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    if (returnEvidencePaths != null && returnEvidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in returnEvidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

    if (mode != null) params.add('mode=$mode');

  // helpers

  Map<String, dynamic> _handleResponse(http.Response res) {
    if (res.statusCode == 429) {
      String msg = 'Terlalu banyak permintaan. Mohon tunggu sebentar.';
      try {
        final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
        msg = body['error'] ?? body['message'] ?? msg;
      } catch (_) {}
      throw Exception(msg);
    }

    if (res.statusCode == 413) {
      throw Exception('File terlalu besar (Maks 16MB)');
    }

    // Handle 401 Unauthorized - token expired
    if (res.statusCode == 401) {
      throw Exception('Sesi expired. Silakan login kembali.');
    }

    // Handle empty body
    if (res.body.trim().isEmpty) {
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return {};
      }
      throw Exception('Server Error: ${res.statusCode}');
    }

    try {
      final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return body;
      }
      throw Exception(body['error'] ?? 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${res.statusCode}');
    } on FormatException {
      throw Exception('Server Error ${res.statusCode}: Respon tidak valid');
    }
  }

  String _networkHint(String message) {
    if (!kIsWeb && Platform.isAndroid) {
      if (_configuredBaseUrl.isEmpty) {
        return '$message. Pastikan: (1) Backend Flask running, (2) HP & PC di WiFi yang sama, (3) IP address benar';
      }
      return '$message. Periksa: (1) Flask backend aktif, (2) WiFi sama, (3) Firewall tidak blokir port 5000';
    }
    return '$message. Periksa backend aktif di $baseUrl';
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

class ApiService {
  static const String _configuredBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
    'API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: '',
  );
  static const String _baseUrlPrefsKey = 'api_base_url';
  static String? _runtimeBaseUrl;

  static const Duration _requestTimeout = Duration(seconds: 10);
  static const int _maxRetries = 1;

  /// Helper untuk build URL dengan query parameters menggunakan StringBuffer
  static String _buildUrl(String baseUrl, List<String> params) {
    if (params.isEmpty) return baseUrl;
    final buffer = StringBuffer(baseUrl);
    buffer.write('?');
    buffer.write(params.join('&'));
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  /// Helper untuk retry request jika terjadi connection reset
  static Future<http.Response> _retryRequest(
    Future<http.Response> Function() requestFn,
  ) async {
    int attempts = 0;
    Exception lastException = Exception('Unknown error');

    while (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
      try {
        return await requestFn().timeout(_requestTimeout);
      } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Connection error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on TimeoutException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Request timeout: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on HttpException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('HTTP error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on SocketException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Network error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Unexpected error: $e');
        rethrow;
      }

      if (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
        await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: 500 * attempts));
      }
    }

    throw lastException;
  }

  static String get baseUrl {
    if (_configuredBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      return _configuredBaseUrl;
    }
    if (_runtimeBaseUrl != null && _runtimeBaseUrl!.isNotEmpty) {
      return _runtimeBaseUrl!;
    }
    if (kIsWeb) {
      return 'http://localhost:5000/api';
    }
    if (Platform.isAndroid) {
      // Untuk HP Android fisik, gunakan IP jaringan lokal
      return 'http://10.42.57.67:5000/api';
    }
    return 'http://localhost:5000/api';
  }

  static Future<void> loadSavedBaseUrl() async {
    if (_configuredBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {

    }
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    _runtimeBaseUrl = prefs.getString(_baseUrlPrefsKey);
  }

  static Future<void> saveBaseUrl(String url) async {
    if (_configuredBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      return;
    }
    final normalized = url.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'/$'), '');
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      _runtimeBaseUrl = null;
      await prefs.remove(_baseUrlPrefsKey);
      return;
    }
    _runtimeBaseUrl = normalized;
    await prefs.setString(_baseUrlPrefsKey, normalized);
    debugPrint('API Base URL updated to: $normalized');

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    String? disbursementComment,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (disbursementComment != null &&
        disbursementComment.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_comment'] = disbursementComment.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> approveDisbursementAdvance(int advanceId) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> finalApproveAdvance(
    int id, {
    required int bankId,
    double adminFee = 0.0,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnDescription,
    String? disbursementDescription,
    DateTime? disbursementDate,
    DateTime? returnDate,
    List<String>? evidencePaths,
    List<String>? returnEvidencePaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementPaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementFilenames,
    List<String>? existingReturnPaths,
    List<String>? existingReturnFilenames,
  }) async {
    var request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$id/final_approve'),
    );
    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);

    request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDescription != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_description'] = disbursementDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDate != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_date'] = disbursementDate.toIso8601String();
    }
    if (returnDate != null) {
      request.fields['return_date'] = returnDate.toIso8601String();
    }

    if (existingDisbursementPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingDisbursementFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementFilenames,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnFilenames,
      );
    }

    if (evidencePaths != null && evidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in evidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    if (returnEvidencePaths != null && returnEvidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in returnEvidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  // helpers

  Map<String, dynamic> _handleResponse(http.Response res) {
    if (res.statusCode == 429) {
      String msg = 'Terlalu banyak permintaan. Mohon tunggu sebentar.';
      try {
        final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
        msg = body['error'] ?? body['message'] ?? msg;
      } catch (_) {}
      throw Exception(msg);
    }

    if (res.statusCode == 413) {
      throw Exception('File terlalu besar (Maks 16MB)');
    }

    // Handle 401 Unauthorized - token expired
    if (res.statusCode == 401) {
      throw Exception('Sesi expired. Silakan login kembali.');
    }

    // Handle empty body
    if (res.body.trim().isEmpty) {
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return {};
      }
      throw Exception('Server Error: ${res.statusCode}');
    }

    try {
      final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return body;
      }
      throw Exception(body['error'] ?? 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${res.statusCode}');
    } on FormatException {
      throw Exception('Server Error ${res.statusCode}: Respon tidak valid');
    }
  }

  String _networkHint(String message) {
    if (!kIsWeb && Platform.isAndroid) {
      if (_configuredBaseUrl.isEmpty) {
        return '$message. Pastikan: (1) Backend Flask running, (2) HP & PC di WiFi yang sama, (3) IP address benar';
      }
      return '$message. Periksa: (1) Flask backend aktif, (2) WiFi sama, (3) Firewall tidak blokir port 5000';
    }
    return '$message. Periksa backend aktif di $baseUrl';
  }

  String? _error;
  bool _unsavedDraft = false; // Flag untuk track draft yang belum tersimpan

  String? _statusFilter;
  int _reportYear = DateTime.now().year;
  String _filterMode = 'report'; // 'report' or 'actual'
  String? _startDate;
  String? _endDate;
  String? _searchQuery;
  int? _filterYear; // Local filter year for list
  String _filterYearMode = 'report'; // Local filter mode for list
  bool _initialized =
      false; // ✅ Flag untuk track apakah sudah di-init dengan year dari settings

  // ✅ Sync report year from settings on init
  SettlementProvider() {
    // Load default year from settings (not from DateTime.now())
    // Use addPostFrameCallback or call syncReportYear explicitly before first load
    syncReportYear();
  }

  // ✅ Initialize with default year, will be overwritten by syncReportYear
  void initialize() {
    syncReportYear();
  }

  // ✅ Check if provider is initialized
  bool get isInitialized => _initialized;

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get settlements => _settlements;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get categories => _categories;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get pendingCategories => _pendingCategories;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get banks => _banks;
  Map<String, dynamic>? get currentSettlement => _currentSettlement;
  bool get unsavedDraft => _unsavedDraft;
  bool get loading => _loading;
  String? get error => _error;
  int get reportYear => _reportYear;
  int get filterYear => _filterYear ?? _reportYear;
  String get filterYearMode => _filterYearMode;
  String get filterMode => _filterMode;

  String? get statusFilter => _statusFilter;
  String? get startDate => _startDate;
  String? get endDate => _endDate;
  String? get searchQuery => _searchQuery;

  // rapikan kategori untuk dropdown
  // parent dengan child jadi header
  // parent tanpa child tetap bisa dipilih
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get flatCategories {
    final flat = <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    for (final cat in _categories) {
      final children = cat['children'] as List? ?? [];
      if (children.isNotEmpty) {
        // parent hanya jadi header
        flat.add({...cat, '_isHeader': true});
        for (final child in children) {
          flat.add({
            ...child,
            'name': '  └ ${child['name']}',
            '_isHeader': false,
            'status': child['status'], // pastikan status terbawa
          });
        }
      } else {
        flat.add({...cat, '_isHeader': false});
      }
    }
    return flat;
  }

  bool _disposed = false;
  bool get disposed => _disposed;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    super.dispose();
  }

  void updateToken(String? token) {
    _api.setToken(token);
    if (token == null) {
      clearData();
    }
  }

  void clearData() {
    _settlements = [];
    _currentSettlement = null;
    _loading = false;
    _error = null;
    _unsavedDraft = false;
    _initialized = false;
    _categories = [];
    _pendingCategories = [];
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> loadSettlements({
    String? status,
    String? startDate,
    String? endDate,
    String? type,
    int? reportYear,
    String? mode,
    String? search,
    bool notify = true,
  }) async {
    // ✅ SKIP load if not initialized yet (waiting for syncReportYear)
    // This prevents flash of old data before settings year is loaded
    if (!_initialized && reportYear == null) {
      // Don't load with default year, wait for syncReportYear to complete
      return;
    }

    // Set filters
    _statusFilter = status;
    _startDate = startDate;
    _endDate = endDate;

    if (reportYear != null) {
      _filterYear = reportYear;
    }
    if (mode != null) {
      _filterYearMode = mode;
    }

    // ✅ Centralized Sanitization
    _searchQuery = search
        ?.replaceAll('<', '')
        .replaceAll('>', '')
        .replaceAll('"', '')
        .replaceAll("'", '')
        .replaceAll('&', '')
        .replaceAll(';', '')
        .trim();

    _loading = true;
    if (notify) notifyListeners();
    _error = null;

    try {
      final data = await _api.getSettlements(
        status: _statusFilter,
        startDate: _startDate,
        endDate: _endDate,
        type: type,
        reportYear: _filterYear ?? _reportYear,
        mode: _filterYearMode,
        search: _searchQuery,
      );

      _settlements = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(data['settlements']);
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
    }

    _loading = false;
    if (notify) notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    _statusFilter = null;
    _startDate = null;
    _endDate = null;
    // ✅ Don't reset to DateTime.now().year, keep the synced year from settings
    // _reportYear = DateTime.now().year;  // ❌ REMOVED
    _searchQuery = null;
    loadSettlements();
  }

  Future<void> loadSettlement(int id, {bool notify = true}) async {
    _loading = true;
    if (notify) notifyListeners();
    _error = null;

    try {
      final res = await _api.getSettlement(id);
      _currentSettlement = res['settlement'];
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
    }

    _loading = false;
    if (notify) notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> syncReportYear({bool force = false}) async {
    // ✅ Sticky Session Logic: Don't overwrite if already initialized in this session
    if (_initialized && !force) return;

    try {
      final res = await _api.getReportYearSettings();
      final dynamic rawYear = res['default_report_year'];
      final year = int.tryParse((rawYear ?? 0).toString());

      if (year != null && year != 0) {
        _reportYear = year;
      } else {
        _reportYear = DateTime.now().year;
      }
      _filterMode = 'report'; // ✅ Default to report mode from settings
      _filterYear = _reportYear;
      _filterYearMode = 'report';
      _initialized = true;
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (_) {
      // If fails, still mark as initialized to prevent constant retries
      _initialized = true;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void setReportYear(int year, {String? mode, bool reload = true}) {
    _reportYear = year;
    // When global report year changes, we also update filterYear and mode to keep everything in sync by default
    _filterYear = year;
    if (mode != null) {
      _filterMode = mode;
      _filterYearMode = mode;
    }
    if (reload) {
      loadSettlements();
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setFilterYear(int year, String mode, {bool reload = true}) {
    _filterYear = year;
    _filterYearMode = mode;
    if (reload) loadSettlements();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setFilterMode(String mode, {bool reload = true}) {
    if (_filterMode == mode) return;
    _filterMode = mode;
    if (reload) {
      loadSettlements();
    }
    notifyListeners();
  }

    try {

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>?> createSettlement(
    String title,
    String description, {
    int? advanceId,
    String settlementType = 'single',
    int? reportYear,
  }) async {
    _loading = true;
    _error = null;
    notifyListeners();
    try {
      final res = await _api.createSettlement(
        title,
        description,
        advanceId: advanceId,
        settlementType: settlementType,
        reportYear: reportYear,
      );

      final newSettlement = res['settlement'];
      _currentSettlement = newSettlement;
      _unsavedDraft = true; // Mark as unsaved draft until first expense

      _loading = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return newSettlement;
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
      _loading = false;
      notifyListeners();
      return null;
    }
  }

  /// Save expense pertama sekaligus commit settlement ke list
  /// Ini adalah trigger utama untuk auto-save Settlement
  Future<bool> saveFirstExpenseAndCommitSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    required int categoryId,
    List<int>? categoryIds,
    required String description,
    required double amount,
    required String date,
    String? source,
    String currency = 'IDR',
    double currencyExchange = 1,
    List<String>? filePaths,
  }) async {
    try {
      // Save expense pertama
      await _api.createExpense(
        settlementId: settlementId,
        categoryId: categoryId,
        categoryIds: categoryIds,
        description: description,
        amount: amount,
        date: date,
        source: source,
        currency: currency,
        currencyExchange: currencyExchange,
        filePaths: filePaths,
      );

      // Commit settlement ke list dengan reload
      await loadSettlement(settlementId);
      await loadSettlements(
        status: _statusFilter,
        startDate: _startDate,
        endDate: _endDate,
        reportYear: _reportYear,
        search: _searchQuery,
      );
      _unsavedDraft = false;
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
      notifyListeners();
      return false;
    }
  }

  /// Cleanup - delete draft yang tidak ada expense
  Future<void> cleanupEmptyDraft(int settlementId) async {
    if (!_unsavedDraft) return;

    try {
      await deleteSettlement(settlementId, reload: true);
      _unsavedDraft = false;
    } catch (e) {
      // Ignore error, just mark as not unsaved
      _unsavedDraft = false;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  Future<bool> approveExpense(
    int expenseId,
    String action, {
    String notes = '',
  }) async {
    try {
      // Preserve existing notes if approving and no new notes provided
      String finalNotes = notes;
      if (action == 'approve' &&
          finalNotes.isEmpty &&
          _currentSettlement != null) {
        final expenses = _currentSettlement!['expenses'] as List? ?? [];
        final existing = expenses.firstWhere(
          (e) => e['id'] == expenseId,
          orElse: () => null,
        );
        if (existing != null && existing['notes'] != null) {
          finalNotes = existing['notes'].toString();
        }
      }

      await _api.approveExpense(expenseId, action, notes: finalNotes);
      if (_currentSettlement != null) {
        await loadSettlement(_currentSettlement!['id']);
      }
      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
      notifyListeners();
      return false;
    }
  }

import 'dart:io';

import '../services/api_service.dart';

class AdvanceProvider extends ChangeNotifier {
  final ApiService _api = ApiService();

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _advances = [];
  Map<String, dynamic>? _currentAdvance;
  bool _loading = false;
  String? _error;
  bool _unsavedDraft = false;
  bool _initialized = false;
  int _reportYear = DateTime.now().year;
  String _filterMode = 'report'; // 'report' or 'actual'
  int? _filterYear; // Local filter year for list
  String _filterYearMode = 'report'; // Local filter mode for list

  AdvanceProvider() {
    syncReportYear();
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get advances => _advances;
  Map<String, dynamic>? get currentAdvance => _currentAdvance;
  bool get unsavedDraft => _unsavedDraft;
  List<Map<String, dynamic>> get availableAdvances => _advances
      .where((a) => a['status'] == 'approved' && a['settlement_id'] == null)
      .toList();
  bool get loading => _loading;
  String? get error => _error;
  int get reportYear => _reportYear;
  int get filterYear => _filterYear ?? _reportYear;
  String get filterYearMode => _filterYearMode;
  String get filterMode => _filterMode;
  bool get isInitialized => _initialized;

  void setFilterMode(String mode, {bool reload = true}) {
    if (_filterMode == mode) return;
    _filterMode = mode;
    notifyListeners();
    if (reload) loadAdvances();
  }

  void updateToken(String? token) {
    _api.setToken(token);
    if (token == null) {
      clearData();
    }
  }

  void clearData() {
    _advances = [];
    _currentAdvance = null;
    _loading = false;
    _error = null;
    _unsavedDraft = false;
    _initialized = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> loadAdvances({
    String? status,
    String? startDate,
    String? endDate,
    int? reportYear,
    String? mode,
    String? type,
    String? search,
  }) async {
    if (!_initialized && reportYear == null) return;

    if (reportYear != null) _filterYear = reportYear;
    if (mode != null) _filterYearMode = mode;
    final yearToUse = (_filterYear ?? _reportYear) == 0 ? null : (_filterYear ?? _reportYear);

    // ✅ Centralized Sanitization
    final cleanSearch = search
        ?.replaceAll('<', '')
        .replaceAll('>', '')
        .replaceAll('"', '')
        .replaceAll("'", '')
        .replaceAll('&', '')
        .replaceAll(';', '')
        .trim();

    _loading = true;
    _error = null;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final res = await _api.getAdvances(
        status: status,
        startDate: startDate,
        endDate: endDate,
        reportYear: yearToUse,
        mode: _filterYearMode,
        type: type,
        search: cleanSearch,
      );
      _advances = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(res['advances']);
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
    }

    _loading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void clearFilters() {
    loadAdvances();
  }

  Future<void> syncReportYear({bool force = false}) async {
    if (_initialized && !force) return;

    try {
      final res = await _api.getReportYearSettings();
      final dynamic rawYear = res['default_report_year'];
      final year = int.tryParse((rawYear ?? 0).toString());

      if (year != null && year != 0) {
        _reportYear = year;
      } else {
        _reportYear = DateTime.now().year;
      }
      _filterMode = 'report'; // ✅ Default to report mode
      _filterYear = _reportYear;
      _filterYearMode = 'report';
      _initialized = true;
      notifyListeners();
    } catch (_) {
      _initialized = true;
      notifyListeners();
    }
  }

  void setReportYear(int year, {String? mode, bool reload = true}) {
    _reportYear = year;
    // When global report year changes, we also update filterYear and mode to keep everything in sync by default
    _filterYear = year;
    if (mode != null) {
      _filterMode = mode;
      _filterYearMode = mode;
    }
    if (reload) loadAdvances();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void setFilterYear(int year, String mode, {bool reload = true}) {
    _filterYear = year;
    _filterYearMode = mode;
    if (reload) loadAdvances();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<void> loadAdvance(int id) async {
    _loading = true;
    _error = null;
    notifyListeners();

    try {
      final res = await _api.getAdvance(id);
      _currentAdvance = res['advance'];
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
    }

    _loading = false;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  Future<bool> approveAdvanceItem(
    int itemId,
    String action, {
    String notes = '',
  }) async {
    try {
      // Preserve existing notes if approving and no new notes provided
      String finalNotes = notes;
      if (action == 'approve' &&
          finalNotes.isEmpty &&
          _currentAdvance != null) {
        final items = _currentAdvance!['items'] as List? ?? [];
        final existing = items.firstWhere(
          (e) => e['id'] == itemId,
          orElse: () => null,
        );
        if (existing != null && existing['notes'] != null) {
          finalNotes = existing['notes'].toString();
        }
      }

      await _api.approveAdvanceItem(itemId, action, notes: finalNotes);

      // Reload current advance to sync state
      if (_currentAdvance != null) {
        await loadAdvance(_currentAdvance!['id']);
      }

      return true;
    } catch (e) {
      _error = e.toString().replaceAll('Exception: ', '');
      notifyListeners();
      return false;
    }
  }

  List<String> _getCommentsFromNotes(String notes) {
    if (notes.isEmpty) return [];

    final systemPrefixes = [
      'Disetujui oleh',
      'Imported from',
      'Subcategory:',
      'Approved by',
      'System:',
    ];

    try {
      final decoded = json.decode(notes);
      if (decoded is List) {
        final List<String> comments = [];
        for (var item in decoded) {
          final text = (item is Map ? item['text'] : item).toString();

          bool isSystem = false;
          for (var prefix in systemPrefixes) {
            if (text.trim().startsWith(prefix)) {
              isSystem = true;
              break;
            }
          }

          if (!isSystem && text.trim().isNotEmpty) {
            comments.add(text.trim());
          }
        }
        return comments;
      }
      return [];
    } catch (_) {
      bool isSystem = false;
      for (var prefix in systemPrefixes) {
        if (notes.trim().startsWith(prefix)) {
          isSystem = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      return isSystem || notes.trim().isEmpty ? [] : [notes.trim()];
    }
  }

  Future<void> _handleNotificationTap(String? rawPath) async {
    if (!mounted || rawPath == null || rawPath.trim().isEmpty) return;
    final path = rawPath.trim().toLowerCase();

    // Extract ID from path
    final parts = path.split('/');
    int? id;
    for (int i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      final value = int.tryParse(parts[i]);
      if (value != null) {
        id = value;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Navigate based on path
    if (path.contains('/settlements') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to settlement detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => SettlementDetailScreen(settlementId: id!),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/advances') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to advance detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AdvanceDetailScreen(advanceId: id!)),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/categories')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard categories tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 3},
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/reports')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard reports tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 2},
        );
      }
      return;
    }
  }

      case 'approved':

      case 'completed':

      default:
        return AppTheme.textSecondary;
    }
  }

  double _toDouble(dynamic value) {
    if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
    if (value == null) return 0.0;
    String str = value.toString().trim();
    if (str.isEmpty) return 0.0;

    // Handle Indonesian format: 1.234.567,89 -> 1234567.89
    // Or our new formatter output: 1.234.567.89 -> 1234567.89

    int dots = '.'.allMatches(str).length;
    int commas = ','.allMatches(str).length;

    if (dots > 1) {
      // Multiple dots. In our project, the last one is likely the decimal separator
      // added by our new formatter, OR they are all thousands separators.
      // If there's a comma, the comma is definitely the decimal.
      if (commas == 1) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        // Check if the last dot looks like a decimal (not followed by exactly 3 digits, or only 1-2 digits)
        int lastDotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (str.length - lastDotIdx != 4) {
           // Last dot is decimal
           String integerPart = str.substring(0, lastDotIdx).replaceAll('.', '');
           String decimalPart = str.substring(lastDotIdx + 1);
           str = "$integerPart.$decimalPart";
        } else {
           // All dots are thousands
           str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
        }
      }
    } else if (dots == 1 && commas == 1) {
      int dotIdx = str.indexOf('.');
      int commaIdx = str.indexOf(',');
      if (dotIdx < commaIdx) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
      }
    } else if (commas > 1) {
      str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
    } else if (dots == 1) {
      // Single dot.
      int dotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
      // If exactly 3 digits follow and it's not the ONLY digits, it might be thousands.
      if (str.length - dotIdx == 4 && str.length > 4) {
        // Likely thousands, e.g., 1.234 or 10.234
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
      }
    } else if (commas == 1) {
      str = str.replaceFirst(',', '.');
    }

    return double.tryParse(str) ??
           double.tryParse(str.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d.]'), '')) ?? 0.0;
  }

  String _formatExpenseAmount(Map<String, dynamic> expense) {
    final currency = (expense['currency'] ?? 'IDR').toString().toUpperCase();
    final amount = _toDouble(expense['amount']);
    final kurs = _toDouble(expense['currency_exchange']);
    final idrAmount = _toDouble(expense['idr_amount']) > 0
        ? _toDouble(expense['idr_amount'])
        : (amount * (kurs > 0 ? kurs : 1.0));

    if (currency == 'IDR') {
      return 'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(amount)}';
    }

    return '$currency ${_foreignCurrencyFormat.format(amount)}\n(Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(idrAmount)})';
  }

  String _displaySettlementStatus(Map<String, dynamic>? s) {
    if (s == null) return 'draft';
    final status = (s['status'] ?? 'draft').toString().toLowerCase();
    final returnStatus = (s['return_status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final expenses = _asMapList(s['expenses']);
    final hasRejectedExpense = expenses.any((e) => (e['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'rejected');

    if (status == 'submitted' && (returnStatus == 'rejected' || hasRejectedExpense)) {
      return 'revision';
    }
    return status == 'completed' ? 'approved' : status;
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _approvedSettlementExpenses(
    Map<String, dynamic> settlement,
  ) {
    final expenses = _asMapList(settlement['expenses']);
    return expenses.where((expense) {
      final status = (expense['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      return status == 'approved' || status == 'completed';
    }).toList();
  }

  String _expenseFundSource(Map<String, dynamic> expense) {
    for (final key in const [
      'source_bank_name',
      'source_bank',
      'bank_name',
      'bank',
      'source',
    ]) {
      final value = (expense[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty) return value;
    }
    return '-';
  }

  String _settlementDisbursementSourceLabel(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final saved = (settlement['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (saved.isNotEmpty) return saved;
    final approvedExpenses = _approvedSettlementExpenses(settlement);
    if (approvedExpenses.isEmpty) return '-';
    final firstSource = _expenseFundSource(approvedExpenses.first);
    final allSame = approvedExpenses
        .every((expense) => _expenseFundSource(expense) == firstSource);
    return allSame && firstSource.isNotEmpty ? firstSource : '-';
  }

  String _settlementReturnSourceLabel(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final returnSource = (settlement['return_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (returnSource.isNotEmpty) return returnSource;
    final disbursementSource = _settlementDisbursementSourceLabel(settlement);
    return disbursementSource.isNotEmpty ? disbursementSource : '-';
  }

  List<String> _fundSourceOptions(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final options = <String>{};

    void collect(dynamic raw) {
      if (raw is List) {
        for (final item in raw) {
          if (item is Map) {
            final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item);
            for (final key in const ['name', 'bank_name', 'label', 'code']) {
              final value = (map[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
              if (value.isNotEmpty) {
                options.add(value);
                break;
              }
            }
          } else {
            final value = item.toString().trim();
            if (value.isNotEmpty) options.add(value);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    collect(settlement['fund_sources']);
    collect([settlement['disbursement_source'], settlement['return_source']]);

    for (final expense in _approvedSettlementExpenses(settlement)) {
      final source = _expenseFundSource(expense);
      if (source.isNotEmpty) options.add(source);
    }

    final merged = <String>[..._settlementFundSourceChoices];
    for (final option in options) {
      final value = option.trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty &&
          value != '-' &&
          !_settlementFundSourceChoices.contains(value) &&
          !merged.contains(value)) {
        merged.add(value);
      }
    }
    return merged;
  }

  double _settlementReimbursementAmount(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final approvedAmount = _toDouble(settlement['approved_amount']);
    final advanceId = settlement['advance_id'] ?? 0;
    if (advanceId == null || advanceId == 0) return approvedAmount;

    final availableFund = _toDouble(settlement['available_fund']);
    final delta = approvedAmount - availableFund;
    return delta > 0 ? delta : 0;
  }
