                              dateCtrl.text = DateFormat(
                                'yyyy-MM-dd',
                              ).format(d);
                            }
                          },
                        ),
                      ),
                      style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                      readOnly: true,
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 12),
                    // mata uang
                    Row(
                      children: [
                        Expanded(
                          flex: 2,
                          child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Mata Uang',
                            ),
                            dropdownColor: _cardColor(ctx),
                            style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                            initialValue: selectedCurrency,
                            items: const [
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'IDR', child: Text('IDR')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'USD', child: Text('USD')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'EUR', child: Text('EUR')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'GBP', child: Text('GBP')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'JPY', child: Text('JPY')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'CNY', child: Text('CNY')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'AUD', child: Text('AUD')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'HKD', child: Text('HKD')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'SGD', child: Text('SGD')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'TWD', child: Text('TWD')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'THB', child: Text('THB')),
                              DropdownMenuItem(
                                  value: 'MYR', child: Text('MYR')),

                              if (selectedCurrency == 'IDR') {

                        ),

                      onPressed: () async {
                        try {
                          final result = await FilePicker.pickFiles(

                            allowMultiple: true,
                            allowedExtensions: [

                              'jpeg',

                            setDialogState(() {
                              for (var file in result.files) {

                                    !selectedFilePaths.contains(file.path)) {
                                  selectedFilePaths.add(file.path!);
                                  selectedFileNames.add(file.name);

                        } catch (e) {
                          debugPrint('FilePicker Error: $e');
                        }
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.upload_file_rounded),
                      label: Text(
                        selectedFileNames.isEmpty
                            ? 'Upload Bukti (Bisa multiple)'
                            : 'Tambah Bukti Lainnya',
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (selectedFileNames.isNotEmpty)
                      Container(
                        margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                          color: _surfaceColor(ctx),
                          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                          border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(ctx)),
                        ),
                        child: Column(
                          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                          children: [
                            Text(
                              'Terpilih (${selectedFileNames.length}):',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                                fontSize: 10,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                            const SizedBox(height: 4),
                            ...List.generate(selectedFileNames.length, (index) {
                              return Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                  vertical: 2,
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  children: [
                                    const Icon(
                                      Icons.check_circle,
                                      color: AppTheme.success,
                                      size: 14,
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 6),
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Text(
                                        selectedFileNames[index],
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          color: AppTheme.success,
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                        ),
                                        maxLines: 1,
                                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    GestureDetector(
                                      onTap: () {
                                        setDialogState(() {
                                          selectedFilePaths.removeAt(index);
                                          selectedFileNames.removeAt(index);
                                        });
                                      },
                                      child: const Icon(
                                        Icons.cancel,
                                        size: 16,
                                        color: AppTheme.danger,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              );
                            }),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  // validasi berurutan dari atas ke bawah
                  // 1. validasi kategori utama
                  if (selectedParentId == null) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text('Pilih Kategori Utama'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }

                  final parent = allCats.firstWhere(
                    (c) => c['id'] == selectedParentId,
                    orElse: () => {},
                  );
                  final children = (parent['children'] as List?) ?? [];

                  // 2. validasi sub kategori (jika parent punya child)
                  if (children.isNotEmpty && selectedSubCategoryIds.isEmpty) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text('Pilih Sub Kategori'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }

                  // 3. validasi deskripsi
                  if (descCtrl.text.isEmpty) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text('Deskripsi harus diisi'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }

                  final amount = _toDouble(amountCtrl.text);

                  // 5. validasi nominal minimal 100
                  final rateForValidation = _toDouble(exchangeRateCtrl.text);
                  final totalIdrValidation = amount * rateForValidation;

                  if (totalIdrValidation <= 100) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text(
                          'Nominal ekuivalen Rupiah harus lebih dari Rp 100',
                        ),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }

                  try {
                    final firstSubId = selectedSubCategoryIds.isNotEmpty
                        ? selectedSubCategoryIds.first
                        : null;
                    final finalCatId = firstSubId ?? selectedParentId!;
                    final subcatIds = selectedSubCategoryIds.toList();

                    final existingPaths = selectedFilePaths
                        .where((p) => p.startsWith('receipts/'))
                        .toList();
                    final newPaths = selectedFilePaths
                        .where((p) => !p.startsWith('receipts/'))
                        .toList();

                    final existingNames = <String>[];
                    for (var i = 0; i < selectedFilePaths.length; i++) {
                      if (selectedFilePaths[i].startsWith('receipts/')) {
                        if (i < selectedFileNames.length) {
                          existingNames.add(selectedFileNames[i]);
                        } else {
                          existingNames.add(
                            selectedFilePaths[i].split('/').last,
                          );
                        }
                      }
                    }

                    final success = await prov.updateExpense(
                      expenseId: exp['id'],
                      settlementId: widget.settlementId,
                      categoryId: finalCatId,
                      categoryIds: subcatIds,
                      description: descCtrl.text.trim(),
                      amount: amount,
                      date: dateCtrl.text,
                      source: selectedSource,
                      currency: selectedCurrency,
                      currencyExchange: rateForValidation,
                      filePaths: newPaths.isNotEmpty ? newPaths : null,
                      existingFilePaths: existingPaths,
                      existingFileNames: existingNames,
                    );
                    if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    if (success && context.mounted) {
                      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                        const SnackBar(
                          content: Text('Expense diupdate ✓'),
                          backgroundColor: AppTheme.success,
                        ),
                      );
                    }
                  } catch (e) {
                    // error handled by provider
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Simpan'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    // Delayed dispose to prevent "used after disposed" during closing animation
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      descCtrl.dispose();
      amountCtrl.dispose();
      dateCtrl.dispose();
      exchangeRateCtrl.dispose();
    });
  }

  Future<void> _showAddCategoryDialog(
    BuildContext ctx,
    StateSetter setDialogState,
    Function(Map<String, dynamic>) onCreated, {
    int? parentId,
  }) async {
    final nameCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();

    await showDialog(
      context: ctx,
      builder: (innerCtx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _cardColor(innerCtx),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text(
          parentId != null ? 'Tambah Sub Kategori' : 'Tambah Kategori Utama',
          style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(innerCtx)),
        ),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 350,
          child: TextField(
            controller: nameCtrl,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText:
                  parentId != null ? 'Nama Sub Kategori' : 'Nama Kategori',
            ),
            style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
            autofocus: true,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(innerCtx),
            child: const Text('Batal'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () async {
              if (nameCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
              final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
              final success = await prov.createCategory(
                nameCtrl.text.trim(),
                parentId: parentId,
              );
              if (innerCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(innerCtx);
              if (success && mounted) {
                // cari kategori baru untuk callback
                final all = prov.categories;
                Map<String, dynamic> found = {};

                // cari kategori yang baru dibuat
                for (final p in all) {
                  if (parentId == null && p['name'] == nameCtrl.text.trim()) {
                    found = p;
                    break;
                  }
                  if (parentId != null && p['id'] == parentId) {
                    final children = (p['children'] as List?) ?? [];
                    for (final c in children) {
                      if (c['name'] == nameCtrl.text.trim()) {
                        found = c;
                        break;
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }

                onCreated(found);

                messenger.showSnackBar(
                  const SnackBar(
                    content: Text(
                      'Kategori ditambahkan (menunggu approval manager) ✓',
                    ),
                    backgroundColor: AppTheme.success,
                  ),
                );
              }
            },
            child: const Text('Tambah'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    // Delayed dispose
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      nameCtrl.dispose();
    });
  }

  void _showChecklistDialog(
    int expenseId,
    List<dynamic> checklist,
    String settlementStatus,
  ) {
    final normalizedStatus = settlementStatus.toLowerCase();
    // Bisa edit jika status draft atau rejected (setelah revisi)
    final canEdit =
        normalizedStatus == 'draft' || normalizedStatus == 'rejected';

    List<Map<String, dynamic>> localChecklist = _parseChecklist(checklist);

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setModalState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            title: Text(
              'Rejection Checklist${!canEdit ? ' (Lihat saja)' : ''}',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 400,
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 420),
                child: Builder(
                  builder: (ctx2) {
                    final checklistCtrl = ScrollController();
                    return AppScrollbar(
                      controller: checklistCtrl,
                      thumbVisibility: true,
                      interactive: true,
                      child: SingleChildScrollView(
                        controller: checklistCtrl,
                        child: SelectionArea(
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              ...localChecklist.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                                final item = entry.value;
                                return _buildChecklistTile(
                                  item,
                                  canEdit,
                                  setModalState,
                                );
                              }),
                              if (!canEdit &&
                                  (normalizedStatus == 'submitted' ||
                                      normalizedStatus == 'revision_submitted'))
                                Container(
                                  margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
                                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                    horizontal: 12,
                                    vertical: 8,
                                  ),
                                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                    color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(
                                      alpha: 0.1,
                                    ),
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                    border: Border.all(
                                      color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(
                                        alpha: 0.3,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                  child: Row(
                                    children: [
                                      const Icon(
                                        Icons.info_outline,
                                        size: 16,
                                        color: AppTheme.warning,
                                      ),
                                      const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                      const Expanded(
                                        child: Text(
                                          'Settlement disubmit, Move to Draft untuk edit',
                                          style: TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 11,
                                            color: AppTheme.warning,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: Text(
                  'Tutup',
                  style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
                ),
              ),
              if (canEdit)
                _buildSaveChecklistButton(
                  ctx,
                  expenseId,
                  localChecklist,
                  settlementStatus,
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _parseChecklist(dynamic checklist) {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> local = [];
    try {
      dynamic parsed = checklist is String ? jsonDecode(checklist) : checklist;
      if (parsed is List) {
        for (final e in parsed) {
          String text = '';
          bool checked = false;

          if (e is Map) {
            text = (e['text'] ?? '').toString();
            checked = e['checked'] == true;
          } else if (e is String) {
            text = e;
          }

          if (text.isNotEmpty) {
            local.add({'text': text, 'checked': checked});
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return local;
  }

  Widget _buildChecklistTile(
    Map<String, dynamic> item,
    bool canEdit,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    final alreadyChecked = item['checked'] == true;
    return CheckboxListTile(
      value: alreadyChecked,
      onChanged: canEdit
          ? (val) => setModalState(() => item['checked'] = val ?? false)
          : null,
      title: alreadyChecked
          ? SelectionContainer.disabled(
              child: Text(
                item['text'] ?? '',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
                  decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough,
                ),
              ),
            )
          : Text(
              item['text'] ?? '',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(context)),
            ),
      activeColor: AppTheme.success,
      checkColor: Colors.white,
      controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSaveChecklistButton(
    BuildContext dialogCtx,
    int expenseId,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list,
    String settlementStatus,
  ) {
    return ElevatedButton(
      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
      ),
      onPressed: () async {
        bool allFinished = list.every((it) => it['checked'] == true);
        final newStatus = allFinished ? 'pending' : 'rejected';
        final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();

        final success = await prov.updateExpenseData(
          expenseId,
          widget.settlementId,
          {'notes': jsonEncode(list), 'status': newStatus},
        );

        if (success) {
          prov.loadSettlement(widget.settlementId);
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          AppSnackbar.success('Checklist berhasil disimpan ✓');
        } else {
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          AppSnackbar.error('Gagal menyimpan checklist');
        }
      },
      child: const Text('Simpan'),
    );
  }

  Future<List<String>?> _pickReturnEvidence() async {
    try {
      final result = await FilePicker.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowMultiple: true,
        allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'pdf', 'webp'],
      );

      if (result != null && result.files.isNotEmpty) {
        return result.files
            .where((f) => f.path != null)
            .map((f) => f.path!)
            .toList();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Gagal memilih file: $e')));
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  Widget _buildFileList(
    BuildContext context,
    List<String> paths,
    List<String>? filenames,
    bool isLocal,
    Function(int) onRemove,
  ) {
    if (paths.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(context)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            isLocal
                ? 'Terpilih (${paths.length}):'
                : 'File Lama (${paths.length}):',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: _secondaryText(context),
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          ...List.generate(paths.length, (index) {
            final name = (filenames != null && filenames.length > index)
                ? filenames[index]
                : paths[index].split('/').last;
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    isLocal ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.cloud_done,
                    color: isLocal ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.primary,
                    size: 14,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      name,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: isLocal ? AppTheme.success : _primaryText(context),
                        fontSize: 11,
                      ),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () => onRemove(index),
                    child: const Icon(
                      Icons.cancel,
                      size: 16,
                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    Future.microtask(() {
      if (mounted) {
        final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
        prov.loadSettlement(widget.settlementId);
        prov.loadCategories();
        prov.loadBanks(); // Load banks for dialogs
        _fetchBadgeCounts();
      }
    });

  Future<void> _fetchBadgeCounts() async {
    try {
      final api = context.read<AuthProvider>().api;
      final data = await api.getDashboardSummary();
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() {
          _pendingSettlements = data['pending_settlements'] ?? 0;
          _pendingAdvances = data['pending_advances'] ?? 0;
        });
      }
    } catch (_) {}
  }

  Future<void> _handleNotificationTap(String? rawPath) async {
    if (!mounted || rawPath == null || rawPath.trim().isEmpty) return;
    final path = rawPath.trim().toLowerCase();

    // Extract ID from path
    final parts = path.split('/');
    int? id;
    for (int i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      final value = int.tryParse(parts[i]);
      if (value != null) {
        id = value;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Navigate based on path
    if (path.contains('/settlements') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to settlement detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => SettlementDetailScreen(settlementId: id!),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/advances') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to advance detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AdvanceDetailScreen(advanceId: id!)),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/categories')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard categories tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 3},
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/reports')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard reports tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 2},
        );
      }
      return;
    }
  }

  Future<void> _confirmLogout() async {
    final confirmed = await AppDialogs.showExitConfirmation(
      context,
      isLogout: true,
    );
    if (confirmed && mounted) {
      context.read<AuthProvider>().logout();
    }
  }

  Color _statusColor(String status) {
    switch (status) {
      case 'draft':
        return AppTheme.textSecondary;
      case 'submitted':
        return AppTheme.warning;
      case 'approved':
        return AppTheme.success;
      case 'completed':
        return AppTheme.success;
      case 'rejected':
        return AppTheme.danger;
      case 'pending':
        return AppTheme.warning;
      default:
        return AppTheme.textSecondary;
    }
  }

  double _toDouble(dynamic value) {
    if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
    if (value == null) return 0.0;
    String str = value.toString().trim();
    if (str.isEmpty) return 0.0;

    // Handle Indonesian format: 1.234.567,89 -> 1234567.89
    // Or our new formatter output: 1.234.567.89 -> 1234567.89

    int dots = '.'.allMatches(str).length;
    int commas = ','.allMatches(str).length;

    if (dots > 1) {
      // Multiple dots. In our project, the last one is likely the decimal separator
      // added by our new formatter, OR they are all thousands separators.
      // If there's a comma, the comma is definitely the decimal.
      if (commas == 1) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        // Check if the last dot looks like a decimal (not followed by exactly 3 digits, or only 1-2 digits)
        int lastDotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (str.length - lastDotIdx != 4) {
           // Last dot is decimal
           String integerPart = str.substring(0, lastDotIdx).replaceAll('.', '');
           String decimalPart = str.substring(lastDotIdx + 1);
           str = "$integerPart.$decimalPart";
        } else {
           // All dots are thousands
           str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
        }
      }
    } else if (dots == 1 && commas == 1) {
      int dotIdx = str.indexOf('.');
      int commaIdx = str.indexOf(',');
      if (dotIdx < commaIdx) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
      }
    } else if (commas > 1) {
      str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
    } else if (dots == 1) {
      // Single dot.
      int dotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
      // If exactly 3 digits follow and it's not the ONLY digits, it might be thousands.
      if (str.length - dotIdx == 4 && str.length > 4) {
        // Likely thousands, e.g., 1.234 or 10.234
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
      }
    } else if (commas == 1) {
      str = str.replaceFirst(',', '.');
    }

    return double.tryParse(str) ??
           double.tryParse(str.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d.]'), '')) ?? 0.0;
  }

  String _formatExpenseAmount(Map<String, dynamic> expense) {
    final currency = (expense['currency'] ?? 'IDR').toString().toUpperCase();
    final amount = _toDouble(expense['amount']);
    final kurs = _toDouble(expense['currency_exchange']);
    final idrAmount = _toDouble(expense['idr_amount']) > 0
        ? _toDouble(expense['idr_amount'])
        : (amount * (kurs > 0 ? kurs : 1.0));

    if (currency == 'IDR') {
      return 'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(amount)}';
    }

    return '$currency ${_foreignCurrencyFormat.format(amount)}\n(Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(idrAmount)})';
  }

  String _displaySettlementStatus(Map<String, dynamic>? s) {
    if (s == null) return 'draft';
    final status = (s['status'] ?? 'draft').toString().toLowerCase();
    final returnStatus = (s['return_status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final expenses = _asMapList(s['expenses']);
    final hasRejectedExpense = expenses.any((e) => (e['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'rejected');

    if (status == 'submitted' && (returnStatus == 'rejected' || hasRejectedExpense)) {
      return 'revision';
    }
    return status == 'completed' ? 'approved' : status;
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _approvedSettlementExpenses(
    Map<String, dynamic> settlement,
  ) {
    final expenses = _asMapList(settlement['expenses']);
    return expenses.where((expense) {
      final status = (expense['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      return status == 'approved' || status == 'completed';
    }).toList();
  }

  String _expenseFundSource(Map<String, dynamic> expense) {
    for (final key in const [
      'source_bank_name',
      'source_bank',
      'bank_name',
      'bank',
      'source',
    ]) {
      final value = (expense[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty) return value;
    }
    return '-';
  }

  String _settlementDisbursementSourceLabel(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final saved = (settlement['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (saved.isNotEmpty) return saved;
    final approvedExpenses = _approvedSettlementExpenses(settlement);
    if (approvedExpenses.isEmpty) return '-';
    final firstSource = _expenseFundSource(approvedExpenses.first);
    final allSame = approvedExpenses
        .every((expense) => _expenseFundSource(expense) == firstSource);
    return allSame && firstSource.isNotEmpty ? firstSource : '-';
  }

  String _settlementReturnSourceLabel(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final returnSource = (settlement['return_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (returnSource.isNotEmpty) return returnSource;
    final disbursementSource = _settlementDisbursementSourceLabel(settlement);
    return disbursementSource.isNotEmpty ? disbursementSource : '-';
  }

  List<String> _fundSourceOptions(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final options = <String>{};

    void collect(dynamic raw) {
      if (raw is List) {
        for (final item in raw) {
          if (item is Map) {
            final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item);
            for (final key in const ['name', 'bank_name', 'label', 'code']) {
              final value = (map[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
              if (value.isNotEmpty) {
                options.add(value);
                break;
              }
            }
          } else {
            final value = item.toString().trim();
            if (value.isNotEmpty) options.add(value);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    collect(settlement['fund_sources']);
    collect([settlement['disbursement_source'], settlement['return_source']]);

    for (final expense in _approvedSettlementExpenses(settlement)) {
      final source = _expenseFundSource(expense);
      if (source.isNotEmpty) options.add(source);
    }

    final merged = <String>[..._settlementFundSourceChoices];
    for (final option in options) {
      final value = option.trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty &&
          value != '-' &&
          !_settlementFundSourceChoices.contains(value) &&
          !merged.contains(value)) {
        merged.add(value);
      }
    }
    return merged;
  }

  double _settlementReimbursementAmount(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final approvedAmount = _toDouble(settlement['approved_amount']);
    final advanceId = settlement['advance_id'] ?? 0;
    if (advanceId == null || advanceId == 0) return approvedAmount;

    final availableFund = _toDouble(settlement['available_fund']);
    final delta = approvedAmount - availableFund;
    return delta > 0 ? delta : 0;
  }

  Widget _buildFundTransferSection(
    BuildContext context,
    Map<String, dynamic> settlement,
    AuthProvider auth,
  ) {
    final approvedExpenses = _approvedSettlementExpenses(settlement);
    final options = _fundSourceOptions(settlement);
    final hasPendingItems =
        _asMapList(settlement['expenses']).length != approvedExpenses.length;

    // SYARAT: Tabel 2 baru bisa diproses jika SEMUA item di Tabel 1 sudah status Approved
    final allExpenses = _asMapList(settlement['expenses']);
    final allApproved = allExpenses.isNotEmpty &&
        allExpenses.every((item) => item['status'] == 'approved');

    if (!allApproved) {
      return Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          border: Border.all(color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.4)),
        ),
        child: Row(
          children: [
            Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded, color: AppTheme.warning),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                'Belum semua item di-approve. Tabel pengiriman dana akan muncul setelah semua item approved.',
                style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(context)),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      );
    }

    final isDisbursementApproved =
        settlement['is_disbursement_approved'] ?? false;
    final initialSource = _settlementDisbursementSourceLabel(settlement);
    final totalApproved = approvedExpenses.fold<double>(
      0,
      (sum, e) =>
          sum + (double.tryParse(e['idr_amount']?.toString() ?? '0') ?? 0.0),
    );

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        Row(
          children: [
            Text(
              'Tabel Pengiriman Dana',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: _creamColor(context),
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(width: 12),
            Container(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 10, vertical: 4),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: isDisbursementApproved
                    ? AppTheme.success.withValues(alpha: 0.1)
                    : AppTheme.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                border: Border.all(
                    color: isDisbursementApproved
                        ? AppTheme.success
                        : AppTheme.warning,
                    width: 1),
              ),
              child: Text(
                isDisbursementApproved ? 'APPROVED' : 'PENDING',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 10,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: isDisbursementApproved
                      ? AppTheme.success
                      : AppTheme.warning,
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        if (hasPendingItems) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 8),
          Text(
            'Hanya item approved yang ditampilkan di tabel verifikasi dana.',
            style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(context), fontSize: 12),
          ),
        ],
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: _cardColor(context),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(context)),
          ),
          child: ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              child: DataTable(
                headingRowColor: WidgetStateProperty.all(
                  _surfaceColor(context),
                ),
                dataRowColor: WidgetStateProperty.resolveWith((states) {
                  if (states.contains(WidgetState.hovered)) {
                    return _isDark(context)
                        ? AppTheme.cardHover
                        : AppTheme.lightCardHover;
                  }
                  return _cardColor(context);
                }),
                dataRowMaxHeight: double.infinity,
                columns: [
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('No')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Tanggal')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Sumber Dana')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Deskripsi')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Amount')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Biaya Admin')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Evidence')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Status')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Comment')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Aksi')),
                ],
                rows: [
                  _buildDisbursementDataRow(
                    settlement,
                    approvedExpenses,
                    initialSource,
                    totalApproved,
                    isDisbursementApproved,
                    auth,
                    options,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  DataRow _buildDisbursementDataRow(
    Map<String, dynamic> settlement,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> approvedExpenses,
    String initialSource,
    double totalApproved,
    bool isDisbursementApproved,
    AuthProvider auth,
    List<String> options,
  ) {
    final isBatch = settlement['settlement_type'] == 'batch';
    final title = settlement['title']?.toString() ?? '';
    final firstDesc = approvedExpenses.isNotEmpty
        ? approvedExpenses[0]['description']?.toString() ?? ''
        : '';
    final displayDescription = isBatch ? title : firstDesc;

    // Selalu sinkronkan nilai turunan antar tabel
    _disbursementDate ??= AppFormatters.parseDateFromApi(
          settlement['created_at'],
        ) ??
        DateTime.now();

    if (_disbursementDescriptionController.text != displayDescription) {
      _disbursementDescriptionController.text = displayDescription;
    }

    final disbursementComment =
        (settlement['disbursement_comment'] ?? '').toString();
    if (_disbursementCommentController.text != disbursementComment) {
      _disbursementCommentController.text = disbursementComment;
    }

    final dbAdminFee = _toDouble(settlement['admin_fee']);
    final targetAdminFee = AppFormatters.formatCurrencyPlain(dbAdminFee);
    if (_adminFeeController.text != targetAdminFee) {
      _adminFeeController.text = targetAdminFee;
    }

    final dbDisbursed = _toDouble(settlement['disbursed_amount']);
    final isTable2Modified = settlement['modified_t2'] == true;
    final targetDisbursed =
        isTable2Modified ? (dbDisbursed > 0 ? dbDisbursed : totalApproved) : totalApproved;
    final targetDisbursedText =
        AppFormatters.formatCurrencyPlain(targetDisbursed);
    if (_disbursedAmountController.text != targetDisbursedText) {
      _disbursedAmountController.text = targetDisbursedText;
    }

    final dbReturned = _toDouble(settlement['returned_amount']);
    final targetReturnedText = AppFormatters.formatCurrencyPlain(dbReturned);
    if (_returnedAmountController.text != targetReturnedText) {
      _returnedAmountController.text = targetReturnedText;
    }

    return DataRow(
      cells: [
        DataCell(Text('1')),
        DataCell(
          Text(
            AppFormatters.formatDateForApi(_disbursementDate!),
          ),
        ),
        DataCell(
          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 180),
            child: Text(
              initialSource == '-' ? 'Pilih Sumber Dana' : initialSource,
            ),
          ),
        ),
        DataCell(
          ConstrainedBox(
            constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 280),
            child: Text(_disbursementDescriptionController.text),
          ),
        ),
        DataCell(
          Text(
            AppFormatters.formatCurrency(
              _toDouble(_disbursedAmountController.text),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        DataCell(
          Text(
            AppFormatters.formatCurrency(
              _toDouble(_adminFeeController.text),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        DataCell(
          settlement['disbursement_evidence_path'] != null
              ? IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(
                    Icons.image_rounded,
                    color: AppTheme.accent,
                    size: 18,
                  ),
                  onPressed: () {
                    // Prioritaskan evidence dari settlement level
                    if (settlement['disbursement_evidence_path'] != null) {
                      _showEvidence(
                        settlement['disbursement_evidence_path'],
                        'Bukti Transfer',
                      );
                    }
                  },
                )
              : const Text('-'),
        ),
        DataCell(
          Container(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: 10,
              vertical: 6,
            ),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: (isDisbursementApproved
                      ? AppTheme.success
                      : AppTheme.warning)
                  .withValues(alpha: 0.15),
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
            ),
            child: Text(
              isDisbursementApproved ? 'APPROVED' : 'PENDING',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 10,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.w700,
                color: isDisbursementApproved
                    ? AppTheme.success
                    : AppTheme.warning,
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        DataCell(
          Builder(builder: (context) {
            final comments = _parsePlainComments(
              settlement['disbursement_comment'],
            );
            if (comments.isEmpty) return const Text('-');

            return TextButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _showPlainCommentsDialog(
                comments,
                title: 'Riwayat Komentar',
              ),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.comment_rounded, size: 14),
              label: const Text(
                'Lihat Komentar',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
              ),
              style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                minimumSize: Size.zero,
                tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
              ),
            );
          }),
        ),
        DataCell(
          Builder(builder: (context) {
            final mainStatus =
                (settlement['status'] ?? 'draft').toString().toLowerCase();
            final isSubmittedDoc =
                mainStatus == 'submitted' || mainStatus == 'revision_submitted';
            final isInDraftDoc =
                mainStatus == 'draft' || mainStatus == 'rejected';
            return Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                IconButton(
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                      size: 18, color: AppTheme.primary),
                  onPressed: () => _showDisbursementPreview(settlement),
                  tooltip: 'Pratinjau Rincian',
                ),
                if (auth.isManager && isInDraftDoc)
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.edit_rounded,
                      color: AppTheme.primary,
                    ),
                    onPressed: () => _showEditDisbursementDialog(
                      settlement,
                      options,
                    ),
                    tooltip: 'Edit Rincian Pengiriman',
                  ),
                if (auth.isManager &&
                    isSubmittedDoc &&
                    !isDisbursementApproved &&
                    (_settlementDisbursementSourceLabel(settlement) != '-'))
                  IconButton(
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                        size: 20, color: AppTheme.success),
                    onPressed: () async {
                      final messenger = ScaffoldMessenger.of(context);
                      final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
                      final success =
                          await prov.approveDisbursement(widget.settlementId);
                      if (!mounted) return;
                      if (success) {
                        messenger.showSnackBar(
                          const SnackBar(
                              content: Text('Tabel Pengiriman Dana disetujui ✓'),
                              backgroundColor: AppTheme.success),
                        );
                      }
                    },
                    tooltip: 'Setujui Pengiriman',
                  ),
              ],
            );
          }),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFundReturnSection(
    BuildContext context,
    Map<String, dynamic> settlement,
    AuthProvider auth,
  ) {
    // GATING: Tabel 3 dikunci jika Tabel 2 belum di-Approve Manager
    final isDisbursementApproved = settlement['is_disbursement_approved'] ?? false;

    if (!isDisbursementApproved) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final isReturnApproved = settlement['is_return_approved'] ?? false;
    final dbReturned = _toDouble(settlement['returned_amount']);
    if (dbReturned <= 0) {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    final isManager = auth.isManager;
    final returnStatus = (settlement['return_status'] ?? 'pending').toString().toLowerCase();

    // Permission logic
    final isOwner = auth.user?['id'] == settlement['user_id'];
    final isInDraft = settlement['status'] == 'draft' || settlement['status'] == 'rejected';
    final isSubmittedDoc = settlement['status'] == 'submitted' || settlement['status'] == 'revision_submitted';

    final canEditReturn = (isOwner || isManager) && isInDraft;

    // Permission logic for Table 3 Actions (Manager Only)
    final canApproveReturn = isManager && isSubmittedDoc && returnStatus == 'submitted';
    final canRejectReturn = isManager && isSubmittedDoc && returnStatus == 'submitted';

    if (_returnedAmountController.text == '0' && dbReturned > 0) {      _returnedAmountController.text = dbReturned.toStringAsFixed(0);
    }

    _returnDate ??= DateTime.now();

    return Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
      children: [
        const SizedBox(height: 28),
        Row(
          children: [
            Text(
              'Tabel Pengembalian Dana',
              style: TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                color: _creamColor(context),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 16),
        Container(
          decoration: BoxDecoration(
            color: _cardColor(context),
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(context)),
          ),
          child: ClipRRect(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
            child: SingleChildScrollView(
              scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
              child: DataTable(
                headingRowColor: WidgetStateProperty.all(_surfaceColor(context)),
                dataRowMaxHeight: double.infinity,
                columns: [
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('No')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Tanggal')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Sumber Dana')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Deskripsi')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Amount')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Evidence')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Status')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Comment')),
                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Aksi')),
                ],
                rows: [
                  DataRow(
                    cells: [
                      const DataCell(Text('1')),
                      DataCell(
                          Text(AppFormatters.formatDateForApi(_returnDate!))),
                      DataCell(ConstrainedBox(
                        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 180),
                        child: Text(_settlementReturnSourceLabel(settlement)),
                      )),
                      DataCell(ConstrainedBox(
                        constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 300),
                        child: Text(
                          _displaySettlementTitle(settlement),
                          style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13),
                        ),
                      )),
                      DataCell(Text(
                        AppFormatters.formatCurrency(
                            _toDouble(_returnedAmountController.text)),
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          color: AppTheme.danger,
                        ),
                      )),
                      DataCell(
                        (settlement['return_evidence_path'] != null ||
                                _returnFilePaths.isNotEmpty)
                            ? IconButton(
                                icon: Icon(
                                  Icons.image_rounded,
                                  color:
                                      settlement['return_evidence_path'] != null
                                          ? AppTheme.danger
                                          : AppTheme.success,
                                ),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  final path =
                                      settlement['return_evidence_path'] ??
                                          _returnFilePaths.join('|');
                                  _showEvidence(path, 'Bukti Pengembalian');
                                },
                              )
                            : const Text('-'),
                      ),
                      DataCell(
                        Builder(builder: (context) {
                          final checklist = _parseChecklist(
                            settlement['return_notes'] ?? '[]',
                          );
                          final checkedCount = checklist
                              .where((it) => it['checked'] == true)
                              .length;
                          final totalCount = checklist.length;

                          final normalizedStatus =
                              (isReturnApproved || returnStatus == 'approved')
                                  ? 'approved'
                                  : returnStatus;

                          final statusUpper = normalizedStatus.toUpperCase();
                          final showCommentProgress =
                              (normalizedStatus == 'rejected' ||
                                      normalizedStatus == 'pending') &&
                                  totalCount > 0;
                          final statusLabel = showCommentProgress
                              ? '$statusUpper (Comment $checkedCount/$totalCount)'
                              : statusUpper;

                          final color = normalizedStatus == 'approved'
                              ? AppTheme.success
                              : (normalizedStatus == 'rejected'
                                  ? AppTheme.danger
                                  : AppTheme.warning);

                          Widget badge = Container(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 10,
                              vertical: 6,
                            ),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.15),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                              border: showCommentProgress
                                  ? Border.all(
                                      color: color.withValues(alpha: 0.3),
                                    )
                                  : null,
                            ),
                            child: Text(
                              statusLabel,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                fontSize: 10,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                color: color,
                              ),
                            ),
                          );

                          if (showCommentProgress) {
                            return InkWell(
                              onTap: () => _showReturnChecklistDialog(
                                checklist,
                                returnStatus,
                              ),
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(6),
                              child: badge,
                            );
                          }

                          return badge;
                        }),
                      ),
                      DataCell(
                        ConstrainedBox(
                          constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxWidth: 280),
                          child: Text(
                            _returnDescriptionController.text.isEmpty
                                ? (settlement['return_description'] ?? '-')
                                : _returnDescriptionController.text,
                            style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 13),
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                      DataCell(
                        Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                                  size: 18, color: AppTheme.primary),
                              onPressed: () => _showReturnPreview(settlement),
                              tooltip: 'Pratinjau',
                            ),
                            if (canEditReturn)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_rounded,
                                    color: Colors.orange),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  _existingReturnPaths.clear();
                                  _existingReturnPaths.addAll(
                                    (settlement['return_evidence_path']
                                                ?.toString() ??
                                            '')
                                        .split('|')
                                        .where((p) => p.isNotEmpty),
                                  );
                                  _existingReturnFilenames.clear();
                                  _existingReturnFilenames.addAll(
                                    (settlement['return_evidence_filename']
                                                ?.toString() ??
                                            '')
                                        .split('|')
                                        .where((f) => f.isNotEmpty),
                                  );
                                  _showEditReturnDialog();
                                },
                                tooltip: 'Edit',
                              ),
                            if (canApproveReturn)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                    size: 20, color: AppTheme.success),
                                tooltip: 'Approve Pengembalian',
                                onPressed: () => _approveReturn(),
                              ),
                            if (canRejectReturn)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.cancel_rounded,
                                    size: 20, color: AppTheme.danger),
                                tooltip: 'Reject Pengembalian',
                                onPressed: () => _showRejectReturnDialog(),
                              ),                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
  Widget _headerText(String label) {
    return Text(
      label,
      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: _creamColor(context)),
    );
  }

  void _showReturnChecklistDialog(
    List<dynamic> checklist,
    String returnStatus,
  ) {
    final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
    final s = prov.currentSettlement;
    final mainStatus = (s?['status'] ?? 'draft').toString().toLowerCase();

    // Bisa edit checklist HANYA jika status utama adalah DRAFT
    final canEdit = mainStatus == 'draft';

    List<Map<String, dynamic>> localChecklist = _parseChecklist(checklist);

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setModalState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            title: Text(
              'Rejection Checklist${!canEdit ? ' (Lihat saja)' : ''}',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 400,
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 420),
                child: Builder(
                  builder: (ctx2) {
                    final checklistCtrl = ScrollController();
                    return AppScrollbar(
                      controller: checklistCtrl,
                      thumbVisibility: true,
                      interactive: true,
                      child: SingleChildScrollView(
                        controller: checklistCtrl,
                        child: SelectionArea(
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              ...localChecklist.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                                final idx = entry.key;
                                final item = entry.value;
                                return _buildReturnChecklistTile(
                                  idx,
                                  item,
                                  canEdit,
                                  setModalState,
                                );
                              }),
                              const SizedBox(height: 16),
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color:
                                      AppTheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  children: [
                                    const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                                        size: 16, color: AppTheme.primary),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Text(
                                        canEdit
                                            ? 'Centang semua item di atas setelah Anda memperbaikinya.'
                                            : 'Settlement disubmit, Move to Draft untuk edit',
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: AppTheme.primary,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('Tutup'),
              ),
              if (canEdit)
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();

                    setState(() => _isSaving = true);

                    // 1. Simpan checklist-nya
                    final success = await prov.updateReturnNotes(
                      widget.settlementId,
                      jsonEncode(localChecklist),
                    );

                    if (success && ctx.mounted) {
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      _showGlobalSnackBar(
                        'Checklist berhasil disimpan ✓',
                        AppTheme.success,
                      );
                      await prov.loadSettlement(widget.settlementId);
                    }
                    setState(() => _isSaving = false);
                  },                  child: const Text('Simpan'),
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildReturnChecklistTile(
    int index,
    Map<String, dynamic> item,
    bool canEdit,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    final isChecked = item['checked'] == true;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4),
      child: CheckboxListTile(
        value: isChecked,
        onChanged: canEdit
            ? (val) {
                setModalState(() {
                  item['checked'] = val;
                });
              }
            : null,
        title: Text(
          item['text'] ?? '',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: _creamColor(context).withValues(alpha: isChecked ? 0.5 : 1.0),
            decoration: isChecked ? TextDecoration.lineThrough : null,
          ),
        ),
        activeColor: AppTheme.success,
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        dense: true,
        controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _approveReturn() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);
    final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
    final success = await prov.approveReturn(widget.settlementId);
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _isSaving = false);
      _showGlobalSnackBar(
        success ? 'Tabel Pengembalian disetujui ✓' : (prov.error ?? 'Gagal approve'),
        success ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.danger,
      );
      if (success) {
        prov.loadSettlement(widget.settlementId);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showRejectReturnDialog() async {
    final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
    final s = prov.currentSettlement;
    if (s == null) return;

    List<Map<String, dynamic>> existingReasons = [];
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(s['return_notes'] ?? '[]');
      if (decoded is List) {
        existingReasons = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(decoded);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    final controllers = [TextEditingController()];
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> reasonsList = [];

    final confirmReject = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            ),
            title: Text(
              'Reject Pengembalian Dana',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 500,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Berikan alasan penolakan dalam bentuk checklist:',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                      fontSize: 13,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  ConstrainedBox(
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 300),
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      child: Column(
                        children: controllers.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                          final idx = entry.key;
                          final ctrl = entry.value;
                          return Padding(
                            key: ValueKey(ctrl),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                            child: Row(
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.check_box_outline_blank_rounded,
                                  size: 20,
                                  color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: TextField(
                                    controller: ctrl,
                                    autofocus: idx == controllers.length - 1,
                                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                                      hintText: 'Alasan #${idx + 1}',
                                      hintStyle: TextStyle(
                                        color: _secondaryText(ctx)
                                            .withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                                        fontSize: 13,
                                      ),
                                      isDense: true,
                                      contentPadding:
                                          const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                        vertical: 8,
                                        horizontal: 10,
                                      ),
                                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _creamColor(ctx),
                                      fontSize: 13,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                if (controllers.length > 1)
                                  IconButton(
                                    icon: const Icon(
                                      Icons.remove_circle_outline_rounded,
                                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                                      size: 20,
                                    ),
                                    onPressed: () {
                                      setDialogState(() {
                                        ctrl.dispose();
                                        controllers.removeAt(idx);
                                      });
                                    },
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        controllers.add(TextEditingController());
                      });
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                        size: 18, color: AppTheme.primary),
                    label: const Text('Tambah Alasan'),
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
                      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (controllers.every((c) => c.text.trim().isEmpty)) return;
                  reasonsList = controllers
                      .where((c) => c.text.trim().isNotEmpty)
                      .map((c) => {'text': c.text.trim(), 'checked': false})
                      .toList();
                  Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
                },
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                ),
                child: const Text('Reject Pengembalian'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    if (confirmReject == true && mounted) {
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> finalReasons = [
        ...existingReasons,
        ...reasonsList
      ];
      final notes = jsonEncode(finalReasons);

      setState(() => _isSaving = true);
      final success = await prov.rejectReturn(widget.settlementId, notes);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSaving = false);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(success
                ? 'Pengembalian dana ditolak ✓'
                : (prov.error ?? 'Gagal reject')),
            backgroundColor: success ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.danger,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    // Cleanup
    for (var c in controllers) {
      try {
        c.dispose();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  List<Widget> _buildSettlementDetailActions(
    BuildContext context,
    Map<String, dynamic> s,
    AuthProvider auth,
    String settlementStatus,
  ) {
    final actions = <Widget>[];

    final expenses = _asMapList(s['expenses']);
    if (expenses.isNotEmpty) {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _showAllItemsPreview(expenses, s),
          icon: Icons.list_alt_rounded,
          label: 'Pratinjau List',
          isOutlined: true,
          color: AppTheme.accent,
        ),
      );
    }

    if ((auth.user?['id'] == s['user_id'] || auth.isManager) &&
        (s['status'] == 'draft' || s['status'] == 'rejected') &&
        s['settlement_type'] == 'batch') {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _showEditSettlementDialog(context, s),
          icon: Icons.edit_rounded,
          label: 'Edit',
          isOutlined: true,
        ),
      );
    }

    if ((auth.user?['id'] == s['user_id'] || auth.isManager) &&
        s['status'] == 'draft') {
      actions.add(
        Builder(
          builder: (context) {
            final items = _asMapList(s['expenses']);
            return SettlementActionButton(
              onPressed: _canSubmitSettlementItems(items, s)
                  ? () => _submitSettlement()
                  : null,
              icon: Icons.send_rounded,
              label: 'Submit',
            );
          },
        ),
      );
    }

    if (auth.isManager && (s['status'] == 'submitted' || s['status'] == 'manager_approved')) {
      final isDisbursementApproved = s['is_disbursement_approved'] ?? false;
      // final isReturnApproved = s['is_return_approved'] ?? false; // Removed gating
      // final returnedAmount = _toDouble(s['returned_amount']);

      actions.add(
        Builder(
          builder: (context) {
            final items = _asMapList(s['expenses']);
            final itemsApproved = _canApproveSettlementItems(items);
            final returnedAmount = _toDouble(s['returned_amount']);
            final isReturnApproved = s['is_return_approved'] ?? false;
            final isReturnVerified = returnedAmount <= 0 || isReturnApproved;

            // Gating logic for showing the button:
            // Require Table 1 (itemsApproved), Table 2 (isDisbursementApproved), and Table 3 (isReturnVerified)
            final shouldShowFinalApprove =
                itemsApproved && isDisbursementApproved && isReturnVerified;

            // Logic for clickability: Same as above, Table 3 (returns) is now independent
            final canFinalApproveGating = shouldShowFinalApprove;

            return Row(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                if (shouldShowFinalApprove) ...[
                  SettlementActionButton(
                    onPressed: canFinalApproveGating
                        ? () => _approveSettlement()
                        : null,
                    icon: Icons.verified_rounded,
                    label: 'Approved Final',
                    backgroundColor: AppTheme.success,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                ],
                SettlementActionButton(
                  onPressed: () => _rejectSettlement(),
                  icon: Icons.cancel_rounded,
                  label: 'Reject',
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                ),
              ],
            );
          },
        ),
      );
    }

    final isOwner = auth.user?['id'] == s['user_id'];
    final isManager = auth.isManager;

    if ((isOwner || isManager) &&
        (s['status'] == 'submitted' ||
         s['status'] == 'rejected' ||
         s['status'] == 'approved' ||
         s['status'] == 'completed')) {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _moveToDraft(),
          icon: Icons.undo_rounded,
          label: 'Move to Draft',
          isOutlined: true,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (settlementStatus == 'approved' || settlementStatus == 'completed') {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _downloadReceipt(),
          icon: Icons.print_rounded,
          label: 'Cetak',
          isOutlined: true,
        ),
      );
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _exportSettlementExcel(),
          icon: Icons.table_chart_rounded,
          label: 'Excel',
          isOutlined: true,
        ),
      );
    }

    return actions;
  }

  Widget _buildMobileSettlementActionBar(
    BuildContext context,
    Map<String, dynamic> s,
    AuthProvider auth,
    String settlementStatus,
  ) {
    final actions = _buildSettlementDetailActions(
      context,
      s,
