  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _parseChecklist(dynamic checklist) {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> local = [];
    try {
      dynamic parsed = checklist is String ? jsonDecode(checklist) : checklist;
      if (parsed is List) {
        for (final e in parsed) {
          String text = '';
          bool checked = false;

          if (e is Map) {
            text = (e['text'] ?? '').toString();
            checked = e['checked'] == true;
          } else if (e is String) {
            text = e;
          }

          if (text.isNotEmpty) {
            local.add({'text': text, 'checked': checked});
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return local;
  }

  Widget _buildChecklistTile(
    Map<String, dynamic> item,
    bool canEdit,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    final alreadyChecked = item['checked'] == true;
    return CheckboxListTile(
      value: alreadyChecked,
      onChanged: canEdit
          ? (val) => setModalState(() => item['checked'] = val ?? false)
          : null,
      title: alreadyChecked
          ? SelectionContainer.disabled(
              child: Text(
                item['text'] ?? '',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
                  decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough,
                ),
              ),
            )
          : Text(
              item['text'] ?? '',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(context)),
            ),
      activeColor: AppTheme.success,
      checkColor: Colors.white,
      controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSaveChecklistButton(
    BuildContext dialogCtx,
    int expenseId,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list,
    String settlementStatus,
  ) {
    return ElevatedButton(
      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
      ),
      onPressed: () async {
        bool allFinished = list.every((it) => it['checked'] == true);
        final newStatus = allFinished ? 'pending' : 'rejected';
        final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();

        final success = await prov.updateExpenseData(
          expenseId,
          widget.settlementId,
          {'notes': jsonEncode(list), 'status': newStatus},
        );

        if (success) {
          prov.loadSettlement(widget.settlementId);
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          AppSnackbar.success('Checklist berhasil disimpan ✓');
        } else {
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          AppSnackbar.error('Gagal menyimpan checklist');
        }
      },
      child: const Text('Simpan'),
    );
  }

  void _showEditDisbursementDialog(
    Map<String, dynamic> settlement,
    List<String> options,
  ) {
    List<String> localDisbursementFilePaths = [];
    List<String> localDisbursementFileNames = [];
    String? localDisbursementSource =
        (settlement['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty
            ? null
            : (settlement['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();

    // Initialize existing files
    List<String> currentExistingPaths =
        (settlement['disbursement_evidence_path']?.toString() ?? '')
            .split('|')
            .where((p) => p.isNotEmpty)
            .toList();
    List<String> currentExistingNames =
        (settlement['disbursement_evidence_filename']?.toString() ?? '')
            .split('|')
            .where((f) => f.isNotEmpty)
            .toList();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setDialogState) {
          Widget buildFileList(
            List<String> paths,
            List<String>? filenames,
            bool isLocal,
            Function(int) onRemove,
          ) {
            if (paths.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
            return Container(
              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(context)),
              ),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    isLocal
                        ? 'Terpilih (${paths.length}):'
                        : 'File Lama (${paths.length}):',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                      fontSize: 10,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 4),
                  ...List.generate(paths.length, (index) {
                    final name = (filenames != null && filenames.length > index)
                        ? filenames[index]
                        : paths[index].split('/').last;
                    return Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(
                            isLocal ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.cloud_done,
                            color:
                                isLocal ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.primary,
                            size: 14,
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(width: 6),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              name,
                              style: TextStyle(
                                color: isLocal
                                    ? AppTheme.success
                                    : _primaryText(ctx),
                                fontSize: 11,
                              ),
                              maxLines: 1,
                              overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            ),
                          ),
                          GestureDetector(
                            onTap: () => onRemove(index),
                            child: const Icon(
                              Icons.cancel,
                              size: 16,
                              color: AppTheme.danger,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    );
                  }),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }

          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            title: Text('Edit Rincian Pengiriman',
                style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx))),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 500,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    ListTile(
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                      title: Text('Tanggal Pengiriman',
                          style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx))),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        AppFormatters.formatDateForApi(_disbursementDate!),
                        style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
                      ),
                      trailing:
                          Icon(Icons.calendar_today, color: AppTheme.primary),
                      onTap: () async {
                        final picked = await showDatePicker(
                          context: context,
                          initialDate: _disbursementDate!,
                          firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                          lastDate: DateTime(2101),
                        );
                        if (picked != null) {
                          setDialogState(() => _disbursementDate = picked);
                        }
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                      initialValue: localDisbursementSource,
                      dropdownColor: _cardColor(ctx),
                      isExpanded: true,
                      style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Sumber Dana',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      ),
                      items: options
                          .map(
                            (source) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                              value: source,
                              child: Text(source),
                            ),
                          )
                          .toList(),
                      onChanged: (value) {
                        setDialogState(() => localDisbursementSource = value);
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    const Text(
                      'Deskripsi',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),
                    Text(
                      _disbursementDescriptionController.text,
                      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _disbursedAmountController,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                      style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Amount',
                        prefixText: 'Rp ',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _adminFeeController,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                      style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                      decoration: const InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Biaya Admin',
                        prefixText: 'Rp ',
                        border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      ),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 20),
                    Text(
                      'Evidence (Bukti Transfer)',
                      style: TextStyle(
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: _creamColor(ctx)),
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    OutlinedButton.icon(
                      onPressed: () async {
                        final result = await FilePicker.pickFiles(
                          type: FileType.custom,
                          allowMultiple: true,
                          allowedExtensions: [
                            'jpg',
                            'jpeg',
                            'png',
                            'pdf',
                            'webp',
                          ],
                        );
                        if (result != null && result.files.isNotEmpty) {
                          setDialogState(() {
                            for (var file in result.files) {
                              if (file.path != null &&
                                  !localDisbursementFilePaths.contains(
                                    file.path,
                                  )) {
                                localDisbursementFilePaths.add(file.path!);
                                localDisbursementFileNames.add(file.name);
                              }
                            }
                          });
                        }
                      },
                      icon: const Icon(Icons.upload_file_rounded),
                      label: const Text('Pilih Bukti Transfer'),
                    ),
                    if (currentExistingPaths.isNotEmpty)
                      buildFileList(
                        currentExistingPaths,
                        currentExistingNames,
                        false,
                        (idx) {
                          setDialogState(() {
                            currentExistingPaths.removeAt(idx);
                            if (currentExistingNames.length > idx) {
                              currentExistingNames.removeAt(idx);
                            }
                          });
                        },
                      ),
                    if (localDisbursementFilePaths.isNotEmpty)
                      buildFileList(
                        localDisbursementFilePaths,
                        localDisbursementFileNames,
                        true,
                        (idx) {
                          setDialogState(() {
                            localDisbursementFilePaths.removeAt(idx);
                            localDisbursementFileNames.removeAt(idx);
                          });
                        },
                      ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
                  final disbursementSource = localDisbursementSource?.trim();

                  if (disbursementSource == null ||
                      disbursementSource.isEmpty) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text('Pilih Sumber Dana terlebih dahulu'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }

                  setDialogState(() => _isSaving = true);
                  final success = await prov.saveDisbursement(
                    settlementId: widget.settlementId,
                    disbursementSource: disbursementSource,
                    adminFee: _toDouble(_adminFeeController.text),
                    disbursedAmount: _toDouble(_disbursedAmountController.text),
                    evidenceFiles:
                        localDisbursementFilePaths.map((p) => File(p)).toList(),
                    existingFilePaths: currentExistingPaths,
                    existingFileNames: currentExistingNames,
                  );
                  setDialogState(() => _isSaving = false);

                  if (success && context.mounted) {
                    if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _showGlobalSnackBar(
                        'Data pengiriman disimpan', AppTheme.success);
                    setState(() {});
                  } else if (!success && context.mounted) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      SnackBar(
                        content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal menyimpan data'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Simpan'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<List<String>?> _pickReturnEvidence() async {
    try {
      final result = await FilePicker.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowMultiple: true,
        allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'pdf', 'webp'],
      );

      if (result != null && result.files.isNotEmpty) {
        return result.files
            .where((f) => f.path != null)
            .map((f) => f.path!)
            .toList();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
            .showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Gagal memilih file: $e')));
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  void _showEditReturnDialog() {
    final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
    final settlement = prov.currentSettlement;
    if (settlement == null) return;

    List<String> localReturnFilePaths = List.from(_returnFilePaths);
    List<String> localExistingPaths = List.from(_existingReturnPaths);
    List<String> localExistingNames = List.from(_existingReturnFilenames);

    String? localReturnSource =
        (settlement['return_source'] ?? settlement['disbursement_source'] ?? '')
                .toString()
                .trim()
                .isEmpty
            ? null
            : (settlement['return_source'] ??
                    settlement['disbursement_source'] ??
                    '')
                .toString()
                .trim();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setDialogState) {
          // Hitung saran kembalian
          final totalUsage = _toDouble(settlement['total_amount']);
          final disbursed = _toDouble(_disbursedAmountController.text);
          final excess = disbursed - totalUsage;
          final suggestedReturn = excess > 0 ? excess : 0.0;

          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape:
                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            title: Text('Edit Rincian Pengembalian',
                style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx))),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 500,
              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    ListTile(
                      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                      title: Text('Tanggal Kembali',
                          style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx))),
                      subtitle: Text(
                        AppFormatters.formatDateForApi(_returnDate!),
                        style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
                      ),
                      trailing:
                          Icon(Icons.calendar_today, color: AppTheme.primary),
                      onTap: () async {
                        final picked = await showDatePicker(
                          context: context,
                          initialDate: _returnDate!,
                          firstDate: DateTime(2020),
                          lastDate: DateTime(2101),
                        );
                        if (picked != null) {
                          setDialogState(() => _returnDate = picked);
                        }
                      },
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 16),
                    TextFormField(
                      controller: _returnedAmountController,
                      keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                      inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                      style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                      decoration: InputDecoration(
                        labelText: 'Amount',
                        prefixText: 'Rp ',
                        border: const OutlineInputBorder(),
                        suffixIcon: suggestedReturn > 0
                            ? TextButton(
                                onPressed: () {
                                  setDialogState(() {
                                    _returnedAmountController.text =
                                        _currencyFormat.format(suggestedReturn);
                                  });
                                },
                                child: const Text('Sesuai Sisa'),
                              )
                            : null,
                      ),
                    ),
                    if (suggestedReturn > 0) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Container(

    if (!mounted || rawPath == null || rawPath.trim().isEmpty) return;
    final path = rawPath.trim().toLowerCase();

    // Extract ID from path
    final parts = path.split('/');
    int? id;
    for (int i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      final value = int.tryParse(parts[i]);
      if (value != null) {
        id = value;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Navigate based on path
    if (path.contains('/settlements') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to settlement detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => SettlementDetailScreen(settlementId: id!),
        ),
      );
      return;

    if (path.contains('/advances') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to advance detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AdvanceDetailScreen(advanceId: id!)),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/categories')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard categories tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 3},
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/reports')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard reports tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 2},
        );
      }
      return;
    }
  }

  }

  double _toDouble(dynamic value) {
    if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
    if (value == null) return 0.0;
    String str = value.toString().trim();
    if (str.isEmpty) return 0.0;

    // Handle Indonesian format: 1.234.567,89 -> 1234567.89
    // Or our new formatter output: 1.234.567.89 -> 1234567.89

    int dots = '.'.allMatches(str).length;
    int commas = ','.allMatches(str).length;

    if (dots > 1) {
      // Multiple dots. In our project, the last one is likely the decimal separator
      // added by our new formatter, OR they are all thousands separators.
      // If there's a comma, the comma is definitely the decimal.
      if (commas == 1) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        // Check if the last dot looks like a decimal (not followed by exactly 3 digits, or only 1-2 digits)
        int lastDotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (str.length - lastDotIdx != 4) {
           // Last dot is decimal
           String integerPart = str.substring(0, lastDotIdx).replaceAll('.', '');
           String decimalPart = str.substring(lastDotIdx + 1);
           str = "$integerPart.$decimalPart";
        } else {
           // All dots are thousands
           str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
        }
      }
    } else if (dots == 1 && commas == 1) {
      int dotIdx = str.indexOf('.');
      int commaIdx = str.indexOf(',');
      if (dotIdx < commaIdx) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
      }
    } else if (commas > 1) {
      str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
    } else if (dots == 1) {
      // Single dot.
      int dotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
      // If exactly 3 digits follow and it's not the ONLY digits, it might be thousands.
      if (str.length - dotIdx == 4 && str.length > 4) {
        // Likely thousands, e.g., 1.234 or 10.234
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
      }
    } else if (commas == 1) {
      str = str.replaceFirst(',', '.');
    }

    return double.tryParse(str) ??
           double.tryParse(str.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d.]'), '')) ?? 0.0;
  }

  String _formatExpenseAmount(Map<String, dynamic> expense) {
    final currency = (expense['currency'] ?? 'IDR').toString().toUpperCase();
    final amount = _toDouble(expense['amount']);
    final kurs = _toDouble(expense['currency_exchange']);
    final idrAmount = _toDouble(expense['idr_amount']) > 0
        ? _toDouble(expense['idr_amount'])
        : (amount * (kurs > 0 ? kurs : 1.0));

    if (currency == 'IDR') {
      return 'Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(amount)}';
    }

    return '$currency ${_foreignCurrencyFormat.format(amount)}\n(Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(idrAmount)})';
  }

    final expenses = _asMapList(s['expenses']);

    if (status == 'submitted' && (returnStatus == 'rejected' || hasRejectedExpense)) {

  String _settlementDisbursementSourceLabel(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final saved = (settlement['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (saved.isNotEmpty) return saved;
    final approvedExpenses = _approvedSettlementExpenses(settlement);

    final firstSource = _expenseFundSource(approvedExpenses.first);
    final allSame = approvedExpenses

    return allSame && firstSource.isNotEmpty ? firstSource : '-';
  }

  List<String> _fundSourceOptions(Map<String, dynamic> settlement) {
    final options = <String>{};

    void collect(dynamic raw) {
      if (raw is List) {
        for (final item in raw) {
          if (item is Map) {
            final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item);
            for (final key in const ['name', 'bank_name', 'label', 'code']) {
              final value = (map[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
              if (value.isNotEmpty) {
                options.add(value);
                break;
              }
            }
          } else {
            final value = item.toString().trim();
            if (value.isNotEmpty) options.add(value);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    collect(settlement['fund_sources']);
    collect([settlement['disbursement_source'], settlement['return_source']]);

    for (final expense in _approvedSettlementExpenses(settlement)) {
      final source = _expenseFundSource(expense);
      if (source.isNotEmpty) options.add(source);
    }

    final merged = <String>[..._settlementFundSourceChoices];
    for (final option in options) {
      final value = option.trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty &&
          value != '-' &&
          !_settlementFundSourceChoices.contains(value) &&
          !merged.contains(value)) {
        merged.add(value);
      }
    }
    return merged;

                  DataColumn(label: _headerText('Comment')),
