  Future<void> _rejectItem(int itemId) async {
    final controllers = [TextEditingController()];

    final result = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            ),
            title: Text(
              'Tolak Item',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 500,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Berikan alasan penolakan dalam bentuk checklist:',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                      fontSize: 13,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  Flexible(
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      child: Column(
                        children: controllers.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                          final idx = entry.key;
                          final ctrl = entry.value;
                          return Padding(
                            key: ValueKey(ctrl),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                            child: Row(
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.check_box_outline_blank_rounded,
                                  size: 20,
                                  color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: TextField(
                                    controller: ctrl,
                                    autofocus: idx == controllers.length - 1,
                                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                                      hintText: 'Alasan #${idx + 1}',
                                      isDense: true,
                                      contentPadding:
                                          const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                        vertical: 10,
                                        horizontal: 12,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _primaryText(ctx),
                                      fontSize: 14,
                                    ),                                    maxLines: null,
                                    minLines: 1,
                                    keyboardType: TextInputType.multiline,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                if (controllers.length > 1)
                                  IconButton(
                                    icon: const Icon(
                                      Icons.remove_circle_outline,
                                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                                      size: 20,
                                    ),
                                    onPressed: () {
                                      final removedCtrl = controllers[idx];
                                      setDialogState(() {
                                        controllers.removeAt(idx);
                                      });
                                      Future.delayed(
                                        const Duration(milliseconds: 100),
                                        () {
                                          removedCtrl.dispose();
                                        },
                                      );
                                    },
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () => setDialogState(() {
                      controllers.add(TextEditingController());
                    }),
                    icon: const Icon(
                      Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                      size: 20,
                    ),
                    label: const Text('Tambah Alasan'),
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: AppTheme.accent,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  Navigator.pop(ctx, false);
                },
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (controllers.every((c) => c.text.trim().isEmpty)) return;
                  Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
                },
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                ),
                child: const Text('Tolak Item'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    if (result == true) {
      if (!mounted) {
        for (var c in controllers) {
          try {
            c.dispose();
          } catch (_) {}
        }
        return;
      }
      final reasons = controllers
          .map((c) => c.text.trim())
          .where((t) => t.isNotEmpty)
          .map((t) => {'text': t, 'checked': false})
          .toList();

      if (reasons.isNotEmpty) {
        final notesJson = jsonEncode(reasons);
        final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
        final success = await prov.approveAdvanceItem(
          itemId,
          'reject',
          notes: notesJson,
        );
        if (mounted) {
          if (success) {
            prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
          } else {
            ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
              SnackBar(
                content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal reject item'),
                backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
              ),
            );
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // Always dispose after everything is done
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      for (var c in controllers) {
        try {
          c.dispose();
        } catch (_) {}
      }
    });
  }

  void _showEvidence(String path, String? filename) {
    final paths = path.split('|').where((p) => p.isNotEmpty).toList();
    final filenames =
        (filename ?? '').split('|').where((f) => f.isNotEmpty).toList();
    if (paths.isEmpty) return;

    final screenWidth = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final token = context.read<AuthProvider>().token;

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Row(
          children: [
            Expanded(
              child: Text(
                paths.length > 1
                    ? 'Bukti (${paths.length} file)'
                    : (filenames.isNotEmpty ? filenames[0] : 'Evidence'),
                style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx), fontSize: 18),
              ),
            ),
            if (paths.length > 1)
              ElevatedButton.icon(
                onPressed: () async {
                  for (final p in paths) {
                    final url = prov.getEvidenceUrl(p);
                    final uri = Uri.parse(url);
                    if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
                      await launchUrl(
                        uri,
                        mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                      );
                    }
                  }
                },
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
                  foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                    horizontal: 12,
                    vertical: 8,
                  ),
                  textStyle: const TextStyle(fontSize: 12),
                ),
                icon: const Icon(Icons.open_in_new_rounded, size: 14),
                label: const Text('Buka Semua'),
              ),
          ],
        ),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: screenWidth > 700 ? 700 : screenWidth * 0.95,
          child: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Center(
              child: Wrap(
                spacing: 16,
                runSpacing: 16,
                alignment: WrapAlignment.center,
                children: List.generate(paths.length, (index) {
                  final p = paths[index];
                  final name = filenames.length > index
                      ? filenames[index]
                      : p.split('/').last;
                  final url = prov.getEvidenceUrl(p);
                  final pLower = p.toLowerCase();
                  final isPdf = pLower.endsWith('.pdf');
                  final isImage = pLower.endsWith('.jpg') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.jpeg') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.png') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.webp') ||
                      pLower.endsWith('.gif');

                  return InkWell(
                    onTap: () async {
                      final uri = Uri.parse(url);
                      if (await canLaunchUrl(uri)) {
                        await launchUrl(
                          uri,
                          mode: LaunchMode.externalApplication,
                        );
                      }
                    },
                    child: Container(
                      width: 140,
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: _cardColor(ctx).withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                        border: Border.all(
                          color: _creamColor(ctx).withValues(alpha: 0.2),
                        ),
                      ),
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          Container(
                            height: 100,
                            width: 120,
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: Colors.black12,
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                            ),
                            child: isImage
                                ? ClipRRect(
                                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                    child: Image.network(
                                      url,
                                      headers: {
                                        'Authorization': 'Bearer $token',
                                      },
                                      fit: BoxFit.cover,
                                      loadingBuilder:
                                          (context, child, loadingProgress) {
                                        if (loadingProgress == null) {
                                          return child;
                                        }
                                        return const Center(
                                          child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                                            strokeWidth: 2,
                                          ),
                                        );
                                      },
                                      errorBuilder: (ctx, error, stack) =>
                                          const Icon(Icons.broken_image),
                                    ),
                                  )
                                : Icon(
                                    isPdf
                                        ? Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded
                                        : Icons.insert_drive_file_rounded,
                                    size: 48,
                                    color: isPdf
                                        ? AppTheme.danger
                                        : AppTheme.primary,
                                  ),
                          ),
                          const SizedBox(height: 8),
                          Text(
                            name,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              color: _creamColor(ctx),
                              fontSize: 10,
                            ),
                            maxLines: 2,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  );
                }),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
            child: const Text('Tutup'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _asMapList(dynamic list) {
    if (list == null || list is! List) return [];
    return list.map((e) => Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)).toList();
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _uniqueById(List<Map<String, dynamic>> list) {
    final seen = <dynamic>{};
    return list.where((item) => seen.add(item['id'])).toList();
  }

  Future<void> _showAddCategoryDialog(
    BuildContext ctx,
    StateSetter setDialogState,
    Function(Map<String, dynamic>) onCreated, {
    int? parentId,
  }) async {
    final nameCtrl = TextEditingController();
    final prov = context.read<SettlementProvider>();

    await showDialog(
      context: ctx,
      builder: (innerCtx) => AlertDialog(
        backgroundColor: _cardColor(innerCtx),
        shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
        title: Text(
          parentId != null ? 'Tambah Sub Kategori' : 'Tambah Kategori Utama',
          style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(innerCtx)),
        ),
        content: SizedBox(
          width: 350,
          child: TextField(
            controller: nameCtrl,
            decoration: InputDecoration(
              labelText:
                  parentId != null ? 'Nama Sub Kategori' : 'Nama Kategori',
            ),
            style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
            autofocus: true,
          ),
        ),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(innerCtx),
            child: const Text('Batal'),
          ),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () async {
              if (nameCtrl.text.trim().isEmpty) return;
              final success = await prov.createCategory(
                nameCtrl.text.trim(),
                parentId: parentId,
              );
              if (innerCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(innerCtx);
              if (success && mounted) {
                // cari kategori baru untuk callback
                final all = prov.categories;
                Map<String, dynamic> found = {};

                // cari kategori yang baru dibuat
                for (final p in all) {
                  if (parentId == null && p['name'] == nameCtrl.text.trim()) {
                    found = p;
                    break;
                  }
                  if (parentId != null && p['id'] == parentId) {
                    final children = (p['children'] as List?) ?? [];
                    for (final c in children) {
                      if (c['name'] == nameCtrl.text.trim()) {
                        found = c;
                        break;
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }

                onCreated(found);

                if (context.mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    const SnackBar(
                      content: Text(
                        'Kategori ditambahkan (menunggu approval manager) ✓',
                      ),
                      backgroundColor: AppTheme.success,
                    ),
                  );
                }
              }
            },
            child: const Text('Tambah'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    // Delayed dispose
    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 300), () {
      nameCtrl.dispose();
    });
  }

  void _showChecklistDialog(
    int itemId,
    List<dynamic> checklist,
    String advanceStatus,
  ) {
    final isRejected =
        advanceStatus == 'rejected' || advanceStatus == 'revision_rejected';
    final isSubmitted =
        advanceStatus == 'submitted' || advanceStatus == 'revision_submitted';
    final isDraft = advanceStatus == 'draft';
    final isRevisionDraft = advanceStatus == 'revision_draft';

    // SEMUA user (manager/staff) TIDAK bisa edit saat submitted
    // Bisa edit saat draft/rejected/revision_draft
    final canEdit = !isSubmitted && (isDraft || isRejected || isRevisionDraft);
    final canAddComment = canEdit;

    List<Map<String, dynamic>> localChecklist = _parseChecklist(checklist);

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setModalState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            title: Text(
              'Rejection Checklist${!canEdit ? ' (Lihat saja)' : ''}',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 400,
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 420),
                child: AppScrollbar(
                  controller: _checklistScrollController,
                  thumbVisibility: true,
                  interactive: true,
                  child: SingleChildScrollView(
                    controller: _checklistScrollController,
                    child: SelectionArea(
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          ...localChecklist.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                            final item = entry.value;
                            return _buildChecklistTile(
                              item,
                              canEdit,
                              setModalState,
                            );
                          }),
                          if (canAddComment)
                            _buildAddCommentButton(
                              localChecklist,
                              setModalState,
                            ),
                          if (!canEdit && isSubmitted)
                            Container(
                              margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 16),
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 12,
                                vertical: 8,
                              ),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(
                                    alpha: 0.3,
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                              child: Row(
                                children: [
                                  const Icon(
                                    Icons.info_outline,
                                    size: 16,
                                    color: AppTheme.warning,
                                  ),
                                  const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                  Expanded(
                                    child: Text(
                                      'Kasbon disubmit, Move to Draft untuk edit',
                                      style: TextStyle(
                                        fontSize: 11,
                                        color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(
                                          alpha: 0.9,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                            ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: Text(
                  'Tutup',
                  style: TextStyle(color: _secondaryText(ctx)),
                ),
              ),
              if (canEdit)
                _buildSaveChecklistButton(
                  ctx,
                  itemId,
                  localChecklist,
                  advanceStatus,
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _parseChecklist(dynamic checklist) {
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> local = [];
    try {
      dynamic parsed = checklist is String ? jsonDecode(checklist) : checklist;
      if (parsed is List) {
        for (final e in parsed) {
          String text = '';
          bool checked = false;

          if (e is Map) {
            text = (e['text'] ?? '').toString();
            checked = e['checked'] == true;
          } else if (e is String) {
            text = e;
          }

          if (text.isNotEmpty) {
            local.add({'text': text, 'checked': checked});
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (_) {}
    return local;
  }

  Widget _buildChecklistTile(
    Map<String, dynamic> item,
    bool canEdit,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    final alreadyChecked = item['checked'] == true;
    return CheckboxListTile(
      value: alreadyChecked,
      onChanged: canEdit
          ? (val) => setModalState(() => item['checked'] = val ?? false)
          : null,
      title: alreadyChecked
          ? SelectionContainer.disabled(
              child: Text(
                item['text'] ?? '',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: _secondaryText(context),
                  decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough,
                ),
              ),
            )
          : Text(
              item['text'] ?? '',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(context)),
            ),
      activeColor: AppTheme.success,
      checkColor: Colors.white,
      controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
    );
  }

  Widget _buildAddCommentButton(
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      child: OutlinedButton.icon(
        onPressed: () => setModalState(
          () => list.add({'text': 'Komentar baru', 'checked': false}),
        ),
        icon: const Icon(Icons.add, size: 18),
        label: const Text('Tambah komentar'),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSaveChecklistButton(
    BuildContext dialogCtx,
    int itemId,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> list,
    String status,
  ) {
    return ElevatedButton(
      style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
        backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
      ),
      onPressed: () async {
        bool allFinished = list.every((it) => it['checked'] == true);
        final newStatus = allFinished ? 'pending' : 'rejected';

        final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
        final success = await prov.updateItemPartial(itemId, {
          'notes': jsonEncode(list),
          'status': newStatus,
        });

        if (success) {
          prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          _showGlobalSnackBar(
            'Checklist berhasil disimpan ✓',
            AppTheme.success,
          );
        } else {
          if (dialogCtx.mounted) Navigator.pop(dialogCtx);
          _showGlobalSnackBar('Gagal menyimpan checklist', AppTheme.danger);
        }
      },
      child: const Text('Simpan'),
    );
  }

  void _showGlobalSnackBar(String message, Color color) {
    if (context.mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(
        context,
      ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(message), backgroundColor: color));
    }
  }

  Widget _buildFileList(
    List<String> paths,
    List<String>? filenames,
    bool isLocal,
    Function(int) onRemove,
    BuildContext ctx,
    StateSetter setDialogState,
  ) {
    if (paths.isEmpty) return const SizedBox.shrink();
    return Container(
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
        border: Border.all(color: _dividerColor(ctx)),
      ),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Text(
            isLocal
                ? 'Terpilih (${paths.length}):'
                : 'File Lama (${paths.length}):',
            style: TextStyle(
              color: AppTheme.textSecondary,
              fontSize: 10,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: 4),
          ...List.generate(paths.length, (index) {
            final name = (filenames != null && filenames.length > index)
                ? filenames[index]
                : paths[index].split('/').last;
            return Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 2),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(
                    isLocal ? Icons.check_circle : Icons.cloud_done,
                    color: isLocal ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.primary,
                    size: 14,
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(width: 6),
                  Expanded(
                    child: Text(
                      name,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        color: isLocal ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.cream,
                        fontSize: 11,
                      ),
                      maxLines: 1,
                      overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                    ),
                  ),
                  GestureDetector(
                    onTap: () {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        onRemove(index);
                      });
                    },
                    child: const Icon(
                      Icons.cancel,
                      size: 16,
                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            );
          }),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showEditDisbursementDialog(

  ) {
    List<String> localDisbursementFilePaths = List.from(_disbursementFilePaths);
    List<String> localExistingPaths = List.from(_existingDisbursementPaths);
    List<String> localExistingNames = List.from(_existingDisbursementFilenames);
    String? localDisbursementSource =
        (advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim().isEmpty
            ? null
            : (advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setDialogState) => AlertDialog(
          title: const Text('Edit Rincian Pengiriman'),
          content: SingleChildScrollView(
            child: Column(
              mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
              children: [
                ListTile(
                  contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,

                    final picked = await showDatePicker(

                      initialDate: _disbursementDate!,

                    if (picked != null) {
                      setDialogState(() => _disbursementDate = picked);
                    }

                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                  initialValue: localDisbursementSource,

                    labelText: 'Sumber Dana',

                  items: options

                      .toList(),
                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setDialogState(() => localDisbursementSource = value);

                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                const Text(
                  'Deskripsi',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 12,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 4),
                Text(
                  _disbursementDescriptionController.text,
                  style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 14),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _disbursedAmountController,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Amount',
                    prefixText: 'Rp ',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                TextFormField(
                  controller: _adminFeeController,
                  keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
                  inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],
                  decoration: const InputDecoration(
                    labelText: 'Biaya Admin',
                    prefixText: 'Rp ',
                    border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                OutlinedButton.icon(
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final paths = await _pickDisbursementEvidence();
                    if (paths != null) {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        for (var p in paths) {
                          if (!localDisbursementFilePaths.contains(p)) {
                            localDisbursementFilePaths.add(p);
                          }
                        }
                      });
                    }
                  },
                  icon: const Icon(Icons.upload_file_rounded),
                  label: const Text('Tambah Bukti Transfer'),
                ),
                if (localExistingPaths.isNotEmpty)
                  _buildFileList(
                    localExistingPaths,
                    localExistingNames,
                    false,
                    (idx) {
                      localExistingPaths.removeAt(idx);
                      if (localExistingNames.length > idx) {
                        localExistingNames.removeAt(idx);
                      }
                    },
                    ctx,
                    setDialogState,
                  ),
                if (localDisbursementFilePaths.isNotEmpty)
                  _buildFileList(
                    localDisbursementFilePaths,
                    null,
                    true,
                    (idx) => localDisbursementFilePaths.removeAt(idx),
                    ctx,
                    setDialogState,
                  ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
          actions: [
            TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
              child: const Text('Batal'),
            ),
            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
                final disbursementSource = localDisbursementSource?.trim();

                if (disbursementSource == null || disbursementSource.isEmpty) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    const SnackBar(
                      content: Text('Pilih Sumber Dana terlebih dahulu'),
                      backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                    ),
                  );
                  return;
                }

                setDialogState(() => _isSaving = true);
                final success = await prov.saveDisbursement(
                  advanceId: widget.advanceId,
                  disbursementSource: disbursementSource,
                  adminFee: _toDouble(_adminFeeController.text),
                  disbursedAmount: _toDouble(_disbursedAmountController.text),
                  evidenceFiles:
                      localDisbursementFilePaths.map((p) => File(p)).toList(),
                  existingFilePaths: localExistingPaths,
                  existingFileNames: localExistingNames,
                );
                setDialogState(() => _isSaving = false);

                if (success && mounted) {
                  setState(() {
                    _disbursementFilePaths.clear();
                    _disbursementFilePaths.addAll(localDisbursementFilePaths);
                  });
                  if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                } else if (!success && context.mounted) {
                  ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                    SnackBar(
                      content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal menyimpan data'),
                      backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                    ),
                  );
                }
              },
              child: const Text('Simpan'),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  void _showEditReturnDialog() {
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final advance = prov.currentAdvance;
    if (advance == null) return;

    List<String> localReturnFilePaths = List.from(_returnFilePaths);
    List<String> localExistingPaths = List.from(_existingReturnPaths);
    List<String> localExistingNames = List.from(_existingReturnFilenames);
    String? localReturnSource =
        (advance['return_source'] ?? advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '')
                .toString()
                .trim()

      context: context,

          // Hitung saran kembalian (jika disbursed > approved)
          final approvedAmount = _toDouble(advance['approved_amount']);
          final disbursed = _toDouble(_disbursedAmountController.text);
          final excess = disbursed - approvedAmount;
          final suggestedReturn = excess > 0 ? excess : 0.0;

          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),

                RoundedRectangleBorder(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20)),
            title: Text('Edit Rincian Pengembalian',

                        Icon(Icons.calendar_today, color: AppTheme.primary),
                    onTap: () async {
                      final picked = await showDatePicker(

                    inputFormatters: [CurrencyInputFormatter()],

                      suffixIcon: suggestedReturn > 0
                          ? TextButton(
                              onPressed: () {
                                setDialogState(() {
                                  _returnedAmountController.text =
                                      _currencyFormat.format(suggestedReturn);
                                });
                              },
                              child: const Text('Sesuai Sisa'),
                            )
                          : null,
                    ),                  ),
                  if (suggestedReturn > 0) ...[
                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                    Container(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
                      decoration: BoxDecoration(
                        color: AppTheme.warning.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                      ),
                      child: Row(
                        children: [
                          Icon(Icons.info_outline,
                              size: 14, color: AppTheme.warning),
                          const SizedBox(width: 8),
                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              'Saran kembalian (Sisa Dana): Rp ${_currencyFormat.format(suggestedReturn)}',
                              style: TextStyle(
                                  fontSize: 11, color: AppTheme.warning),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                    value: localReturnSource,
                    dropdownColor: _cardColor(ctx),
                    isExpanded: true,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Sumber Dana',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                    ),
                    items: _advanceFundSourceOptions(advance)
                        .map(
                          (source) => DropdownMenuItem<String>(
                            value: source,
                            child: Text(source),
                          ),
                        )
                        .toList(),
                    onChanged: (value) {
                      setDialogState(() => localReturnSource = value);
                    },
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  TextFormField(
                    controller: _returnDescriptionController,
                    maxLines: 3,
                    style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                    decoration: const InputDecoration(
                      labelText: 'Komentar / Catatan Pengembalian',
                      hintText: 'Masukkan catatan tambahan jika ada...',
                      border: OutlineInputBorder(),
                      alignLabelWithHint: true,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 24),
                  Text(
                    'Evidence (Bukti Kembali)',
                    style: TextStyle(
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold, color: _creamColor(ctx)),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  OutlinedButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () async {
                      final paths = await _pickReturnEvidence();
                      if (paths != null) {
                        setDialogState(() {
                          for (var p in paths) {
                            if (!localReturnFilePaths.contains(p)) {
                              localReturnFilePaths.add(p);
                            }
                          }
                        });
                      }
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.file_upload_outlined),
                    label: const Text('Pilih Bukti Kembali'),
                  ),
                  if (localExistingPaths.isNotEmpty)
                    _buildFileList(
                      localExistingPaths,
                      localExistingNames,
                      false,
                      (idx) {
                        localExistingPaths.removeAt(idx);
                        if (localExistingNames.length > idx) {
                          localExistingNames.removeAt(idx);
                        }
                      },

                    ),
                  if (localReturnFilePaths.isNotEmpty)
                    _buildFileList(
                      localReturnFilePaths,
                      null,
                      true,
                      (idx) => localReturnFilePaths.removeAt(idx),
                      ctx,
                      setDialogState,
                    ),

              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () async {
                  final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
                  final returnSource = localReturnSource?.trim();
                  if (_toDouble(_returnedAmountController.text) > 0 &&
                      (returnSource == null || returnSource.isEmpty)) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      const SnackBar(
                        content: Text(
                            'Pilih Sumber Dana pengembalian terlebih dahulu'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                    return;
                  }
                  setDialogState(() => _isSaving = true);
                  final success = await prov.saveReturn(
                    advanceId: widget.advanceId,
                    returnedAmount: _toDouble(_returnedAmountController.text),
                    returnSource: returnSource,
                    returnDescription: _returnDescriptionController.text,
                    returnEvidenceFiles:
                        localReturnFilePaths.map((p) => File(p)).toList(),
                    existingFilePaths: localExistingPaths,
                    existingFileNames: localExistingNames,
                  );
                  setDialogState(() => _isSaving = false);

                  if (success && mounted) {
                    setState(() {
                      _returnFilePaths.clear();
                      _existingReturnPaths.clear();
                      _existingReturnFilenames.clear();
                    });
                    if (ctx.mounted) Navigator.pop(ctx);
                    _showGlobalSnackBar(
                        'Data pengembalian disimpan', AppTheme.success);
                  } else if (!success && context.mounted) {
                    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                      SnackBar(
                        content: Text(prov.error ?? 'Gagal menyimpan data'),
                        backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                      ),
                    );
                  }
                },
                child: const Text('Simpan'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _handleNotificationTap(String rawPath) async {
    if (!mounted) return;
    final path = rawPath.trim().toLowerCase();

    // Extract ID from path
    final parts = path.split('/');
    int? id;
    for (int i = parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      final value = int.tryParse(parts[i]);
      if (value != null) {
        id = value;
        break;
      }
    }

    // Navigate based on path
    if (path.contains('/settlements') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to settlement detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (_) => SettlementDetailScreen(settlementId: id!),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/advances') && id != null) {
      // Navigate to advance detail
      Navigator.pushReplacement(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => AdvanceDetailScreen(advanceId: id!)),
      );
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/categories')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard categories tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 3},
        );
      }
      return;
    }

    if (path.contains('/reports')) {
      // Navigate to dashboard reports tab
      if (context.read<AuthProvider>().isManager) {
        Navigator.of(context).pushNamedAndRemoveUntil(
          '/',
          (route) => false,
          arguments: {'initialTabIndex': 2},
        );
      }
      return;
    }
  }

  Color _statusColor(String status) {
    switch (status) {
      case 'draft':
        return AppTheme.textSecondary;
      case 'submitted':
        return AppTheme.warning;
      case 'approved':
        return AppTheme.success;
      case 'revision_draft':
        return AppTheme.accent;
      case 'revision_submitted':
        return AppTheme.warning;
      case 'revision_rejected':
        return AppTheme.danger;
      case 'in_settlement':
      case 'rejected':
      case 'completed':
      case 'settled':
        return status == 'rejected' ? AppTheme.danger : AppTheme.primary;
      default:
        return AppTheme.textSecondary;
    }
  }

  Color _advanceStatusColor(Map<String, dynamic> advance) {
    final status = (advance['status'] ?? 'draft').toString().toLowerCase();
    if (status == 'in_settlement') {
      final settlementStatus =
          (advance['settlement_status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      final isSettlementApproved =
          settlementStatus == 'approved' || settlementStatus == 'completed';
      return isSettlementApproved ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.danger;
    }
    return _statusColor(status);
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _approvedAdvanceItems(
    Map<String, dynamic> advance,
  ) {
    final items = _asMapList(advance['items']);
    return items.where((item) {
      final status = (item['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
      return status == 'approved' || status == 'completed';
    }).toList();
  }

  String _advanceFundSource(Map<String, dynamic> item) {
    for (final key in const [
      'source_bank_name',
      'source_bank',
      'bank_name',
      'bank',
      'source',
    ]) {
      final value = (item[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty) return value;
    }
    return '-';
  }

  String _advanceDisbursementSourceLabel(Map<String, dynamic> advance) {
    final saved = (advance['disbursement_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (saved.isNotEmpty) return saved;
    final approvedItems = _approvedAdvanceItems(advance);
    if (approvedItems.isEmpty) return '-';
    final firstSource = _advanceFundSource(approvedItems.first);
    final allSame =
        approvedItems.every((item) => _advanceFundSource(item) == firstSource);
    return allSame && firstSource.isNotEmpty ? firstSource : '-';
  }

  String _advanceReturnSourceLabel(Map<String, dynamic> advance) {
    final returnSource = (advance['return_source'] ?? '').toString().trim();
    if (returnSource.isNotEmpty) return returnSource;
    final disbursementSource = _advanceDisbursementSourceLabel(advance);
    return disbursementSource.isNotEmpty ? disbursementSource : '-';
  }

  List<String> _advanceFundSourceOptions(Map<String, dynamic> advance) {
    final options = <String>{};

    void collect(dynamic raw) {
      if (raw is List) {
        for (final item in raw) {
          if (item is Map) {
            final map = Map<String, dynamic>.from(item);
            for (final key in const ['name', 'bank_name', 'label', 'code']) {
              final value = (map[key] ?? '').toString().trim();
              if (value.isNotEmpty) {
                options.add(value);
                break;
              }
            }
          } else {
            final value = item.toString().trim();
            if (value.isNotEmpty) options.add(value);
          }
        }
      }
    }

    collect(advance['fund_sources']);
    collect([advance['disbursement_source'], advance['return_source']]);

    for (final item in _approvedAdvanceItems(advance)) {
      final source = _advanceFundSource(item);
      if (source.isNotEmpty) options.add(source);
    }

    final merged = <String>[..._advanceFundSourceChoices];
    for (final option in options) {
      final value = option.trim();
      if (value.isNotEmpty &&
          value != '-' &&
          !_advanceFundSourceChoices.contains(value) &&
          !merged.contains(value)) {
        merged.add(value);
      }
    }
    return merged;
  }
