                              _returnDescriptionController.text.trim().isNotEmpty
                                  ? _returnDescriptionController.text.trim()
                                  : ((advance['return_description'] ?? '')
                                      .toString()
                                      .trim());
                          final comments = _parsePlainComments(plainComment);
                          if (comments.isEmpty) return const Text('-');

                          return TextButton.icon(
                            onPressed: () => _showPlainCommentsDialog(
                              comments,
                              title: 'Riwayat Komentar',
                            ),
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.comment_rounded, size: 14),
                            label: const Text(
                              'Lihat Komentar',
                              style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11),
                            ),
                            style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 8),
                              minimumSize: Size.zero,
                              tapTargetSize: MaterialTapTargetSize.shrinkWrap,
                            ),
                          );
                        }),
                      ),
                      DataCell(
                        Row(
                          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                          children: [
                            IconButton(
                              icon: const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                                  size: 18, color: AppTheme.primary),
                              onPressed: () => _showReturnPreview(advance),
                              tooltip: 'Pratinjau',
                            ),
                            if (canEditReturn)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.edit_rounded,
                                    color: Colors.orange),
                                onPressed: () {
                                  _existingReturnPaths.clear();
                                  _existingReturnPaths.addAll(
                                      (advance['return_evidence_path']
                                                  ?.toString() ??
                                              '')
                                          .split('|')
                                          .where((p) => p.isNotEmpty));
                                  _existingReturnFilenames.clear();
                                  _existingReturnFilenames.addAll(
                                      (advance['return_evidence_filename']
                                                  ?.toString() ??
                                              '')
                                          .split('|')
                                          .where((f) => f.isNotEmpty));
                                  _showEditReturnDialog();
                                },
                                tooltip: 'Edit Data',
                              ),
                            if (canApproveReturn)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.check_circle_rounded,
                                    size: 20, color: AppTheme.success),
                                tooltip: 'Approve Pengembalian',
                                onPressed: () => _approveReturn(),
                              ),
                            if (canRejectReturn)
                              IconButton(
                                icon: const Icon(Icons.cancel_rounded,
                                    size: 20, color: AppTheme.danger),
                                tooltip: 'Reject Pengembalian',
                                onPressed: () => _showRejectReturnDialog(),
                              ),
                          ],
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  String _displayAdvanceStatus(Map<String, dynamic>? a) {
    if (a == null) return 'draft';
    final status = (a['status'] ?? 'draft').toString().toLowerCase();
    final returnStatus = (a['return_status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final items = _asMapList(a['items']);
    final hasRejectedItem = items.any((e) => (e['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase() == 'rejected');

    if (status == 'submitted' && (returnStatus == 'rejected' || hasRejectedItem)) {
      return 'revision';
    }
    return status == 'completed' ? 'approved' : status;
  }

  Widget _headerText(String label) {
    return Text(
      label,
      style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: _creamColor(context)),
    );
  }

  void _showReturnChecklistDialog(
    List<dynamic> checklist,
    String returnStatus,
  ) {
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final adv = prov.currentAdvance;
    final mainStatus = (adv?['status'] ?? 'draft').toString().toLowerCase();

    // Bisa edit checklist HANYA jika status utama adalah DRAFT
    final canEdit = mainStatus == 'draft';

    List<Map<String, dynamic>> localChecklist = _parseChecklist(checklist);

    showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (context, setModalState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            title: Text(
              'Rejection Checklist${!canEdit ? ' (Lihat saja)' : ''}',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 400,
              child: ConstrainedBox(
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 420),
                child: Builder(
                  builder: (ctx2) {
                    final checklistCtrl = ScrollController();
                    return AppScrollbar(
                      controller: checklistCtrl,
                      thumbVisibility: true,
                      interactive: true,
                      child: SingleChildScrollView(
                        controller: checklistCtrl,
                        child: SelectionArea(
                          child: Column(
                            mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                            children: [
                              ...localChecklist.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                                final idx = entry.key;
                                final item = entry.value;
                                return _buildReturnChecklistTile(
                                  idx,
                                  item,
                                  canEdit,
                                  setModalState,
                                );
                              }),
                              const SizedBox(height: 16),
                              Container(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
                                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                  color:
                                      AppTheme.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
                                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
                                ),
                                child: Row(
                                  children: [
                                    const Icon(Icons.info_outline_rounded,
                                        size: 16, color: AppTheme.primary),
                                    const SizedBox(width: 10),
                                    Expanded(
                                      child: Text(
                                        canEdit
                                            ? 'Centang semua item di atas setelah Anda memperbaikinya.'
                                            : 'Kasbon disubmit, Move to Draft untuk edit',
                                        style: const TextStyle(
                                          fontSize: 11,
                                          color: AppTheme.primary,
                                        ),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              ),
                            ],
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    );
                  },
                ),
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx),
                child: const Text('Tutup'),
              ),
              if (canEdit)
                ElevatedButton(
                  style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                    backgroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
                    foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                  ),
                  onPressed: () async {
                    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
                    setState(() => _isSaving = true);
                    final success = await prov.updateReturnNotes(
                      widget.advanceId,
                      jsonEncode(localChecklist),
                    );

                    if (success && ctx.mounted) {
                      Navigator.pop(ctx);
                      _showGlobalSnackBar(
                        'Checklist berhasil disimpan ✓',
                        AppTheme.success,
                      );
                      await prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
                    }
                    setState(() => _isSaving = false);
                  },
                  child: const Text('Simpan'),
                ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildReturnChecklistTile(
    int index,
    Map<String, dynamic> item,
    bool canEdit,
    StateSetter setModalState,
  ) {
    final isChecked = item['checked'] == true;
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4),
      child: CheckboxListTile(
        value: isChecked,
        onChanged: canEdit
            ? (val) {
                setModalState(() {
                  item['checked'] = val;
                });
              }
            : null,
        title: Text(
          item['text'] ?? '',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontSize: 13,
            color: _creamColor(context).withValues(alpha: isChecked ? 0.5 : 1.0),
            decoration: isChecked ? TextDecoration.lineThrough : null,
          ),
        ),
        activeColor: AppTheme.success,
        contentPadding: EdgeInsets.zero,
        dense: true,
        controlAffinity: ListTileControlAffinity.leading,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _approveReturn() async {
    if (_isSaving) return;
    setState(() => _isSaving = true);
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final success = await prov.approveReturn(widget.advanceId);
    if (mounted) {
      setState(() => _isSaving = false);
      _showGlobalSnackBar(
        success ? 'Tabel Pengembalian disetujui ✓' : (prov.error ?? 'Gagal approve'),
        success ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.danger,
      );
      if (success) {
        prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
      }
    }
  }

  Future<void> _showRejectReturnDialog() async {
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final adv = prov.currentAdvance;
    if (adv == null) return;

    List<Map<String, dynamic>> existingReasons = [];
    try {
      final decoded = jsonDecode(adv['return_notes'] ?? '[]');
      if (decoded is List) {
        existingReasons = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(decoded);
      }
    } catch (_) {}

    final controllers = [TextEditingController()];
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> reasonsList = [];

    final confirmReject = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) {
          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            ),
            title: Text(
              'Reject Pengembalian Dana',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: 500,
              child: Column(
                mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  Text(
                    'Berikan alasan penolakan dalam bentuk checklist:',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                      fontSize: 13,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  ConstrainedBox(
                    constraints: const BoxConstraints(maxHeight: 300),
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      child: Column(
                        children: controllers.asMap().entries.map((entry) {
                          final idx = entry.key;
                          final ctrl = entry.value;
                          return Padding(
                            key: ValueKey(ctrl),
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 8),
                            child: Row(
                              children: [
                                Icon(
                                  Icons.check_box_outline_blank_rounded,
                                  size: 20,
                                  color: _secondaryText(ctx),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                                Expanded(
                                  child: TextField(
                                    controller: ctrl,
                                    autofocus: idx == controllers.length - 1,
                                    decoration: InputDecoration(
                                      hintText: 'Alasan #${idx + 1}',
                                      hintStyle: TextStyle(
                                        color: _secondaryText(ctx)
                                            .withValues(alpha: 0.5),
                                        fontSize: 13,
                                      ),
                                      isDense: true,
                                      contentPadding:
                                          const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                        vertical: 8,
                                        horizontal: 10,
                                      ),
                                      border: OutlineInputBorder(
                                        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(8),
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                    style: TextStyle(
                                      color: _creamColor(ctx),
                                      fontSize: 13,
                                    ),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                if (controllers.length > 1)
                                  IconButton(
                                    icon: const Icon(
                                      Icons.remove_circle_outline_rounded,
                                      color: AppTheme.danger,
                                      size: 20,
                                    ),
                                    onPressed: () {
                                      setDialogState(() {
                                        ctrl.dispose();
                                        controllers.removeAt(idx);
                                      });
                                    },
                                  ),
                              ],
                            ),
                          );
                        }).toList(),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  TextButton.icon(
                    onPressed: () {
                      setDialogState(() {
                        controllers.add(TextEditingController());
                      });
                    },
                    icon: const Icon(Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded,
                        size: 18, color: AppTheme.primary),
                    label: const Text('Tambah Alasan'),
                    style: TextButton.styleFrom(
                      foregroundColor: AppTheme.primary,
                      padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
            actions: [
              TextButton(
                onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
                child: const Text('Batal'),
              ),
              ElevatedButton(
                onPressed: () {
                  if (controllers.every((c) => c.text.trim().isEmpty)) return;
                  reasonsList = controllers
                      .where((c) => c.text.trim().isNotEmpty)
                      .map((c) => {'text': c.text.trim(), 'checked': false})
                      .toList();
                  Navigator.pop(ctx, true);
                },
                style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                  backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
                ),
                child: const Text('Reject Pengembalian'),
              ),
            ],
          );
        },
      ),
    );

    if (confirmReject == true && mounted) {
      final List<Map<String, dynamic>> finalReasons = [
        ...existingReasons,
        ...reasonsList
      ];
      final notes = jsonEncode(finalReasons);

      setState(() => _isSaving = true);
      final success = await prov.rejectReturn(widget.advanceId, notes);
      if (mounted) {
        setState(() => _isSaving = false);
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
          SnackBar(
            content: Text(success
                ? 'Pengembalian dana ditolak ✓'
                : (prov.error ?? 'Gagal reject')),
            backgroundColor: success ? AppTheme.success : AppTheme.danger,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    // Cleanup
    for (var c in controllers) {
      try {
        c.dispose();
      } catch (_) {}
    }
  }

  List<Widget> _buildAdvanceDetailActions(
    BuildContext context,
    Map<String, dynamic> adv,
    AuthProvider auth,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> workflowItems,
    bool canEditHeader,
    bool canSubmit,
    bool canCreateSettlement,
    bool canStartRevision,
    bool canShowDownloadButtons,
  ) {
    final actions = <Widget>[];

    final items = _asMapList(adv['items']);
    if (items.isNotEmpty) {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _showAllItemsPreview(items, adv),
          icon: Icons.list_alt_rounded,
          label: 'Pratinjau List',
          isOutlined: true,
          color: AppTheme.accent,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (canEditHeader) {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _showEditAdvanceDialog(context, adv),
          icon: Icons.edit_rounded,
          label: 'Edit',
          isOutlined: true,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (canSubmit) {
      final label = adv['status'] == 'revision_draft' ||
              adv['status'] == 'revision_rejected'
          ? 'Submit Revisi'
          : 'Submit';
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: _canSubmitAdvanceItems(workflowItems, adv)
              ? () => _submitAdvance()
              : null,
          icon: Icons.send_rounded,
          label: label,
        ),
      );
    }

    final isOwner = auth.user?['id'] == adv['user_id'];
    final isManager = auth.isManager;

    if ((isOwner || isManager) &&
        (adv['status'] == 'submitted' ||
            adv['status'] == 'rejected' ||
            adv['status'] == 'revision_submitted' ||
            adv['status'] == 'revision_rejected' ||
            adv['status'] == 'approved' ||
            adv['status'] == 'completed')) {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: _moveToDraft,
          icon: Icons.undo_rounded,
          label: 'Move to Draft',
          isOutlined: true,
          color: AppTheme.warning,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (_isManager &&
        (adv['status'] == 'submitted' ||
            adv['status'] == 'revision_submitted')) {
      final label = adv['status'] == 'revision_submitted'
          ? 'Approved Final Revisi ${adv['active_revision_no'] ?? ''}'
          : 'Approved Final';

      final isDisbursementApproved = adv['is_disbursement_approved'] ?? false;
      final returnedAmount = _toDouble(adv['returned_amount']);
      final isReturnApproved = adv['is_return_approved'] ?? false;
      final isReturnVerified = returnedAmount <= 0 || isReturnApproved;

      // Gating logic for showing the button
      final itemsApproved = _canApproveAdvanceItems(workflowItems);
      // Logic for showing & clickability: Require Table 1, Table 2, and Table 3 (if applicable)
      final shouldShowFinalApprove =
          itemsApproved && isDisbursementApproved && isReturnVerified;
      final canFinalApproveGating = shouldShowFinalApprove;

      if (shouldShowFinalApprove) {
        actions.add(
          SettlementActionButton(
            onPressed: canFinalApproveGating ? () => _approveAdvance() : null,
            icon: Icons.check_circle_outline,
            label: label,
            color: AppTheme.success,
          ),
        );
      }
    }

    if (canStartRevision) {
      final label = 'Tambah Revisi ${(adv['approved_revision_no'] ?? 0) + 1}';
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _startRevision(),
          icon: Icons.add_circle_outline,
          label: label,
          color: AppTheme.accent,
        ),
      );
    }

    if (canShowDownloadButtons) {
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _downloadReceipt(),
          icon: Icons.picture_as_pdf_rounded,
          label: 'PDF',
          isOutlined: true,
        ),
      );
      actions.add(
        SettlementActionButton(
          onPressed: () => _exportAdvanceExcel(),
          icon: Icons.table_chart_rounded,
          label: 'Excel',
          isOutlined: true,
        ),
      );
    }

    return actions;
  }

  bool _canEditCurrentRevision(
    Map<String, dynamic> advance,
    Map<String, dynamic> item,
  ) {
    final status = (advance['status'] ?? '').toString();
    if (status == 'completed' || status == 'approved' || status == 'manager_approved') return false;

    final itemRevisionNo = item['revision_no'] ?? 0;
    if (status == 'draft' || status == 'rejected') {
      return itemRevisionNo == 0;
    }
    if (status == 'revision_draft' || status == 'revision_rejected') {
      return itemRevisionNo == (advance['active_revision_no'] ?? -1);
    }
    return false;
  }

  String _displayAdvanceTitle(Map<String, dynamic> advance) {
    final type = (advance['advance_type'] ?? 'single').toString().toLowerCase();
    final title = (advance['title'] ?? '').toString();

    if (type == 'single') {
      final items = List<Map<String, dynamic>>.from(
        advance['items'] as List? ?? [],
      );
      if (items.isNotEmpty) {
        // Sort by ID descending to get the latest item
        items.sort((a, b) => (b['id'] ?? 0).compareTo(a['id'] ?? 0));
        final latestItem = items.first;
        final desc = latestItem['description']?.toString() ?? '';
        return desc.isNotEmpty
            ? desc
            : (title.isNotEmpty ? title : 'Kasbon Mandiri');
      }
      return title.isNotEmpty ? title : 'Kasbon Mandiri';
    }
    return title.isEmpty ? 'Detail Kasbon' : title;
  }

  bool _hasUncheckedChecklist(Map<String, dynamic> item) {
    final checklist = _parseChecklist(item['notes']);
    return checklist.isNotEmpty &&
        checklist.any((entry) => entry['checked'] != true);
  }

  bool _canSubmitAdvanceItems(
      List<Map<String, dynamic>> items, Map<String, dynamic> adv) {
    if (items.isEmpty) return false;

    final itemsOk = !items.any(_hasUncheckedChecklist);
    final returnNotes = adv['return_notes'] ?? '';
    final returnChecklist = _parseChecklist(returnNotes);
    final returnOk = returnChecklist.isEmpty ||
        !returnChecklist.any((item) => item['checked'] != true);

    return itemsOk && returnOk;
  }

  bool _canApproveAdvanceItems(List<Map<String, dynamic>> items) {
    if (items.isEmpty) return false;
    return items.every(
      (item) =>
          (item['status'] ?? 'pending').toString().toLowerCase() == 'approved',
    );
  }

  List<Map<String, dynamic>> _workflowItems(
    Map<String, dynamic> advance,
    List<Map<String, dynamic>> items,
  ) {
    final status = (advance['status'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final activeRevisionNo =
        int.tryParse('${advance['active_revision_no'] ?? ''}') ?? -1;

    if (status == 'revision_draft' ||
        status == 'revision_rejected' ||
        status == 'revision_submitted') {
      return items
          .where(
            (item) =>
                (int.tryParse('${item['revision_no'] ?? 0}') ?? 0) ==
                activeRevisionNo,
          )
          .toList();
    }

    return items
        .where(
          (item) => (int.tryParse('${item['revision_no'] ?? 0}') ?? 0) == 0,
        )
        .toList();
  }

  double _toDouble(dynamic value) {
    if (value is num) return value.toDouble();
    if (value == null) return 0.0;
    String str = value.toString().trim();
    if (str.isEmpty) return 0.0;

    // Handle Indonesian format: 1.234.567,89 -> 1234567.89
    // Or our new formatter output: 1.234.567.89 -> 1234567.89

    int dots = '.'.allMatches(str).length;
    int commas = ','.allMatches(str).length;

    if (dots > 1) {
      // Multiple dots. In our project, the last one is likely the decimal separator
      // added by our new formatter, OR they are all thousands separators.
      if (commas == 1) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        // Check if the last dot looks like a decimal (not followed by exactly 3 digits, or only 1-2 digits)
        int lastDotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
        if (str.length - lastDotIdx != 4) {
           // Last dot is decimal
           String integerPart = str.substring(0, lastDotIdx).replaceAll('.', '');
           String decimalPart = str.substring(lastDotIdx + 1);
           str = "$integerPart.$decimalPart";
        } else {
           // All dots are thousands
           str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
        }
      }
    } else if (dots == 1 && commas == 1) {
      int dotIdx = str.indexOf('.');
      int commaIdx = str.indexOf(',');
      if (dotIdx < commaIdx) {
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '').replaceFirst(',', '.');
      } else {
        str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
      }
    } else if (commas > 1) {
      str = str.replaceAll(',', '');
    } else if (dots == 1) {
      // Single dot.
      int dotIdx = str.lastIndexOf('.');
      if (str.length - dotIdx == 4 && str.length > 4) {
        // Likely thousands, e.g., 1.234 or 10.234
        str = str.replaceAll('.', '');
      }
    } else if (commas == 1) {
      str = str.replaceFirst(',', '.');
    }

    return double.tryParse(str) ??
           double.tryParse(str.replaceAll(RegExp(r'[^\d.]'), '')) ?? 0.0;
  }

  Future<List<String>?> _pickDisbursementEvidence() async {
    try {
      final result = await FilePicker.pickFiles(
        type: FileType.custom,
        allowMultiple: true,
        allowedExtensions: ['jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'pdf', 'webp'],
      );

      if (result != null && result.files.isNotEmpty) {
        return result.files
            .where((f) => f.path != null)
            .map((f) => f.path!)
            .toList();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (mounted) {
        ScaffoldMessenger.of(
          context,
        ).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Gagal memilih file: $e')));
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  Future<void> _submitAdvance() async {
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final success = await prov.submitAdvance(widget.advanceId);
    if (success && mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        const SnackBar(
          content: Text('Kasbon berhasil disubmit untuk approval'),
        ),
      );
      prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId);
    } else if (mounted) {
      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text(
            prov.error ?? 'Submit gagal. Cek checklist komentar revisi.',
          ),
          backgroundColor: AppTheme.danger,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  Future<void> _approveAdvance() async {
    final currentAdvance = context.read<AdvanceProvider>().currentAdvance;
    if (currentAdvance == null) return;

    final confirm = await showDialog<bool>(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => AlertDialog(
        title: const Text('Konfirmasi Approved Final'),
        content: const Text(
            'Apakah Anda yakin ingin menyetujui final kasbon ini? Data akan dicatat ke Bank.'),
        actions: [
          TextButton(
              onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, false),
              child: const Text('Batal')),
          ElevatedButton(
            onPressed: () => Navigator.pop(ctx, true),
            style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(backgroundColor: AppTheme.success),
            child: const Text('Ya, Setujui'),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );

    if (confirm != true) return;
    if (!mounted) return;

    setState(() => _isSaving = true);
    final prov = context.read<AdvanceProvider>();
    final success = await prov.finalApproveAdvance(widget.advanceId);

    if (!mounted) return;
    if (success && context.mounted) {
      await prov.loadAdvance(widget.advanceId); // ✅ Ensure UI refresh
      _showGlobalSnackBar(
        'Kasbon berhasil disetujui final ✓',
        AppTheme.success,
      );
    } else if (context.mounted) {
      _showGlobalSnackBar(
        prov.error ?? 'Gagal menyetujui final kasbon',
        AppTheme.danger,
      );
    }
    setState(() => _isSaving = false);
  }

  }

  Future<void> _showAddItemDialog(
    BuildContext context, [
    Map<String, dynamic>? item,
  ]) async {
    final screenWidth = MediaQuery.of(context).size.width;
    final isEditing = item != null;
    final reportYear = context.read<AdvanceProvider>().reportYear;
    final now = DateTime.now();
    final defaultDate = reportYear == 0 || reportYear == now.year
        ? now
        : DateTime(reportYear, 12, 31);
    final descCtrl = TextEditingController(text: item?['description']);
    final amountCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: item?['estimated_amount'] != null
          ? NumberFormat('#,##0.###', 'id_ID').format(item!['estimated_amount'])
          : '',
    );

    int? selectedParentId;
    Set<int> selectedSubCategoryIds = {};

    final existingSubIds = item?['subcategory_ids'] as List?;
    if (existingSubIds != null) {
      selectedSubCategoryIds = Set<int>.from(existingSubIds.cast<int>());
    }
    List<String> selectedFilePaths = (item?['evidence_path'] as String?)
            ?.split('|')
            .where((p) => p.isNotEmpty)
            .toList() ??
        [];
    List<String> selectedFileNames = (item?['evidence_filename'] as String?)
            ?.split('|')
            .where((f) => f.isNotEmpty)
            .toList() ??
        [];
    String? selectedSource = item?['source'];
    String selectedCurrency = item?['currency'] ?? 'IDR';
    final exchangeRateCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: item?['currency_exchange'] != null
          ? NumberFormat('#,##0.###', 'id_ID').format(item!['currency_exchange'])
          : '1',
    );
    final dateCtrl = TextEditingController(
      text: item?['date'] ?? DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd').format(defaultDate),
    );

    // Load initial values if editing
    final catProv = context.read<SettlementProvider>();
    final allCats = _uniqueById(_asMapList(catProv.categories));

    if (isEditing && item['category_id'] != null) {
      final catId = item['category_id'] as int;
      for (final p in allCats) {
        if (p['id'] == catId) {
          selectedParentId = p['id'];
          break;
        }
        final children = _asMapList(p['children'] as List?);
        for (final c in children) {
          if (c['id'] == catId || selectedSubCategoryIds.contains(c['id'])) {
            selectedParentId = p['id'];
            if (selectedSubCategoryIds.isEmpty) {
              selectedSubCategoryIds.add(c['id']);
            }
            break;
          }
        }
        if (selectedParentId != null) break;
      }
    }

    await showDialog(
      context: context,
      builder: (ctx) => StatefulBuilder(
        builder: (ctx, setDialogState) {
          final prov = ctx.watch<SettlementProvider>();
          final categories = _uniqueById(_asMapList(prov.categories));

          // re-sync selected parent & child with fresh data from provider
          final parentIds =
              categories.map((c) => c['id']).whereType<int>().toSet();
          final effectiveParentId =
              parentIds.contains(selectedParentId) ? selectedParentId : null;

          final parent = effectiveParentId != null
              ? categories.firstWhere(
                  (c) => c['id'] == effectiveParentId,
                  orElse: () => {},
                )
              : {};
          final children = _uniqueById(_asMapList(parent['children'] as List?));

          final childIds =
              children.map((c) => c['id']).whereType<int>().toSet();
          // Filter out subcategory IDs that no longer belong to selected parent
          selectedSubCategoryIds = selectedSubCategoryIds.intersection(
            childIds,
          );

          return AlertDialog(
            backgroundColor: _cardColor(ctx),
            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
            ),
            title: Text(
              isEditing ? 'Edit Item Kasbon' : 'Tambah Item Kasbon',
              style: TextStyle(color: _creamColor(ctx)),
            ),
            content: SizedBox(
              width: screenWidth > 600 ? 500 : screenWidth * 0.9,
              child: Builder(
                builder: (ctx2) {
                  final dialogScrollCtrl = ScrollController();
                  return AppScrollbar(
                    controller: dialogScrollCtrl,
                    thumbVisibility: true,
                    interactive: true,
                    child: SingleChildScrollView(
                      controller: dialogScrollCtrl,
                      child: Column(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          const SizedBox(
                            height: 10,
                          ), // Ruang ekstra agar label terbaca
                          // dropdown kategori utama
                          DropdownButtonFormField<int>(
                            decoration: const InputDecoration(
                              labelText: 'Kategori Utama',
                              contentPadding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                                horizontal: 12,
                                vertical: 14,
                              ),
                            ),
                            isExpanded: true,

                          const SizedBox(height: 12),
                          // mata uang
                          Row(
                            children: [
                              Expanded(
                                flex: 2,
                                child: DropdownButtonFormField<String>(
                                  decoration: const InputDecoration(

                                  dropdownColor: _cardColor(ctx),
                                  style: TextStyle(color: _primaryText(ctx)),
                                  initialValue: selectedCurrency,
                                  items: const [
                                    DropdownMenuItem(

                                      child: Text('IDR'),
                                    ),

                                      value: 'USD',

                                      child: Text('EUR'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'GBP',
                                      child: Text('GBP'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'JPY',
                                      child: Text('JPY'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'CNY',
                                      child: Text('CNY'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'AUD',
                                      child: Text('AUD'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'HKD',
                                      child: Text('HKD'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'SGD',
                                      child: Text('SGD'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'TWD',
                                      child: Text('TWD'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(
                                      value: 'THB',
                                      child: Text('THB'),
                                    ),
                                    DropdownMenuItem(

                                      child: Text('MYR'),

                                  onChanged: (v) => setDialogState(() {

                                    if (selectedCurrency == 'IDR') {
