@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/start_revision", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def start_revision(advance_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403
    if advance.status != "approved":
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Revisi hanya bisa dibuat dari kasbon yang sudah disetujui"}
        ), 400
    if advance.active_revision_no:
        return jsonify({"error": "Masih ada revisi yang belum selesai"}), 400

    advance.active_revision_no = _next_revision_no(advance)
    advance.status = "revision_draft"
    db.session.commit()

    # Notify managers about revision
    from routes.notifications import notify_managers

    message = f"{advance.requester.full_name} memulai revisi kasbon: {advance.title} (Revisi #{advance.active_revision_no})"
    notify_managers(
        "start_revision",
        "advance",
        advance.id,
        message,
        user_id,
        f"/advances/{advance.id}",
    )

    return jsonify({"advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True)}), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/items", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def add_advance_item(advance_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    editable_revision_no = _editable_revision_no(advance)
    if editable_revision_no is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "Kasbon saat ini tidak dalam mode edit"}), 400

    # Set modified flag
    advance.modified_t1 = True

    # Support both category_id (legacy) and category_ids (list)
    category_id = request.form.get("category_id")
    category_ids_raw = request.form.get("category_ids")
    category_ids = []
    if category_ids_raw:
        try:
            category_ids = json.loads(category_ids_raw)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if not category_ids and category_id:
        category_ids = [int(category_id)]

    description = request.form.get("description", "").strip()
    estimated_amount = request.form.get("estimated_amount")
    date_str = request.form.get("date")
    source = request.form.get("source", "").strip() or None
    currency = request.form.get("currency", "IDR").strip().upper() or "IDR"
    currency_exchange_str = request.form.get("currency_exchange", "1")

    if not all([category_ids, description, estimated_amount]):
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Semua field wajib diisi (termasuk sub-kategori)"}
        ), 400

    # Validasi kategori: semua harus di bawah parent yang sama
    categories = Category.query.filter(Category.id.in_(category_ids)).all()
    if len(categories) != len(category_ids):
        return jsonify({"error": "Salah satu kategori tidak ditemukan"}), 404

    parent_ids = {c.parent_id for c in categories}
    if len(parent_ids) > 1:
        return jsonify(
            {
                "error": "Semua sub-kategori harus berada di bawah kategori utama yang sama"
            }
        ), 400

    primary_category_id = category_ids[0]

    try:
        estimated_amount = float(estimated_amount)
        if estimated_amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError()
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return jsonify({"error": "Jumlah harus angka positif"}), 400

    if advance.advance_type == "single":
        revision_items = _items_for_revision(advance, editable_revision_no or 0)
        if revision_items:
            return jsonify({"error": "Kasbon single hanya boleh memiliki 1 item"}), 400

    item_date = None
    if date_str:
        try:
            item_date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        except ValueError:
            pass

    try:
        currency_exchange = float(currency_exchange_str)
        if currency_exchange <= 0:
            currency_exchange = 1.0
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        currency_exchange = 1.0

    evidence_paths = []
    evidence_filenames = []

    if "evidence" in request.files:
        files = request.files.getlist("evidence")
        for file in files:
            if file and file.filename and allowed_file(file.filename):
                ext = file.filename.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower()
                unique_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
                now = datetime.now()
                year_month = f"{now.year}/{now.month:02d}"
                upload_dir = os.path.join(
                    current_app.config["UPLOAD_FOLDER"],
                    "receipts",
                    year_month,
                )
                os.makedirs(upload_dir, exist_ok=True)
                file.save(os.path.join(upload_dir, unique_name))
                evidence_paths.append(f"receipts/{year_month}/{unique_name}")
                evidence_filenames.append(file.filename)

    evidence_path = "|".join(evidence_paths) if evidence_paths else None
    evidence_filename = "|".join(evidence_filenames) if evidence_filenames else None

    item = AdvanceItem(
        advance_id=advance.id,
        category_id=primary_category_id,
        description=description,
        estimated_amount=estimated_amount,
        revision_no=editable_revision_no or 0,
        evidence_path=evidence_path,
        evidence_filename=evidence_filename,
        date=item_date,
        source=source,
        currency=currency,
        currency_exchange=currency_exchange,
    )
    if categories:
        item.subcategories = categories
    db.session.add(item)

    # Auto-sync title for single type
    if advance.advance_type == "single":
        advance.title = item.description

    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify(
        {"item": item.to_dict(), "advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True)}
    ), 201


@advances_bp.route("/items/<int:item_id>", methods=["PUT"])
@jwt_required()
def update_advance_item(item_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    item = AdvanceItem.query.get_or_404(item_id)
    advance = item.advance
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    editable_revision_no = _editable_revision_no(advance)

    # data handling: support both json and form-data
    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or request.form.to_dict()

    # edit rules:
    # - draft: full edit
    # - submitted: view only (except for checklist/status updates by manager)
    # - rejected: checklist items only
    is_submitted = advance.status in ("submitted", "revision_submitted")
    is_rejected = advance.status in ("rejected", "revision_rejected")

    # Fields allowed during submitted/rejected status for checklist purposes
    checklist_fields = {"notes", "status", "checked"}
    is_updating_checklist = set(data.keys()).issubset(checklist_fields)

    # Enforce draft mode for non-checklist updates (for both Staff and Manager)
    if not is_updating_checklist:
        if (
            editable_revision_no is None
            or (item.revision_no or 0) != editable_revision_no
        ):
            return jsonify(
                {
                    "error": "Item ini sudah terkunci. Masuk ke mode Draft untuk mengedit."
                }
            ), 400
        # Set modified flag
        advance.modified_t1 = True

    if is_submitted and not is_updating_checklist:
        return jsonify(
            {
                "error": "saat disubmit tidak bisa mengubah rincian data. Silakan Move to Draft terlebih dahulu."
            }
        ), 400

    if is_rejected and not is_updating_checklist:
        # rejected status: only allow updates to 'notes' or 'status'
        if any(
            k in data.keys()
            for k in [
                "category_id",
                "description",
                "estimated_amount",
                "date",
                "source",
                "currency",
                "currency_exchange",
            ]
        ):
            return jsonify(
                {"error": "saat rejected hanya bisa update checklist komentar."}
            ), 400

    if "category_ids" in data or "category_id" in data:
        cat_ids = data.get("category_ids")
        if not isinstance(cat_ids, list):
            try:
                cat_ids = json.loads(cat_ids)
            except Exception:
                cat_ids = [int(data["category_id"])] if "category_id" in data else []

        if cat_ids:
            new_cats = Category.query.filter(Category.id.in_(cat_ids)).all()
            if len(new_cats) != len(cat_ids):
                return jsonify({"error": "Salah satu kategori tidak ditemukan"}), 404

            # Validasi parent sama
            p_ids = {c.parent_id for c in new_cats}
            if len(p_ids) > 1:
                return jsonify(
                    {
                        "error": "Semua sub-kategori harus berada di bawah kategori utama yang sama"
                    }
                ), 400

            item.category_id = cat_ids[0]
            item.subcategories = new_cats
    if "description" in data:
        item.description = data["description"].strip()
    if "estimated_amount" in data:
        try:
            amount = float(data["estimated_amount"])
            if amount <= 0:
                raise ValueError()
            item.estimated_amount = amount
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return jsonify({"error": "Jumlah harus angka positif"}), 400
    if "date" in data:
        date_str = data["date"]
        if date_str:
            try:
                item.date = datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            except ValueError:
                pass
        else:
            item.date = None
    if "source" in data:
        item.source = data["source"].strip() or None
    if "currency" in data:
        item.currency = (data["currency"] or "IDR").strip().upper()
    if "currency_exchange" in data:
        try:
            ex = float(data["currency_exchange"])
            item.currency_exchange = ex if ex > 0 else 1.0
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            item.currency_exchange = 1.0
    if "notes" in data:
        item.notes = data["notes"]
    if "status" in data:
        item.status = data["status"]

    # Handle evidence file upload (jika ada file baru)
    existing_paths = []
    existing_filenames = []
    if "existing_evidence_paths" in data:
        try:
            existing_paths = json.loads(data["existing_evidence_paths"])
        except Exception:
            existing_paths = []
    if "existing_evidence_filenames" in data:
        try:
            existing_filenames = json.loads(data["existing_evidence_filenames"])
        except Exception:
            existing_filenames = []

    # Jika frontend tidak mengirim existing_paths (misal client lama),
    # maka kita asumsikan behavior lama (replace all jika ada file baru).
    # Namun jika dikirim (meskipun list kosong []), kita ikuti list tsb (bisa jadi user hapus semua).

    # Clean up deleted files (files in database but not in existing_paths)
    if "existing_evidence_paths" in data and item.evidence_path:
        old_paths = item.evidence_path.split("|")
        for op in old_paths:
            if op not in existing_paths:
                delete_evidence_file(op)

    new_paths = []
    new_filenames = []

    if "evidence" in request.files:
        files = request.files.getlist("evidence")

        for file in files:
            if file and file.filename and allowed_file(file.filename):
                # Only delete existing files once if we have at least one valid new file
                # AND if existing_evidence_paths was NOT provided (legacy behavior)
                if (
                    "existing_evidence_paths" not in data
                    and not new_paths
                    and item.evidence_path
                ):
                    delete_evidence_file(item.evidence_path)

                ext = file.filename.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower()
                unique_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
                now = datetime.now()
                year_month = f"{now.year}/{now.month:02d}"
                upload_dir = os.path.join(
                    current_app.config["UPLOAD_FOLDER"],
                    "receipts",
                    year_month,
                )
                os.makedirs(upload_dir, exist_ok=True)
                file.save(os.path.join(upload_dir, unique_name))
                new_paths.append(f"receipts/{year_month}/{unique_name}")
                new_filenames.append(file.filename)

    if new_paths or "existing_evidence_paths" in data:
        final_paths = existing_paths + new_paths
        final_filenames = existing_filenames + new_filenames

        item.evidence_path = "|".join(final_paths) if final_paths else None
        item.evidence_filename = "|".join(final_filenames) if final_filenames else None

    db.session.commit()

    # Auto-sync title for single type
    if advance.advance_type == "single":
        # Check if this is the first item or just always sync the edited item to title
        # For simplicity and since 'single' usually has one main meaningful item per revision,
        # we sync the current edited item's description if it's single.
        advance.title = item.description
        db.session.commit()

    return jsonify(
        {"item": item.to_dict(), "advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True)}
    ), 200


@advances_bp.route("/items/<int:item_id>", methods=["DELETE"])
@jwt_required()
def delete_advance_item(item_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    item = AdvanceItem.query.get_or_404(item_id)
    advance = item.advance
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    editable_revision_no = _editable_revision_no(advance)
    if not is_manager:
        if (
            editable_revision_no is None
            or (item.revision_no or 0) != editable_revision_no
        ):

                {"error": "Item ini sudah terkunci dan tidak bisa dihapus"}
            ), 400

    delete_evidence_file(item.evidence_path)

    db.session.delete(item)

        {"message": "Item dihapus", "advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True)}
    ), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/submit", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def submit_advance(advance_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    if advance.status in ("draft", "rejected"):
        revision_no = 0
        next_status = "submitted"
    elif advance.status in ("revision_draft", "revision_rejected"):
        revision_no = advance.active_revision_no
        next_status = "revision_submitted"
    else:
        return jsonify({"error": "Kasbon saat ini tidak bisa disubmit"}), 400

    if revision_no is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "Revisi belum aktif"}), 400

    revision_items = _items_for_revision(advance, revision_no)
    if len(revision_items) == 0:
        return jsonify({"error": "Tambahkan minimal 1 item pengeluaran"}), 400
    unresolved_item = next(
        (item for item in revision_items if _has_unchecked_checklist(item)),
        None,
    )
    if unresolved_item:
        return jsonify(
            {
                "error": f'Item "{unresolved_item.description}" masih memiliki komentar revisi yang belum dicentang.'
            }
        ), 400

    advance.status = next_status

    # Auto-submit Table 3 if it has data and is still pending or was rejected
    if (advance.returned_amount or 0) > 0:
        if advance.return_status in ("pending", "rejected"):
            # Validasi checklist jika pernah ditolak
            if advance.return_status == "rejected" and _has_unchecked_return_checklist(
                advance
            ):
                return jsonify(
                    {
                        "error": "Tabel Pengembalian Dana masih memiliki komentar revisi yang belum dicentang."
                    }
                ), 400
            advance.return_status = "submitted"

    # Identify which tables were modified for notification
    modified_parts = []
    if advance.modified_t1:
        modified_parts.append("Tabel 1 (Rincian)")
    if advance.modified_t2:
        modified_parts.append("Tabel 2 (Pengiriman)")
    if advance.modified_t3:
        modified_parts.append("Tabel 3 (Pengembalian)")

    parts_str = ", ".join(modified_parts) if modified_parts else "Update Header/Lainnya"

    # Reset tracking flags after successful submission
    advance.modified_t1 = False
    advance.modified_t2 = False
    advance.modified_t3 = False

    db.session.commit()

    # Notify managers
    message = f"{user.full_name} melakukan submit kasbon: {advance.title} (Pembaruan: {parts_str})"
    notify_managers(
        "submit", "advance", advance.id, message, user_id, f"/advances/{advance.id}"
    )

    # Notify staff as confirmation
    notify_staff(
        advance.user_id,
        "submit_confirmation",
        "advance",
        advance.id,
        f'Kasbon "{advance.title}" Anda telah disubmit',
        user_id,
        f"/advances/{advance.id}",
    )

    return jsonify({"advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True)}), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/approve_all", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def approve_advance(advance_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)
    if advance.status not in ("submitted", "revision_submitted"):
        return jsonify({"error": "Kasbon ini tidak sedang menunggu approval"}), 400

    # Support both JSON and Form data
    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or request.form.to_dict()
    notes = data.get("notes", "").strip()

    if advance.status == "submitted":
        # Validasi checklist: semua item harus disetujui
        revision_no = 0
        items = _items_for_revision(advance, revision_no)
        for itm in items:
            if itm.status != "approved":
                return jsonify(
                    {
                        "error": f'Gagal approve: Item "{itm.description}" belum disetujui. '
                        "Semua item harus disetujui (Approved) secara individu terlebih dahulu."
                    }
                ), 400

        advance.approved_revision_no = 0
        advance.active_revision_no = None
        advance.status = _status_after_approval(advance)
    else:
        revision_no = advance.active_revision_no
        if revision_no is None:
            return jsonify({"error": "Nomor revisi tidak ditemukan"}), 400

        # Validasi checklist untuk revisi
        items = _items_for_revision(advance, revision_no)
        for itm in items:
            if itm.status != "approved":
                return jsonify(
                    {
                        "error": f'Gagal approve: Item "{itm.description}" belum disetujui (revisi {revision_no}). '
                        "Semua item harus disetujui (Approved) secara individu terlebih dahulu."
                    }
                ), 400

        advance.approved_revision_no = revision_no
        advance.active_revision_no = None
        advance.status = _status_after_approval(advance)
        # Immediate cleanup for Advance deadline notification
        Notification.query.filter_by(
            target_type="advance", target_id=advance.id, action_type="deadline_warning"
        ).delete()

    if notes:
        advance.notes = _merge_rejection_notes_advance(advance.notes or "", notes)

    advance.approved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    db.session.commit()

    # Notify staff
    message = f"Kasbon Anda telah disetujui: {advance.title}"
    notify_staff(
        advance.user_id,
        "approve",
        "advance",
        advance.id,
        message,
        user.id,
        f"/advances/{advance.id}",
    )

    return jsonify({"advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True)}), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/reject_all", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def reject_advance(advance_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)
    if advance.status not in ("submitted", "revision_submitted"):
        return jsonify({"error": "Kasbon ini tidak sedang menunggu approval"}), 400

    # Support both JSON and Form data
    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or request.form.to_dict()
    notes = str(data.get("notes", "")).strip()
    if not notes:
        return jsonify({"error": "Alasan penolakan wajib diisi"}), 400

    if advance.status == "submitted":
        revision_no = 0
        advance.status = "draft"
    else:
        revision_no = advance.active_revision_no
        advance.status = "revision_draft"

    if revision_no is None:
        return jsonify({"error": "Nomor revisi tidak ditemukan"}), 400

    for item in _items_for_revision(advance, revision_no):
        if item.status in ("pending", "approved"):
            item.status = "rejected"
            item.notes = _merge_rejection_notes_advance(item.notes or "", notes)

    advance.notes = _merge_rejection_notes_advance(advance.notes or "", notes)
    # Immediate cleanup for Advance deadline notification (back to draft)
    Notification.query.filter_by(
        target_type="advance", target_id=advance.id, action_type="deadline_warning"
    ).delete()
    db.session.commit()

    # Notify staff
    message = f"Kasbon Anda telah ditolak: {advance.title}. Alasan: {notes}"
    notify_staff(
        advance.user_id,
        "reject",
        "advance",
        advance.id,
        message,
        user.id,
        f"/advances/{advance.id}",
    )

    return jsonify({"advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True)}), 200

def _merge_rejection_notes_advance(old_notes_str, new_notes_str):
    """Gabungkan komentar reject baru ke checklist lama (append)."""
    import json as json_mod

    old_list: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    # 1. Parse old notes
    if old_notes_str and str(old_notes_str).strip().startswith("["):
        try:
            parsed_old = json_mod.loads(str(old_notes_str))
            if isinstance(parsed_old, list):
                for item in parsed_old:
                    if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
                        old_list.append(
                            {
                                "text": str(item["text"]),
                                "checked": bool(item.get("checked", False)),
                            }
                        )
                    elif isinstance(item, str):
                        old_list.append({"text": str(item), "checked": False})
            else:
                old_list = [{"text": str(old_notes_str), "checked": False}]
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            old_list = [{"text": str(old_notes_str), "checked": False}]
    elif old_notes_str:
        old_list = [{"text": str(old_notes_str).strip(), "checked": False}]

    # 2. Parse new notes - check if it's already JSON
    if new_notes_str and str(new_notes_str).strip().startswith("["):
        try:
            new_list = json_mod.loads(str(new_notes_str))
            if isinstance(new_list, list):
                for item in new_list:
                    if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
                        old_list.append(
                            {
                                "text": str(item["text"]),
                                "checked": bool(item.get("checked", False)),
                            }
                        )
                    elif isinstance(item, str):
                        old_list.append({"text": str(item), "checked": False})
                return json_mod.dumps(old_list)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 3. Fallback: treat as plain text
    new_reasons = [
        line.strip() for line in str(new_notes_str).strip().split("\n") if line.strip()
    ]
    for r in new_reasons:
        old_list.append({"text": str(r), "checked": False})
    return json_mod.dumps(old_list)


@advances_bp.route("/items/<int:item_id>/reject", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def reject_advance_item(item_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    item = AdvanceItem.query.get_or_404(item_id)
    advance = item.advance
    if advance.status not in ("submitted", "revision_submitted"):
        return jsonify({"error": "Kasbon ini tidak sedang menunggu approval"}), 400

    data = request.get_json(silent=True) or request.form.to_dict()
    notes = data.get("notes", "").strip()
    if not notes:
        return jsonify({"error": "Alasan penolakan wajib diisi"}), 400

    item.status = "rejected"
    item.notes = _merge_rejection_notes_advance(item.notes or "", notes)
    # ✅ FIX: Jangan auto-draft parent kasbon saat satu item ditolak.
    # Status parent tetap 'submitted'/'revision_submitted' agar manager bisa lanjut review item lain.
    # Draft hanya bisa diubah secara manual oleh pemilik melalui tombol "Move to Draft".
    db.session.commit()

    # Notify staff about item rejection
    from routes.notifications import notify_staff

    message = f"Item kasbon ditolak: {item.description}"
    notify_staff(
        advance.user_id,
        "reject_item",
        "advance_item",
        item.id,
        message,
        user.id,
        f"/advances/{advance.id}",
    )

    return jsonify({"item": item.to_dict()}), 200

def bulk_delete_advance_items():

    user = User.query.get(user_id)

    item_ids = data.get("item_ids", [])

    if not item_ids:
        return jsonify({"error": "Daftar ID item kosong"}), 400

    items = AdvanceItem.query.filter(AdvanceItem.id.in_(item_ids)).all()
    count = 0

    for item in items:
        advance = item.advance
        can_delete = False
        if user.role == "manager":
            can_delete = True
        else:
            if advance.user_id == user_id and advance.status in (
                "draft",
                "rejected",
                "revision_draft",
                "revision_rejected",
            ):
                can_delete = True

        if can_delete:
            delete_evidence_file(item.evidence_path)

            db.session.delete(item)
            count += 1

    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({"message": f"{count} item berhasil dihapus"}), 200

@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/save-disbursement", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def save_disbursement(advance_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    if advance.status not in (
        "draft",
        "revision_draft",
        "rejected",
        "revision_rejected",
    ):
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Tabel ini hanya bisa diubah dalam mode Draft atau Revisi."}
        ), 400

    # Set modified flag
    advance.modified_t2 = True

    data = (
        request.form.to_dict()
        if request.form
        else (request.get_json(silent=True) or {})
    )

    if "bank_id" in data:
        advance.bank_id = data["bank_id"]
    if "disbursement_source" in data:
        advance.disbursement_source = str(data["disbursement_source"]).strip() or None
        advance.bank_id = None
    if "admin_fee" in data:
        advance.admin_fee = float(data["admin_fee"])
    if "disbursement_comment" in data:
        advance.disbursement_comment = str(data["disbursement_comment"]).strip() or None
    if "disbursed_amount" in data:
        advance.disbursed_amount = float(data["disbursed_amount"])
        # Auto-calculate returned_amount if excess
        approved_total = sum(
            (item.idr_amount or 0)
            for item in advance.items
            if (item.revision_no or 0) <= (advance.approved_revision_no or 0)
            and item.status == "approved"
        )
        if advance.disbursed_amount != approved_total:
            advance.returned_amount = abs(advance.disbursed_amount - approved_total)
        else:
            advance.returned_amount = 0.0
            advance.return_source = None
            advance.is_return_approved = False  # Reset if no return needed

    # Handle Evidence (Merging Existing + New)
    existing_paths = []
    existing_filenames = []

    if "existing_disbursement_evidence_paths" in data:
        try:
            existing_paths = json.loads(data["existing_disbursement_evidence_paths"])
        except Exception:
            existing_paths = []

    if "existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames" in data:
        try:
            existing_filenames = json.loads(
                data["existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames"]
            )
        except Exception:
            existing_filenames = []

    new_paths = []
    new_filenames = []
    if "evidence" in request.files:
        files = request.files.getlist("evidence")
        for file in files:
            if file and file.filename and allowed_file(file.filename):
                ext = file.filename.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower()
                unique_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
                now = datetime.now()
                year_month = f"{now.year}/{now.month:02d}"
                upload_dir = os.path.join(
                    current_app.config["UPLOAD_FOLDER"], "receipts", year_month
                )
                os.makedirs(upload_dir, exist_ok=True)
                file.save(os.path.join(upload_dir, unique_name))
                new_paths.append(f"receipts/{year_month}/{unique_name}")
                new_filenames.append(file.filename)

    final_paths = existing_paths + new_paths
    final_filenames = existing_filenames + new_filenames

    advance.disbursement_evidence_path = "|".join(final_paths) if final_paths else None
    advance.disbursement_evidence_filename = (
        "|".join(final_filenames) if final_filenames else None
    )

    db.session.commit()
    db.session.refresh(advance)
    return jsonify(
        {"message": "Data pengiriman berhasil disimpan", "advance": advance.to_dict()}
    ), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/save-return", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def save_return(advance_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    if user.role != "manager" and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    if advance.status not in (
        "draft",
        "revision_draft",
        "rejected",
        "revision_rejected",
    ):
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Tabel ini hanya bisa diubah dalam mode Draft atau Revisi."}
        ), 400

    # Set modified flag
    advance.modified_t3 = True

    if advance.return_status == "submitted" and user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Data sedang disubmit, tidak bisa diubah. Tunggu review manager."}
        ), 400

    data = (
        request.form.to_dict()
        if request.form
        else (request.get_json(silent=True) or {})
    )

    if "returned_amount" in data:
        advance.returned_amount = float(data["returned_amount"])
    if "return_source" in data:
        advance.return_source = str(data["return_source"]).strip() or None
    if "return_description" in data:
        advance.return_description = str(data["return_description"]).strip() or None

    if advance.returned_amount and not (advance.return_source or "").strip():
        advance.return_source = (
            str(advance.disbursement_source).strip()
            if advance.disbursement_source
            else None
        )

    if not advance.returned_amount:
        advance.return_source = None

    # Reset status ke pending jika sedang rejected atau submitted (saat ditarik kembali/diedit)
    if advance.return_status in ("rejected", "submitted"):
        advance.return_status = "pending"

    # Handle Evidence (Merging Existing + New)
    existing_paths = []
    existing_filenames = []

    if "existing_return_evidence_paths" in data:
        try:
            existing_paths = json.loads(data["existing_return_evidence_paths"])
        except Exception:
            existing_paths = []

    if "existing_return_evidence_filenames" in data:
        try:
            existing_filenames = json.loads(data["existing_return_evidence_filenames"])
        except Exception:
            existing_filenames = []

    new_paths = []
    new_filenames = []
    if "return_evidence" in request.files:
        files = request.files.getlist("return_evidence")
        for file in files:
            if file and file.filename and allowed_file(file.filename):
                ext = file.filename.rsplit(".", 1)[1].lower()
                unique_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}.{ext}"
                now = datetime.now()
                year_month = f"{now.year}/{now.month:02d}"
                upload_dir = os.path.join(
                    current_app.config["UPLOAD_FOLDER"], "receipts", year_month
                )
                os.makedirs(upload_dir, exist_ok=True)
                file.save(os.path.join(upload_dir, unique_name))
                new_paths.append(f"receipts/{year_month}/{unique_name}")
                new_filenames.append(file.filename)

    final_paths = existing_paths + new_paths
    final_filenames = existing_filenames + new_filenames

    advance.return_evidence_path = "|".join(final_paths) if final_paths else None
    advance.return_evidence_filename = (
        "|".join(final_filenames) if final_filenames else None
    )

    db.session.commit()
    db.session.refresh(advance)
    return jsonify(
        {"message": "Data pengembalian berhasil disimpan", "advance": advance.to_dict()}
    ), 200

    return jsonify({"advance": advance.to_dict()}), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/final_approve", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def final_approve_advance(advance_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)
    if advance.status not in (
        "submitted",
        "revision_submitted",
        "approved",
    ):
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Kasbon ini tidak dalam status untuk final approval"}
        ), 400

    # Sequential Gating Check
    if advance.status in ("submitted", "revision_submitted"):
        for item in advance.items:
            if item.status == "pending":
                item.status = "approved"
        advance.status = "approved"

    for item in advance.items:
        if item.status == "pending":
            return jsonify({"error": f'Item "{item.description}" masih pending'}), 400

    if not advance.is_disbursement_approved:
        return jsonify({"error": "Tabel Pengiriman Dana belum disetujui"}), 400

    # Removed Table 3 requirement for advances
    # if advance.returned_amount > 0 and not advance.is_return_approved:
    #     return jsonify({"error": "Tabel Pengembalian Dana belum disetujui"}), 400

    # Finalize
    advance.status = "completed"
    advance.approved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    # Otomatis catat mutasi keluar di BankTransaction
    if advance.bank_id:
        requester_name = (
            advance.requester.full_name if advance.requester else "User dihapus"
        )

        # 1. Disbursement Transaction
        if advance.disbursed_amount and advance.disbursed_amount > 0:
            transaction = BankTransaction(
                bank_id=advance.bank_id,
                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Pengiriman Dana Kasbon: {advance.title} (User: {requester_name})",
                amount_idr=advance.disbursed_amount,
                amount_usd=0.0,
                transaction_type="expense",
                group_name="Pengiriman Dana Kasbon",
                report_year=advance.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(transaction)

        # 2. Return Transaction (Income)
        if advance.returned_amount and advance.returned_amount > 0:
            return_transaction = BankTransaction(
                bank_id=advance.bank_id,
                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Kembalian Sisa Dana Kasbon: {advance.title} (User: {requester_name})",
                amount_idr=advance.returned_amount,
                transaction_type="income",
                group_name="Pengembalian Sisa Dana",
                report_year=advance.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(return_transaction)

        # 3. Admin Fee Transaction
        if advance.admin_fee and advance.admin_fee > 0:
            admin_transaction = BankTransaction(
                bank_id=advance.bank_id,
                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Biaya Admin Bank - Kasbon: {advance.title}",
                amount_idr=advance.admin_fee,
                transaction_type="expense",
                group_name="Biaya Admin Bank",
                report_year=advance.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(admin_transaction)

    db.session.commit()
    notify_staff(
        advance.user_id,
        "approve_final",
        "advance",
        advance.id,
        f"Kasbon '{advance.title}' telah disetujui final oleh Manager.",
        user.id,
        f"/advances/{advance.id}",
    )

    return jsonify(
        {"message": "Kasbon berhasil disetujui final", "advance": advance.to_dict()}
    ), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/override", methods=["PUT"])
@jwt_required()
def override_advance(advance_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify(

    data = request.get_json()

@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/move_to_draft", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def move_advance_to_draft(advance_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    if advance.status in ("submitted", "rejected", "approved", "completed"):
        advance.status = "draft"
    elif advance.status in ("revision_submitted", "revision_rejected"):
        advance.status = "revision_draft"
    else:
        return jsonify(
            {"error": f"Status {advance.status} tidak bisa ditarik ke draft"}
        ), 400

    # Reset tracking flags when moving back to draft
    advance.modified_t1 = False
    advance.modified_t2 = False
    advance.modified_t3 = False

    # Also pull back Table 3 to pending if it was submitted
    if advance.return_status == "submitted":
        advance.return_status = "pending"

    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify(
        {
            "message": "Kasbon ditarik ke draft",
            "advance": advance.to_dict(include_items=True),
        }
    ), 200

  static const Duration _requestTimeout = Duration(seconds: 10);
  static const int _maxRetries = 1;

  /// Helper untuk build URL dengan query parameters menggunakan StringBuffer
  static String _buildUrl(String baseUrl, List<String> params) {
    if (params.isEmpty) return baseUrl;
    final buffer = StringBuffer(baseUrl);
    buffer.write('?');
    buffer.write(params.join('&'));
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  /// Helper untuk retry request jika terjadi connection reset
  static Future<http.Response> _retryRequest(
    Future<http.Response> Function() requestFn,
  ) async {
    int attempts = 0;
    Exception lastException = Exception('Unknown error');

    while (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
      try {
        return await requestFn().timeout(_requestTimeout);
      } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Connection error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on TimeoutException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Request timeout: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on HttpException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('HTTP error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on SocketException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Network error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Unexpected error: $e');
        rethrow;
      }

      if (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
        await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: 500 * attempts));
      }
    }

    throw lastException;
  }

    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);
    request.fields['settlement_id'] = settlementId.toString();

    if (categoryIds != null && categoryIds.isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['category_ids'] = jsonEncode(categoryIds);
    }
    request.fields['description'] = description;
    request.fields['amount'] = amount.toString();
    request.fields['date'] = date;
    if (source != null && source.isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['source'] = source;
    }
    request.fields['currency'] = currency;
    request.fields['currency_exchange'] = currencyExchange.toString();

    if (filePaths != null && filePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in filePaths) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    String? disbursementComment,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (disbursementComment != null &&
        disbursementComment.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_comment'] = disbursementComment.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> approveDisbursementAdvance(int advanceId) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(
          json.decode(response.body)['error'] ?? 'Gagal menyetujui pengiriman');
    }
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveReturnSettlement({
    required int settlementId,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnSource,
    String? returnDescription,
    List<File>? returnEvidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/settlements/$settlementId/save-return'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnSource != null && returnSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_source'] = returnSource.trim();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null && returnDescription.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription.trim();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (returnEvidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in returnEvidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'return_evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> finalApproveAdvance(
    int id, {
    required int bankId,
    double adminFee = 0.0,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnDescription,
    String? disbursementDescription,
    DateTime? disbursementDate,
    DateTime? returnDate,
    List<String>? evidencePaths,
    List<String>? returnEvidencePaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementPaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementFilenames,
    List<String>? existingReturnPaths,
    List<String>? existingReturnFilenames,
  }) async {
    var request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$id/final_approve'),
    );
    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);

    request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDescription != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_description'] = disbursementDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDate != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_date'] = disbursementDate.toIso8601String();
    }
    if (returnDate != null) {
      request.fields['return_date'] = returnDate.toIso8601String();
    }

    if (existingDisbursementPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingDisbursementFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementFilenames,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnFilenames,
      );
    }

    if (evidencePaths != null && evidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in evidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    if (returnEvidencePaths != null && returnEvidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in returnEvidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  // helpers

  Map<String, dynamic> _handleResponse(http.Response res) {
    if (res.statusCode == 429) {
      String msg = 'Terlalu banyak permintaan. Mohon tunggu sebentar.';
      try {
        final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
        msg = body['error'] ?? body['message'] ?? msg;
      } catch (_) {}
      throw Exception(msg);
    }

    if (res.statusCode == 413) {
      throw Exception('File terlalu besar (Maks 16MB)');
    }

    // Handle 401 Unauthorized - token expired
    if (res.statusCode == 401) {
      throw Exception('Sesi expired. Silakan login kembali.');
    }

    // Handle empty body
    if (res.body.trim().isEmpty) {
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return {};
      }
      throw Exception('Server Error: ${res.statusCode}');
    }

    try {
      final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return body;
      }
      throw Exception(body['error'] ?? 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${res.statusCode}');
    } on FormatException {
      throw Exception('Server Error ${res.statusCode}: Respon tidak valid');
    }
  }

  String _networkHint(String message) {
    if (!kIsWeb && Platform.isAndroid) {
      if (_configuredBaseUrl.isEmpty) {
        return '$message. Pastikan: (1) Backend Flask running, (2) HP & PC di WiFi yang sama, (3) IP address benar';
      }
      return '$message. Periksa: (1) Flask backend aktif, (2) WiFi sama, (3) Firewall tidak blokir port 5000';
    }
    return '$message. Periksa backend aktif di $baseUrl';
  }
}

class ApiService {
  static const String _configuredBaseUrl = String.fromEnvironment(
    'API_BASE_URL',
    defaultValue: '',
  );
  static const String _baseUrlPrefsKey = 'api_base_url';
  static String? _runtimeBaseUrl;

  static const Duration _requestTimeout = Duration(seconds: 10);
  static const int _maxRetries = 1;

  /// Helper untuk build URL dengan query parameters menggunakan StringBuffer
  static String _buildUrl(String baseUrl, List<String> params) {
    if (params.isEmpty) return baseUrl;
    final buffer = StringBuffer(baseUrl);
    buffer.write('?');
    buffer.write(params.join('&'));
    return buffer.toString();
  }

  /// Helper untuk retry request jika terjadi connection reset
  static Future<http.Response> _retryRequest(
    Future<http.Response> Function() requestFn,
  ) async {
    int attempts = 0;
    Exception lastException = Exception('Unknown error');

    while (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
      try {
        return await requestFn().timeout(_requestTimeout);
      } on http.ClientException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Connection error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on TimeoutException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Request timeout: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on HttpException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('HTTP error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } on SocketException catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Network error: ${e.message}');
        attempts++;
      } catch (e) {
        lastException = Exception('Unexpected error: $e');
        rethrow;
      }

      if (attempts <= _maxRetries) {
        await Future.delayed(Duration(milliseconds: 500 * attempts));
      }
    }

    throw lastException;
  }

  static Future<void> saveBaseUrl(String url) async {
    if (_configuredBaseUrl.isNotEmpty) {
      return;

    final normalized = url.trim().replaceAll(RegExp(r'/$'), '');
    final prefs = await SharedPreferences.getInstance();
    if (normalized.isEmpty) {
      _runtimeBaseUrl = null;
      await prefs.remove(_baseUrlPrefsKey);

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> getAdvances({

    String? startDate,
    String? endDate,
    int? reportYear,

    String? type,

  }) async {
    final params = <String>[];
    if (status != null) params.add('status=$status');
    if (startDate != null) params.add('start_date=$startDate');
    if (endDate != null) params.add('end_date=$endDate');
    if (reportYear != null) params.add('report_year=$reportYear');
    if (mode != null) params.add('mode=$mode');
    if (type != null) params.add('type=$type');
    if (search != null && search.isNotEmpty) {
      params.add('search=${Uri.encodeComponent(search)}');
    }

    final url = _buildUrl('$baseUrl/advances', params);
    final res = await http.get(Uri.parse(url), headers: _headers);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> saveDisbursementAdvance({
    required int advanceId,
    int? bankId,
    String? disbursementSource,
    String? disbursementComment,
    double? adminFee,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    List<File>? evidenceFiles,
    List<String>? existingFilePaths,
    List<String>? existingFileNames,
  }) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/save-disbursement'),
    );
    if (_token != null) request.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer $_token';

    if (bankId != null) request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    if (disbursementSource != null && disbursementSource.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_source'] = disbursementSource.trim();
    }
    if (disbursementComment != null &&
        disbursementComment.trim().isNotEmpty) {
      request.fields['disbursement_comment'] = disbursementComment.trim();
    }
    if (adminFee != null) request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }

    if (existingFilePaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] =
          json.encode(existingFilePaths);
    }
    if (existingFileNames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] =
          json.encode(existingFileNames);
    }

    if (evidenceFiles != null) {
      for (var file in evidenceFiles) {
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath(
          'evidence',
          file.path,
        ));
      }
    }

    final response = await _retryRequest(() async {
      final streamedResponse = await request.send();
      return await http.Response.fromStream(streamedResponse);
    });

    return _handleResponse(response);
  }

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> approveDisbursementAdvance(int advanceId) async {
    await ensureTokenLoaded();
    final response = await _retryRequest(() => http.post(
          Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$advanceId/approve-disbursement'),
          headers: _headers,
        ));
    if (response.statusCode == 200) {
      return json.decode(response.body);
    } else {
      throw Exception(

  Future<Map<String, dynamic>> finalApproveAdvance(
    int id, {
    required int bankId,
    double adminFee = 0.0,
    double? disbursedAmount,
    double? returnedAmount,
    String? returnDescription,
    String? disbursementDescription,
    DateTime? disbursementDate,
    DateTime? returnDate,
    List<String>? evidencePaths,
    List<String>? returnEvidencePaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementPaths,
    List<String>? existingDisbursementFilenames,
    List<String>? existingReturnPaths,
    List<String>? existingReturnFilenames,
  }) async {
    var request = http.MultipartRequest(
      'POST',
      Uri.parse('$baseUrl/advances/$id/final_approve'),
    );
    request.headers.addAll(_authHeaders);

    request.fields['bank_id'] = bankId.toString();
    request.fields['admin_fee'] = adminFee.toString();
    if (disbursedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['disbursed_amount'] = disbursedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnedAmount != null) {
      request.fields['returned_amount'] = returnedAmount.toString();
    }
    if (returnDescription != null) {
      request.fields['return_description'] = returnDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDescription != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_description'] = disbursementDescription;
    }
    if (disbursementDate != null) {
      request.fields['disbursement_date'] = disbursementDate.toIso8601String();
    }
    if (returnDate != null) {
      request.fields['return_date'] = returnDate.toIso8601String();
    }

    if (existingDisbursementPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingDisbursementFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_disbursement_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingDisbursementFilenames,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnPaths != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_paths'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnPaths,
      );
    }
    if (existingReturnFilenames != null) {
      request.fields['existing_return_evidence_filenames'] = jsonEncode(
        existingReturnFilenames,
      );
    }

    if (evidencePaths != null && evidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in evidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('evidence', path));
      }
    }

    if (returnEvidencePaths != null && returnEvidencePaths.isNotEmpty) {
      for (var path in returnEvidencePaths) {
        if (path.startsWith('receipts/')) continue;
        request.files.add(
          await http.MultipartFile.fromPath('return_evidence', path),
        );
      }
    }

    final streamedRes = await request.send();
    final res = await http.Response.fromStream(streamedRes);
    return _handleResponse(res);
  }

  // helpers

  Map<String, dynamic> _handleResponse(http.Response res) {
    if (res.statusCode == 429) {
      String msg = 'Terlalu banyak permintaan. Mohon tunggu sebentar.';
      try {
        final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
        msg = body['error'] ?? body['message'] ?? msg;
      } catch (_) {}
      throw Exception(msg);
    }

    if (res.statusCode == 413) {
      throw Exception('File terlalu besar (Maks 16MB)');
    }

    // Handle 401 Unauthorized - token expired
    if (res.statusCode == 401) {
      throw Exception('Sesi expired. Silakan login kembali.');
    }

    // Handle empty body
    if (res.body.trim().isEmpty) {
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return {};
      }
      throw Exception('Server Error: ${res.statusCode}');
    }

    try {
      final body = jsonDecode(res.body);
      if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) {
        return body;
      }
      throw Exception(body['error'] ?? 'Terjadi kesalahan: ${res.statusCode}');
    } on FormatException {
      throw Exception('Server Error ${res.statusCode}: Respon tidak valid');
    }
  }

  String _networkHint(String message) {
    if (!kIsWeb && Platform.isAndroid) {
      if (_configuredBaseUrl.isEmpty) {
        return '$message. Pastikan: (1) Backend Flask running, (2) HP & PC di WiFi yang sama, (3) IP address benar';
      }
      return '$message. Periksa: (1) Flask backend aktif, (2) WiFi sama, (3) Firewall tidak blokir port 5000';
    }
    return '$message. Periksa backend aktif di $baseUrl';
  }
}

@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/approve_all", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def approve_advance(advance_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)
    if advance.status not in ("submitted", "revision_submitted"):
        return jsonify({"error": "Kasbon ini tidak sedang menunggu approval"}), 400

    settlement.completed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

            settlement.creator.full_name if settlement.creator else "User dihapus"

        if settlement.disbursed_amount and settlement.disbursed_amount > 0:

                amount_idr=settlement.disbursed_amount,
                amount_usd=0.0,
                transaction_type="expense",
                group_name="Pengiriman Dana Settlement",
                report_year=settlement.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(transaction)

        # 2. Return (Income)
        if settlement.returned_amount and settlement.returned_amount > 0:
            return_transaction = BankTransaction(
                bank_id=settlement.bank_id,
                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Kembalian Sisa Dana Settlement: {settlement.title} (User: {creator_name})",
                amount_idr=settlement.returned_amount,
                transaction_type="income",
                group_name="Pengembalian Sisa Dana",
                report_year=settlement.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )

        if settlement.admin_fee and settlement.admin_fee > 0:

                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Biaya Admin Bank - Settlement: {settlement.title}",
                amount_idr=settlement.admin_fee,
                transaction_type="expense",
                group_name="Biaya Admin Bank",
                report_year=settlement.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(admin_transaction)

    _sync_advance_after_settlement(settlement)

    notify_staff(

    return jsonify(

@settlements_bp.route("/<int:settlement_id>/move_to_draft", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def move_to_draft(settlement_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    settlement = Settlement.query.get_or_404(settlement_id)

    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and settlement.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify(
            {
                "error": "Akses ditolak: Hanya pemilik atau manager yang bisa mengubah ke draft"
            }
        ), 403

    if settlement.status not in ("submitted", "rejected", "approved", "completed"):
        return jsonify(
            {"error": f"Status {settlement.status} tidak bisa ditarik ke draft"}
        ), 400

    settlement.status = "draft"

    # Reset tracking flags
    settlement.modified_t1 = False
    settlement.modified_t2 = False
    settlement.modified_t3 = False

    # Also pull back Table 3 to pending if it was submitted
    if settlement.return_status == "submitted":
        settlement.return_status = "pending"

    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify(
        {
            "message": "Settlement berhasil dikembalikan ke draft",
            "settlement": settlement.to_dict(),
        }
    ), 200

    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

        "submitted",
        "revision_submitted",
        "approved",
    ):

            {"error": "Kasbon ini tidak dalam status untuk final approval"}
        ), 400

    # Sequential Gating Check
    if advance.status in ("submitted", "revision_submitted"):
        for item in advance.items:
            if item.status == "pending":
                item.status = "approved"
        advance.status = "approved"

    for item in advance.items:
        if item.status == "pending":
            return jsonify({"error": f'Item "{item.description}" masih pending'}), 400

    if not advance.is_disbursement_approved:

    # Finalize
    advance.status = "completed"
    advance.approved_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    # Otomatis catat mutasi keluar di BankTransaction
    if advance.bank_id:
        requester_name = (
            advance.requester.full_name if advance.requester else "User dihapus"
        )

        # 1. Disbursement Transaction
        if advance.disbursed_amount and advance.disbursed_amount > 0:
            transaction = BankTransaction(
                bank_id=advance.bank_id,
                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Pengiriman Dana Kasbon: {advance.title} (User: {requester_name})",
                amount_idr=advance.disbursed_amount,
                amount_usd=0.0,
                transaction_type="expense",
                group_name="Pengiriman Dana Kasbon",
                report_year=advance.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(transaction)

        # 2. Return Transaction (Income)
        if advance.returned_amount and advance.returned_amount > 0:
            return_transaction = BankTransaction(
                bank_id=advance.bank_id,
                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Kembalian Sisa Dana Kasbon: {advance.title} (User: {requester_name})",
                amount_idr=advance.returned_amount,
                transaction_type="income",
                group_name="Pengembalian Sisa Dana",
                report_year=advance.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(return_transaction)

        # 3. Admin Fee Transaction
        if advance.admin_fee and advance.admin_fee > 0:

                bank_id=advance.bank_id,
                date=datetime.now(timezone.utc).date(),
                description=f"Biaya Admin Bank - Kasbon: {advance.title}",

                transaction_type="expense",
                group_name="Biaya Admin Bank",
                report_year=advance.report_year or datetime.now().year,
            )
            db.session.add(admin_transaction)

@jwt_required()
def override_advance(advance_id):
    user = User.query.get(int(get_jwt_identity()))
    if user.role != "manager":
        return jsonify(
            {"error": "Akses ditolak. Hanya manager yang bisa override data final"}
        ), 403

    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)
    data = request.get_json()

    if "bank_id" in data:
        advance.bank_id = data["bank_id"]
    if "description" in data:
        advance.description = data["description"]
    if "status" in data:
        advance.status = data["status"]

    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify(
        {"message": "Data kasbon berhasil di-override", "advance": advance.to_dict()}
    ), 200


@advances_bp.route("/<int:advance_id>/move_to_draft", methods=["POST"])
@jwt_required()
def move_advance_to_draft(advance_id):
    user_id = int(get_jwt_identity())
    advance = Advance.query.get_or_404(advance_id)

    user = User.query.get(user_id)
    is_manager = user.role == "manager"

    if not is_manager and advance.user_id != user_id:
        return jsonify({"error": "Akses ditolak"}), 403

    if advance.status in ("submitted", "rejected", "approved", "completed"):
        advance.status = "draft"
    elif advance.status in ("revision_submitted", "revision_rejected"):
        advance.status = "revision_draft"
    else:
        return jsonify(
            {"error": f"Status {advance.status} tidak bisa ditarik ke draft"}
        ), 400

def _clone_row_format(ws, source_row, target_row, start_col=1, end_col=17):
    ws.row_dimensions[target_row].height = ws.row_dimensions[source_row].height
    for col in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        source_cell = ws.cell(row=source_row, column=col)
        target_cell = ws.cell(row=target_row, column=col)
        if isinstance(source_cell, MergedCell) or isinstance(target_cell, MergedCell):
            continue
        target_cell._style = copy(source_cell._style)
        target_cell.number_format = source_cell.number_format


def _replace_text_in_sheet(ws, search_text, replace_text):
    """
    Search and replace text in all cells of a worksheet.
    Used for updating headers like 'TAHUN 2024' -> 'TAHUN 2030'.
    """
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value and isinstance(cell.value, str):
                if search_text in cell.value:
                    cell.value = cell.value.replace(search_text, replace_text)


def _copy_template_row(
    ws, source_row, target_row, start_col=2, end_col=20, include_values=True
):
    if source_row == target_row:
        return

    _clear_merged_ranges_in_region(ws, target_row, target_row, start_col, end_col)
    ws.row_dimensions[target_row].height = ws.row_dimensions[source_row].height

    for col in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        target_cell = ws.cell(row=target_row, column=col)
        if isinstance(target_cell, MergedCell):
            continue
        target_cell.value = None

    for col in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        source_cell = ws.cell(row=source_row, column=col)
        target_cell = ws.cell(row=target_row, column=col)
        if isinstance(source_cell, MergedCell) or isinstance(target_cell, MergedCell):
            continue
        target_cell._style = copy(source_cell._style)
        target_cell.number_format = source_cell.number_format
        target_cell.font = copy(source_cell.font)
        target_cell.fill = copy(source_cell.fill)
        target_cell.border = copy(source_cell.border)
        target_cell.alignment = copy(source_cell.alignment)
        target_cell.protection = copy(source_cell.protection)
        target_cell.value = copy(source_cell.value) if include_values else None

    for merged_range in list(ws.merged_cells.ranges):
        min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = merged_range.bounds
        if min_row != source_row or max_row != source_row:
            continue
        if min_col < start_col or max_col > end_col:
            continue
        try:
            ws.merge_cells(
                start_row=target_row,
                start_column=min_col,
                end_row=target_row,
                end_column=max_col,
            )
        except Exception:
            pass


def _copy_template_row_from_backup(
    ws_backup,
    ws_target,
    source_row,
    target_row,

    include_values=True,
):

    for merged_range in list(ws_backup.merged_cells.ranges):

        if min_row != source_row or max_row != source_row:

        try:

def _sum_sheet_column_formula(sheet_ref, column_letter, start_row, end_row):

def _add_image_to_sheet(ws, img_path, anchor, width=None, height=None):
    """Safely add an image to an openpyxl worksheet."""
    if not os.path.exists(img_path):
        logger.warning(f"Image not found for Excel: {img_path}")
        return
    try:
        img = OpenpyxlImage(img_path)
        if width:
            img.width = width
        if height:
            img.height = height
        ws.add_image(img, anchor)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.error(f"Failed to add image {img_path} to Excel: {e}")


def _apply_autofit_sheet1(ws, last_col_idx):
    """
    Logika AutoFit Dinamis (Hanya Sheet 1):
    - Kolom A-Q: DIKUNCI MATI (Fixed) sesuai daftar MIN_WIDTHS agar presisi.
    - Kolom > Q (Kategori tambahan): Baru menggunakan AutoFit dinamis.
    """
    # Pastikan kita memproses minimal sampai kolom Q (17) untuk Table 1 & 2
    max_process_col = max(last_col_idx, 17)

    for col_idx in range(1, max_process_col + 1):
        col_letter = get_column_letter(col_idx)

        # 1. JIKA KOLOM TERDAFTAR DI MIN_WIDTHS (A-Q), PAKSA NILAINYA (FIXED)
        if col_letter in MIN_WIDTHS:
            ws.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = MIN_WIDTHS[col_letter]
            continue

        # 2. UNTUK KOLOM DINAMIS (> Q), BARU GUNAKAN LOGIKA AUTOFIT
        max_length = 0
        # Scan baris 6 sampai max_row
        for row in range(6, ws.max_row + 1):
            cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col_idx)

            # Skip if cell value is None or it's a merged cell (but not the top-left one)
            if cell.value is None or isinstance(cell, MergedCell):
                continue

            # Abaikan teks vertikal (seperti di Tabel 3 header Source, Currency, Rate)
            if cell.alignment and cell.alignment.text_rotation == 90:
                continue

            # Penanganan tanggal (visual format 11-Jan-24)
            if isinstance(cell.value, (datetime, date)):
                length = 11
            else:
                length = len(str(cell.value))

            if length > max_length:
                max_length = length

        # Hitung lebar akhir dengan 18.0 sebagai batas bawah untuk kategori tambahan
        ws.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = max(18.0, max_length * 1.1)

def _extract_subcategory_from_description(description):
    """Ekstrak sub-kategori dari deskripsi dengan format [SubCategory] Description"""
    if not description:
        return ""
    match = re.match(r"^\[(.*?)\]\s*", description.strip())
    if match:
        return match.group(1).strip()
    return ""


def _root_category_info(category_id, category_by_id):
    cat = category_by_id.get(category_id)
    if not cat:
        return "-", "-"
    subcategory_name = cat.name
    while cat.parent_id and category_by_id.get(cat.parent_id):
        cat = category_by_id[cat.parent_id]
    return cat.name or "-", subcategory_name or "-"


def _subcategory_sort_key(label):
    from .helpers import _safe_text

    text = _safe_text(label).strip()
    if not text or text == "-":
        return (1, "")
    return (0, text.lower())


def _apply_standard_cell_style(
    cell, style_type="data", bold=False, align="left", fill=None
):
    """Helper pusat untuk merampingkan styling sel Excel."""
    font_size = 12 if style_type == "header" else 11
    font_name = "Arial Narrow"
    cell.font = Font(
        bold=bold or (style_type in ("header", "total", "final")),
        size=font_size,
        name=font_name,
    )

    h_align = "center" if style_type == "header" else align
    cell.alignment = Alignment(
        horizontal=h_align, vertical="center", wrap_text=(style_type == "header")
    )

    s_thin = Side(style="thin", color="000000")
    s_double = Side(style="double", color="000000")

    top_s = s_thin if style_type in ("total", "final") else s_thin
    bottom_s = (
        s_double
        if style_type == "final"
        else (s_thin if style_type == "total" else s_thin)
    )

    cell.border = Border(left=s_thin, right=s_thin, top=top_s, bottom=bottom_s)

    if fill:
        cell.fill = fill
    elif style_type == "header":
        cell.fill = GREEN_FILL


def _clear_merged_ranges_in_region(ws, start_row, end_row, start_col, end_col):
    """Find and unmerge all ranges in the specified region."""
    ranges_to_unmerge = []
    for merged_range in list(ws.merged_cells.ranges):
        min_col, min_row, max_col, max_row = merged_range.bounds
        overlaps = not (
            max_row < start_row
            or min_row > end_row
            or max_col < start_col
            or min_col > end_col
        )
        if overlaps:
            ranges_to_unmerge.append(merged_range)

    for r_range in ranges_to_unmerge:
        try:
            ws.unmerge_cells(r_range.coord)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _write_dynamic_category_headers(
    ws, root_cats, header_row=40, start_col=9, template_end_col=30
):
    no_fill = PatternFill(fill_type=None)
    no_border = Border(
        left=Side(style=None),
        right=Side(style=None),
        top=Side(style=None),
        bottom=Side(style=None),
    )

    last_cat_col = start_col + len(root_cats) - 1

    for col in range(start_col, template_end_col + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=col)
        if isinstance(cell, MergedCell):
            continue
        if col > last_cat_col:
            cell.value = None
            cell.fill = no_fill
            cell.border = no_border

    for offset, category in enumerate(root_cats):
        col = start_col + offset
        cell = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=col)
        if isinstance(cell, MergedCell):
            continue
        cell.value = category.name
        cell.fill = GREEN_FILL
        cell.font = Font(bold=True, size=12, name="Arial Narrow")
        cell.border = THIN_BORDER
        cell.alignment = Alignment(
            wrap_text=True, horizontal="center", vertical="center"
        )
